import re
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional


# ============================================================
# BLOCKED / BOT-PROTECTION DETECTION
# ============================================================

BLOCKED_MARKERS = [
    "just a moment",
    "performing security verification",
    "checking your browser",
    "verify you are human",
    "cloudflare",
    "security verification",
]


def is_blocked_page(record: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    title = str(record.get("title", "")).lower()
    content = str(record.get("content", "")).lower()

    combined = f"{title} {content}"

    return any(
        marker in combined
        for marker in BLOCKED_MARKERS
    )


# ============================================================
# TEXT CLEANING
# ============================================================

def clean_text(text: Optional[str]) -> str:
    if not text:
        return ""

    text = str(text)

    # Normalize whitespace
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)

    # Remove spaces before punctuation
    text = re.sub(r"\s+([,.!?])", r"\1", text)

    return text.strip()


# ============================================================
# PAGE CLASSIFICATION
# ============================================================

def is_property_page(record: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    """
    Conservative detection of actual property/project pages.

    Important:
    - Press/news pages must NOT be treated as properties.
    - Company/home pages must NOT be treated as properties.
    - Generic country/category pages should not automatically
      produce property-specific fields.
    """

    url = str(
        record.get("source_url", "")
    ).lower().strip()

    title = str(
        record.get("title", "")
    ).lower().strip()

    content = str(
        record.get("content", "")
    ).lower()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Never classify press/news/article pages as properties
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    excluded_url_markers = [
        "/press/",
        "/news/",
        "/blog/",
        "/insights/",
        "/careers/",
        "/investor-relations/",
        "/privacy-policy",
        "/terms-of-use",
        "/terms-of-advertising",
        "/cookie-policy",
    ]

    if any(
        marker in url
        for marker in excluded_url_markers
    ):
        return False

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Explicit property/project URL patterns
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    property_url_patterns = [
        r"/property/",
        r"/properties/[^/]+/[^/]+$",
        r"/project/[^/]+$",
        r"/projects/[^/]+/[^/]+$",
        r"/development/[^/]+$",
        r"/developments/[^/]+$",
        r"/residence/[^/]+$",
        r"/residences/[^/]+$",
        r"/villa/[^/]+$",
        r"/villas/[^/]+$",
        r"/apartment/[^/]+$",
        r"/apartments/[^/]+$",
    ]

    for pattern in property_url_patterns:
        if re.search(pattern, url):
            return True

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Strong title indicators
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    strong_title_markers = [
        "residences",
        "residence",
        "villa",
        "villas",
        "apartment",
        "apartments",
        "mansion",
        "mansions",
        "townhouse",
        "townhouses",
        "penthouse",
        "penthouses",
    ]

    if any(
        marker in title
        for marker in strong_title_markers
    ):
        return True

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Content-based detection
    #
    # Require multiple property signals rather than just
    # seeing the word "project".
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    property_signals = 0

    if re.search(
        r"\b\d+\s*bedrooms?\b",
        content,
        re.IGNORECASE,
    ):
        property_signals += 1

    if re.search(
        r"\b\d+\s*(?:bed|BR)\b",
        content,
        re.IGNORECASE,
    ):
        property_signals += 1

    if re.search(
        r"\b(?:AED|SAR|OMR|QAR|USD|\$|£)\s?[\d,]+",
        content,
        re.IGNORECASE,
    ):
        property_signals += 1

    if re.search(
        r"\b[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?\s*(?:sq\.?\s*ft|sqft|square feet|m²|sqm)\b",
        content,
        re.IGNORECASE,
    ):
        property_signals += 1

    property_words = [
        "property",
        "residence",
        "residences",
        "villa",
        "villas",
        "apartment",
        "apartments",
        "townhouse",
        "mansion",
        "penthouse",
    ]

    if any(
        word in content
        for word in property_words
    ):
        property_signals += 1

    # Require at least two independent signals.
    return property_signals >= 2


# ============================================================
# PRICE EXTRACTION
# ============================================================

def extract_price(text: str) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Extract a property price.

    This function is only called after the page has been
    classified as a property page.

    Note:
    This is intentionally conservative and does not attempt
    to understand arbitrary monetary amounts in articles.
    """

    patterns = [
        r"\bAED\s?[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s?(?:million|m|M|billion|bn))?\b",
        r"\bSAR\s?[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s?(?:million|m|M|billion|bn))?\b",
        r"\bOMR\s?[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s?(?:million|m|M|billion|bn))?\b",
        r"\bQAR\s?[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s?(?:million|m|M|billion|bn))?\b",
        r"\bUSD\s?[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s?(?:million|m|M|billion|bn))?\b",
        r"£[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s?(?:million|m|M|billion|bn))?",
        r"\$[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s?(?:million|m|M|billion|bn))?",
    ]

    for pattern in patterns:
        match = re.search(
            pattern,
            text,
            re.IGNORECASE,
        )

        if match:
            return match.group(0)

    return None


# ============================================================
# BEDROOM EXTRACTION
# ============================================================

def extract_bedrooms(
    text: str,
) -> Optional[int]:

    patterns = [
        r"\b(\d+)\s*[- ]?\s*bedrooms?\b",
        r"\b(\d+)\s*BR\b",
        r"\b(\d+)\s*bed\b",
    ]

    for pattern in patterns:

        match = re.search(
            pattern,
            text,
            re.IGNORECASE,
        )

        if match:
            try:
                return int(
                    match.group(1)
                )
            except ValueError:
                pass

    return None


# ============================================================
# AREA EXTRACTION
# ============================================================

def extract_area(
    text: str,
) -> Optional[str]:

    patterns = [
        r"([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:sq\.?\s*ft|sqft|square feet)",
        r"([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*m²",
        r"([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*sqm",
    ]

    for pattern in patterns:

        match = re.search(
            pattern,
            text,
            re.IGNORECASE,
        )

        if match:
            return match.group(0)

    return None


# ============================================================
# DOCUMENT TYPE
# ============================================================

def detect_document_type(
    record: Dict[str, Any],
) -> str:

    url = str(
        record.get("source_url", "")
    ).lower()

    title = str(
        record.get("title", "")
    ).lower()

    # Press releases
    if "/press/" in url:
        return "press_release"

    # News
    if "/news/" in url:
        return "news"

    # Blog / insights
    if "/blog/" in url or "/insights/" in url:
        return "article"

    # Actual property/project pages
    if is_property_page(record):
        return "property"

    # Otherwise general knowledge document
    return "general"


# ============================================================
# MAIN NORMALIZATION
# ============================================================

def normalize_record(
    record: Dict[str, Any],
) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Reject Cloudflare / bot challenge pages
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if is_blocked_page(record):

        print(
            "Skipping blocked page: "
            f"{record.get('source_url', '')}"
        )

        return None

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Basic fields
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    source = str(
        record.get("source", "")
    ).lower().strip()

    source_url = str(
        record.get("source_url", "")
    ).strip()

    title = clean_text(
        record.get("title")
    )

    description = clean_text(
        record.get("description")
    )

    content = clean_text(
        record.get("content")
    )

    combined_text = " ".join(
        value
        for value in [
            title,
            description,
            content,
        ]
        if value
    )

    if not combined_text:
        return None

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. Determine document type
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    document_type = detect_document_type(
        record
    )

    property_page = (
        document_type == "property"
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. Property-specific fields
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    price = None
    bedrooms = None
    area = None

    if property_page:

        price = extract_price(
            combined_text
        )

        bedrooms = extract_bedrooms(
            combined_text
        )

        area = extract_area(
            combined_text
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. Return normalized record
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    return {
        "source": source,
        "source_url": source_url,
        "title": title,
        "description": description,
        "content": content,

        "document_type": document_type,

        "price": price,
        "bedrooms": bedrooms,
        "area": area,

        "scraped_at": record.get(
            "scraped_at"
        ),
    }

Your current code does:

and:

The regex itself is working correctly. The problem is what text you're allowing it to interpret as a property price.

            return match.group(0)

    return None


# ============================================================
# DOCUMENT TYPE
# ============================================================

def detect_document_type(
    record: Dict[str, Any],
) -> str:

    url = str(
        record.get("source_url", "")
    ).lower()

    title = str(
        record.get("title", "")
    ).lower()

    # Press releases
    if "/press/" in url:
        return "press_release"

    # News
    if "/news/" in url:
        return "news"

    # Blog / insights
    if "/blog/" in url or "/insights/" in url:
        return "article"

    # Actual property/project pages
    if is_property_page(record):
        return "property"

    # Otherwise general knowledge document
    return "general"

# MAIN NORMALIZATION
# ============================================================

def is_news_page(record: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    url = str(record.get("source_url", "")).lower()
    title = str(record.get("title", "")).lower()

    news_url_markers = [

def normalize_record(
    record: Dict[str, Any],
) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Reject Cloudflare / bot challenge pages
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if is_blocked_page(record):

        print(
            "Skipping blocked page: "
            f"{record.get('source_url', '')}"
        )

        return None

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Basic fields
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    source = str(
        record.get("source", "")
    ).lower().strip()

    source_url = str(
        record.get("source_url", "")
    ).strip()

    title = clean_text(
        record.get("title")
    )

    description = clean_text(
        record.get("description")
    )

    content = clean_text(
        record.get("content")
    )

    combined_text = " ".join(
        value
        for value in [
            title,
            description,
            content,
        ]
        if value
    )

    if not combined_text:
        return None

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. Determine document type
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    document_type = detect_document_type(
        record
    )

    property_page = (
        document_type == "property"

    # --------------------------------------------------------

    # --------------------------------------------------------

    bedrooms = None
    area = None

    if property_page:

        price = extract_price(
            combined_text
        )

        bedrooms = extract_bedrooms(
            combined_text
        )

        area = extract_area(
            combined_text
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. Return normalized record
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    return {
        "source": source,
        "source_url": source_url,
        "title": title,
        "description": description,
        "content": content,

        "document_type": document_type,

        "price": price,
        "bedrooms": bedrooms,
        "area": area,

        ),
    }

import re
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional


# ============================================================
# BLOCKED / BOT-PROTECTION DETECTION
# ============================================================

BLOCKED_MARKERS = [
    "just a moment",
    "performing security verification",
    "checking your browser",
    "verify you are human",
    "cloudflare",
    "security verification",
]


def is_blocked_page(record: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    title = str(record.get("title", "")).lower()
    content = str(record.get("content", "")).lower()

    combined = f"{title} {content}"

    return any(
        marker in combined
        for marker in BLOCKED_MARKERS
    )


# ============================================================
# TEXT CLEANING
# ============================================================

def clean_text(text: Optional[str]) -> str:
    if not text:
        return ""

    text = str(text)

    # Normalize whitespace
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)

    # Remove spaces before punctuation
    text = re.sub(
        r"\s+([,.!?])",
        r"\1",
        text,
    )

    return text.strip()


# ============================================================
# NEWS / PRESS DETECTION
# ============================================================

def is_news_page(record: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    """
    Detect press releases, news articles, blogs and insights.

    These pages must never be treated as property pages,
    even if their content contains words such as project,
    residence, villa, tower, etc.
    """

    url = str(
        record.get("source_url", "")
    ).lower()

    title = str(
        record.get("title", "")
    ).lower()

    news_url_markers = [
        "/press/",
        "/news/",
        "/blog/",
        "/insights/",
    ]

    if any(
        marker in url
        for marker in news_url_markers
    ):
        return True

    news_title_markers = [
        "appoints",
        "announces",
        "announcement",
        "contract",
        "successfully executes",
        "marks",
        "awards",
        "launches",
        "partnership",
        "signs",
        "agreement",
        "facility",
    ]

    if any(
        marker in title
        for marker in news_title_markers
    ):
        return True

    return False


# ============================================================
# CATEGORY PAGE DETECTION
# ============================================================

def is_category_page(
    record: Dict[str, Any],
) -> bool:
    """
    Detect property category/search pages.

    These pages describe collections of properties rather
    than one specific property.
    """

    url = str(
        record.get("source_url", "")
    ).lower()

    category_url_markers = [
        "/search",
        "/properties-in-",
        "/property-for-sale",
        "/properties-for-sale",
        "/properties/",
    ]

    # DarGlobal category pages such as:
    #
    # /projects/properties-in-oman
    # /projects/properties-in-oman/apartments
    # /projects/properties-in-uae
    #
    if "/projects/properties-in-" in url:
        return True

    if any(
        marker in url
        for marker in category_url_markers
    ):
        return True

    return False


# ============================================================
# PROPERTY PAGE DETECTION
# ============================================================

def is_property_page(
    record: Dict[str, Any],
) -> bool:
    """
    Detect an actual property/project/listing page.

    This is intentionally conservative.

    Category pages, search pages, press releases and
    articles are excluded.
    """

    url = str(
        record.get("source_url", "")
    ).lower()

    title = str(
        record.get("title", "")
    ).lower()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Never classify news / press / articles as properties
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if is_news_page(record):
        return False

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Never classify category/search pages as properties
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if is_category_page(record):
        return False

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Explicitly excluded corporate URLs
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    excluded_url_markers = [
        "/careers/",
        "/investor-relations/",
        "/corporate/",
        "/about/",
        "/contact/",
        "/privacy/",
        "/terms/",
        "/faq/",
    ]

    if any(
        marker in url
        for marker in excluded_url_markers
    ):
        return False

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Strong property URL markers
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    property_url_markers = [
        "/property/",
        "/property-detail/",
        "/project-detail/",
        "/development/",
        "/development-detail/",
        "/residences/",
        "/villa/",
        "/villas/",
        "/apartment/",
        "/apartments/",
        "/community/",
        "/communities/",
    ]

    if any(
        marker in url
        for marker in property_url_markers
    ):
        return True

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Property-specific title markers
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    property_title_markers = [
        "residences",
        "residence",
        "villa",
        "villas",
        "apartment",
        "apartments",
        "mansion",
        "mansions",
        "hotel residences",
        "townhouse",
        "townhouses",
        "penthouse",
        "penthouses",
    ]

    if any(
        marker in title
        for marker in property_title_markers
    ):
        return True

    return False


# ============================================================
# PRICE EXTRACTION
# ============================================================

def extract_price(
    text: str,
) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Extract a property price.

    IMPORTANT:
    This function is only called after a record has been
    classified as an actual property page.

    It does not attempt to determine whether a monetary
    value represents a property price semantically.
    """

    patterns = [
        r"\bAED\s?[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s?(?:million|m|M|billion|bn))?\b",
        r"\bSAR\s?[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s?(?:million|m|M|billion|bn))?\b",
        r"\bOMR\s?[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s?(?:million|m|M|billion|bn))?\b",
        r"\bQAR\s?[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s?(?:million|m|M|billion|bn))?\b",
        r"\bUSD\s?[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s?(?:million|m|M|billion|bn))?\b",
        r"£[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s?(?:million|m|M|billion|bn))?",
        r"\$[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s?(?:million|m|M|billion|bn))?",
    ]

    for pattern in patterns:

        match = re.search(
            pattern,
            text,
            re.IGNORECASE,
        )

        if match:
            return match.group(0)

    return None


# ============================================================
# BEDROOM EXTRACTION
# ============================================================

def extract_bedrooms(
    text: str,
) -> Optional[int]:

    patterns = [
        r"\b(\d+)\s*[- ]?\s*bedrooms?\b",
        r"\b(\d+)\s*BR\b",
        r"\b(\d+)\s*bed\b",
    ]

    for pattern in patterns:

        match = re.search(
            pattern,
            text,
            re.IGNORECASE,
        )

        if match:

            try:
                return int(
                    match.group(1)
                )

            except ValueError:
                pass

    return None


# ============================================================
# AREA EXTRACTION
# ============================================================

def extract_area(
    text: str,
) -> Optional[str]:

    patterns = [
        r"([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:sq\.?\s*ft|sqft|square feet)",
        r"([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*m²",
        r"([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*sqm",
        r"([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*sq\.?\s*m\b",
    ]

    for pattern in patterns:

        match = re.search(
            pattern,
            text,
            re.IGNORECASE,
        )

        if match:
            return match.group(0)

    return None


# ============================================================
# DOCUMENT TYPE
# ============================================================

def detect_document_type(
    record: Dict[str, Any],
) -> str:
    """
    Classify a scraped page.

    Priority:

        blocked
          ↓
        press/news/article
          ↓
        category
          ↓
        property
          ↓
        general
    """

    url = str(
        record.get("source_url", "")
    ).lower()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Press releases
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if "/press/" in url:
        return "press_release"

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # News
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if "/news/" in url:
        return "news"

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Blog / insights
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        "/blog/" in url
        or "/insights/" in url
    ):
        return "article"

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Other news-like pages
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if is_news_page(record):
        return "news"

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Category/search pages
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if is_category_page(record):
        return "category"

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Actual property pages
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if is_property_page(record):
        return "property"

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Everything else
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    return "general"


# ============================================================
# MAIN NORMALIZATION
# ============================================================

def normalize_record(
    record: Dict[str, Any],
) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Reject Cloudflare / bot challenge pages
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if is_blocked_page(record):

        print(
            "Skipping blocked page: "
            f"{record.get('source_url', '')}"
        )

        return None

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Basic fields
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    source = str(
        record.get("source", "")
    ).lower().strip()

    source_url = str(
        record.get("source_url", "")
    ).strip()

    title = clean_text(
        record.get("title")
    )

    description = clean_text(
        record.get("description")
    )

    content = clean_text(
        record.get("content")
    )

    combined_text = " ".join(
        value
        for value in [
            title,
            description,
            content,
        ]
        if value
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Ignore completely empty records
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if not combined_text:
        return None

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. Determine document type
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    document_type = detect_document_type(
        record
    )

    property_page = (
        document_type == "property"
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. Property-specific fields
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    price = None
    bedrooms = None
    area = None

    if property_page:

        price = extract_price(
            combined_text
        )

        bedrooms = extract_bedrooms(
            combined_text
        )

        area = extract_area(
            combined_text
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. Return normalized record
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    return {
        "source": source,

        "source_url": source_url,

        "title": title,

        "description": description,

        "content": content,

        "document_type": document_type,

        "price": price,

        "bedrooms": bedrooms,

        "area": area,

        "scraped_at": record.get(
            "scraped_at"
        ),
    }

import re
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional


# ============================================================
# BLOCKED / BOT-PROTECTION DETECTION
# ============================================================

BLOCKED_MARKERS = [
    "just a moment",
    "performing security verification",
    "checking your browser",
    "verify you are human",
    "cloudflare",
    "security verification",
]


def is_blocked_page(record: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    title = str(record.get("title", "")).lower()
    content = str(record.get("content", "")).lower()

    combined = f"{title} {content}"

    return any(
        marker in combined
        for marker in BLOCKED_MARKERS
    )


# ============================================================
# TEXT CLEANING
# ============================================================

def clean_text(text: Optional[str]) -> str:
    if not text:
        return ""

    text = str(text)

    # Normalize whitespace
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)

    # Remove spaces before punctuation
    text = re.sub(r"\s+([,.!?])", r"\1", text)

    return text.strip()


# ============================================================
# PAGE CLASSIFICATION
# ============================================================

def is_property_page(record: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    """
    Detect individual property / project pages.

    IMPORTANT:
    Country/property category pages are NOT properties.

    Examples that should be category pages:

        /projects/properties-in-oman
        /projects/properties-in-oman/apartments
        /projects/properties-in-uae/villas
        /projects/properties-in-saudi-arabia
        /projects/properties-in-spain/villas

    Examples that should be property pages:

        /partners/marriott-residences-aida-oman
        /trump-international-resort-maldives
    """

    url = str(
        record.get("source_url", "")
    ).lower().strip()

    title = str(
        record.get("title", "")
    ).lower().strip()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Explicitly exclude non-property pages
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    excluded_url_markers = [
        "/press/",
        "/news/",
        "/blog/",
        "/insights/",
        "/careers/",
        "/investor-relations/",
        "/projects/properties-in-",
    ]

    if any(
        marker in url
        for marker in excluded_url_markers
    ):
        return False

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Explicit individual-property URL patterns
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    property_url_patterns = [
        r"/property/[^/]+/?$",
        r"/property-detail/[^/]+/?$",
        r"/development/[^/]+/?$",
        r"/development-detail/[^/]+/?$",
        r"/residence/[^/]+/?$",
        r"/residences/[^/]+/?$",
        r"/villa/[^/]+/?$",
        r"/villas/[^/]+/?$",
        r"/apartment/[^/]+/?$",
        r"/apartments/[^/]+/?$",
        r"/community/[^/]+/?$",
        r"/communities/[^/]+/?$",
    ]

    for pattern in property_url_patterns:
        if re.search(pattern, url):
            return True

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # DarGlobal-specific known individual project patterns
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    darglobal_property_patterns = [
        r"/partners/[^/]+$",
        r"/trump-international-resort-[^/]+$",
    ]

    for pattern in darglobal_property_patterns:
        if re.search(pattern, url):
            return True

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Property-specific title language
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    property_title_markers = [
        "marriott residences",
        "trump international resort",
        "trump international hotel",
        "residence",
        "residences",
        "villa",
        "villas",
        "mansion",
        "mansions",
        "penthouse",
        "townhouse",
    ]

    if any(
        marker in title
        for marker in property_title_markers
    ):
        return True

    return False


# ============================================================
# CATEGORY PAGE DETECTION
# ============================================================

def is_category_page(
    record: Dict[str, Any],
) -> bool:

    url = str(
        record.get("source_url", "")
    ).lower().strip()

    category_url_patterns = [
        r"/projects/properties-in-[^/]+/?$",
        r"/projects/properties-in-[^/]+/(apartments|villas|hotel)/?$",
    ]

    for pattern in category_url_patterns:
        if re.search(pattern, url):
            return True

    return False


# ============================================================
# NEWS / ARTICLE DETECTION
# ============================================================

def is_news_page(
    record: Dict[str, Any],
) -> bool:

    url = str(
        record.get("source_url", "")
    ).lower()

    title = str(
        record.get("title", "")
    ).lower()

    news_url_markers = [
        "/press/",
        "/news/",
        "/blog/",
        "/insights/",
    ]

    news_title_markers = [
        "appoints",
        "announces",
        "announcement",
        "contract",
        "successfully executes",
        "marks",
        "awards",
        "launches",
    ]

    if any(
        marker in url
        for marker in news_url_markers
    ):
        return True

    if any(
        marker in title
        for marker in news_title_markers
    ):
        return True

    return False


# ============================================================
# PRICE EXTRACTION
# ============================================================

def extract_price(
    text: str,
) -> Optional[str]:

    """
    Extract property price.

    This function is ONLY called for pages classified
    as individual properties.

    It intentionally does not attempt to extract arbitrary
    monetary amounts from news or category pages.
    """

    patterns = [
        r"\bAED\s?[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s?(?:million|m|M|billion|bn))?\b",
        r"\bSAR\s?[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s?(?:million|m|M|billion|bn))?\b",
        r"\bOMR\s?[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s?(?:million|m|M|billion|bn))?\b",
        r"\bQAR\s?[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s?(?:million|m|M|billion|bn))?\b",
        r"\bUSD\s?[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s?(?:million|m|M|billion|bn))?\b",
        r"£[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s?(?:million|m|M|billion|bn))?",
        r"\$[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s?(?:million|m|M|billion|bn))?",
    ]

    for pattern in patterns:

        match = re.search(
            pattern,
            text,
            re.IGNORECASE,
        )

        if match:
            return match.group(0)

    return None


# ============================================================
# BEDROOM EXTRACTION
# ============================================================

def extract_bedrooms(
    text: str,
) -> Optional[int]:

    patterns = [
        r"\b(\d+)\s*[- ]?\s*bedrooms?\b",
        r"\b(\d+)\s*BR\b",
        r"\b(\d+)\s*bed\b",
    ]

    for pattern in patterns:

        match = re.search(
            pattern,
            text,
            re.IGNORECASE,
        )

        if match:

            try:
                return int(
                    match.group(1)
                )

            except ValueError:
                pass

    return None


# ============================================================
# AREA EXTRACTION
# ============================================================

def extract_area(
    text: str,
) -> Optional[str]:

    patterns = [
        r"([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:sq\.?\s*ft|sqft|square feet)",
        r"([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*m²",
        r"([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*sqm",
    ]

    for pattern in patterns:

        match = re.search(
            pattern,
            text,
            re.IGNORECASE,
        )

        if match:
            return match.group(0)

    return None


# ============================================================
# DOCUMENT TYPE
# ============================================================

def detect_document_type(
    record: Dict[str, Any],
) -> str:

    url = str(
        record.get("source_url", "")
    ).lower()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Press releases
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if "/press/" in url:
        return "press_release"

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # News
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if "/news/" in url:
        return "news"

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Blog / insights
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        "/blog/" in url
        or "/insights/" in url
    ):
        return "article"

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Category pages
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if is_category_page(record):
        return "category"

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Individual properties
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if is_property_page(record):
        return "property"

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Everything else
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    return "general"


# ============================================================
# MAIN NORMALIZATION
# ============================================================

def normalize_record(
    record: Dict[str, Any],
) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Reject Cloudflare / bot challenge pages
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if is_blocked_page(record):

        print(
            "Skipping blocked page: "
            f"{record.get('source_url', '')}"
        )

        return None

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Basic fields
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    source = str(
        record.get("source", "")
    ).lower().strip()

    source_url = str(
        record.get("source_url", "")
    ).strip()

    title = clean_text(
        record.get("title")
    )

    description = clean_text(
        record.get("description")
    )

    content = clean_text(
        record.get("content")
    )

    combined_text = " ".join(
        value
        for value in [
            title,
            description,
            content,
        ]
        if value
    )

    if not combined_text:
        return None

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. Determine document type
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    document_type = detect_document_type(
        record
    )

    property_page = (
        document_type == "property"
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. Property-specific fields
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    price = None
    bedrooms = None
    area = None

    if property_page:

        price = extract_price(
            combined_text
        )

        bedrooms = extract_bedrooms(
            combined_text
        )

        area = extract_area(
            combined_text
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. Return normalized record
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    return {
        "source": source,
        "source_url": source_url,
        "title": title,
        "description": description,
        "content": content,

        "document_type": document_type,

        "price": price,
        "bedrooms": bedrooms,
        "area": area,

        "scraped_at": record.get(
            "scraped_at"
        ),
    }

What I recommend changing

/projects/properties-in-uae

Replace your app/services/normalizer.py with this version:
Updated normalizer.py

import re
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional


# ============================================================
# BLOCKED / BOT-PROTECTION DETECTION
# ============================================================

BLOCKED_MARKERS = [
    "just a moment",
    "performing security verification",
    "checking your browser",
    "verify you are human",
    "cloudflare",
    "security verification",
]


def is_blocked_page(record: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    title = str(record.get("title", "")).lower()
    content = str(record.get("content", "")).lower()

    combined = f"{title} {content}"

    return any(
        marker in combined
        for marker in BLOCKED_MARKERS
    )


# ============================================================
# TEXT CLEANING
# ============================================================

def clean_text(text: Optional[str]) -> str:
    if not text:
        return ""

    text = str(text)

    # Normalize whitespace
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)

    # Remove spaces before punctuation
    text = re.sub(r"\s+([,.!?])", r"\1", text)

    return text.strip()


# ============================================================
# CATEGORY PAGE DETECTION
# ============================================================

def is_category_page(record: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    """
    Detect property listing/category pages.

    Examples:

        /projects/properties-in-oman
        /projects/properties-in-oman/apartments
        /projects/properties-in-uae
        /projects/properties-in-saudi-arabia/villas

    These pages describe groups of properties rather than
    one individual property.
    """

    url = str(
        record.get("source_url", "")
    ).lower()

    category_url_markers = [
        "/projects/properties-in-",
    ]

    return any(
        marker in url
        for marker in category_url_markers
    )


# ============================================================
# NEWS / ARTICLE DETECTION
# ============================================================

def is_news_page(record: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    """
    Detect press releases, news, blogs and articles.
    """

    url = str(
        record.get("source_url", "")
    ).lower()

    title = str(
        record.get("title", "")
    ).lower()

    news_url_markers = [
        "/press/",
        "/news/",
        "/blog/",
        "/insights/",
    ]

    news_title_markers = [
        "appoints",
        "announces",
        "announcement",
        "contract",
        "successfully executes",
        "marks",
        "awards",
        "launches",
    ]

    if any(
        marker in url
        for marker in news_url_markers
    ):
        return True

    if any(
        marker in title
        for marker in news_title_markers
    ):
        return True

    return False


# ============================================================
# PROPERTY PAGE DETECTION
# ============================================================

def is_property_page(record: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    """
    Detect an individual property/project page.

    Important:
    Category pages such as /projects/properties-in-oman
    are explicitly excluded.

    Press/news/article pages are also excluded.
    """

    url = str(
        record.get("source_url", "")
    ).lower()

    title = str(
        record.get("title", "")
    ).lower()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Category pages are NOT individual properties
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if is_category_page(record):
        return False

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. News / press / articles are NOT properties
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    excluded_url_markers = [
        "/press/",
        "/news/",
        "/blog/",
        "/insights/",
        "/careers/",
        "/investor-relations/",
    ]

    if any(
        marker in url
        for marker in excluded_url_markers
    ):
        return False

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. Explicit individual property URL patterns
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    property_url_markers = [
        "/property/",
        "/property-detail/",
        "/project-detail/",
        "/development/",
        "/development-detail/",
        "/residence/",
        "/residences/",
        "/villa/",
        "/villas/",
        "/apartment/",
        "/apartments/",
        "/community/",
        "/communities/",
        "/partners/",
    ]

    if any(
        marker in url
        for marker in property_url_markers
    ):
        return True

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. Known DarGlobal project-style pages
    #
    # Some DarGlobal project pages do not have a standard
    # /property/ URL.
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    known_project_markers = [
        "trump-international-resort",
        "marriott-residences",
        "trump-international-hotel",
        "trump-cliff-villas",
        "trump-golf-villas",
        "trump-mansions",
        "rayana-mansions",
        "rayana-kingdom",
        "trump-executive-residences",
        "trump-park-residences",
        "lumaia",
        "marea",
        "tierra-viva",
        "the-astera",
        "dg1",
        "da-vinci",
        "w-residences",
        "urban-oasis",
        "the-mulliner",
        "les-vagues",
    ]

    if any(
        marker in url
        for marker in known_project_markers
    ):
        return True

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. Property-specific title language
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    property_title_markers = [
        "residences",
        "residence",
        "villa",
        "villas",
        "apartment",
        "apartments",
        "mansion",
        "mansions",
        "hotel residences",
        "townhouse",
        "townhouses",
        "penthouse",
        "penthouses",
    ]

    if any(
        marker in title
        for marker in property_title_markers
    ):
        return True

    return False


# ============================================================
# PRICE EXTRACTION
# ============================================================

def extract_price(text: str) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Extract a monetary amount.

    This is only called for documents classified as
    property pages.

    Examples:

        AED 2 million
        AED 2M
        SAR 4M
        SAR 4 million
        OMR 500,000
        QAR 3,650,000
        USD 1.5 million
        £2 million
        $3M
    """

    patterns = [
        r"\bAED\s?[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s?(?:million|m|billion|bn))?\b",
        r"\bSAR\s?[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s?(?:million|m|billion|bn))?\b",
        r"\bOMR\s?[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s?(?:million|m|billion|bn))?\b",
        r"\bQAR\s?[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s?(?:million|m|billion|bn))?\b",
        r"\bUSD\s?[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s?(?:million|m|billion|bn))?\b",
        r"£[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s?(?:million|m|billion|bn))?",
        r"\$[\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?(?:\s?(?:million|m|billion|bn))?",
    ]

    for pattern in patterns:

        match = re.search(
            pattern,
            text,
            re.IGNORECASE,
        )

        if match:
            return match.group(0)

    return None


# ============================================================
# BEDROOM EXTRACTION
# ============================================================

def extract_bedrooms(
    text: str,
) -> Optional[int]:

    patterns = [
        r"\b(\d+)\s*[- ]?\s*bedrooms?\b",
        r"\b(\d+)\s*BR\b",
        r"\b(\d+)\s*bed\b",
    ]

    for pattern in patterns:

        match = re.search(
            pattern,
            text,
            re.IGNORECASE,
        )

        if match:

            try:
                return int(
                    match.group(1)
                )

            except ValueError:
                pass

    return None


# ============================================================
# AREA EXTRACTION
# ============================================================

def extract_area(
    text: str,
) -> Optional[str]:

    patterns = [
        r"([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:sq\.?\s*ft|sqft|square feet)",
        r"([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*m²",
        r"([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*sqm",
    ]

    for pattern in patterns:

        match = re.search(
            pattern,
            text,
            re.IGNORECASE,
        )

        if match:
            return match.group(0)

    return None


# ============================================================
# DOCUMENT TYPE
# ============================================================

def detect_document_type(
    record: Dict[str, Any],
) -> str:

    url = str(
        record.get("source_url", "")
    ).lower()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Press releases
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if "/press/" in url:
        return "press_release"

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # News
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if "/news/" in url:
        return "news"

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Blog / insights
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
        "/blog/" in url
        or "/insights/" in url
    ):
        return "article"

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Category/listing pages
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if is_category_page(record):
        return "category"

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Individual property/project pages
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if is_property_page(record):
        return "property"

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # General pages
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    return "general"


# ============================================================
# MAIN NORMALIZATION
# ============================================================

def normalize_record(
    record: Dict[str, Any],
) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Reject Cloudflare / bot challenge pages
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if is_blocked_page(record):

        print(
            "Skipping blocked page: "
            f"{record.get('source_url', '')}"
        )

        return None

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Basic fields
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    source = str(
        record.get("source", "")
    ).lower().strip()

    source_url = str(
        record.get("source_url", "")
    ).strip()

    title = clean_text(
        record.get("title")
    )

    description = clean_text(
        record.get("description")
    )

    content = clean_text(
        record.get("content")
    )

    combined_text = " ".join(
        value
        for value in [
            title,
            description,
            content,
        ]
        if value
    )

    if not combined_text:
        return None

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. Determine document type
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    document_type = detect_document_type(
        record
    )

    property_page = (
        document_type == "property"
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. Property-specific fields
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    price = None
    bedrooms = None
    area = None

    if property_page:

        price = extract_price(
            combined_text
        )

        bedrooms = extract_bedrooms(
            combined_text
        )

        area = extract_area(
            combined_text
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. Return normalized record
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    return {
        "source": source,
        "source_url": source_url,
        "title": title,
        "description": description,
        "content": content,

        "document_type": document_type,

        "price": price,
        "bedrooms": bedrooms,
        "area": area,

        "scraped_at": record.get(
            "scraped_at"
        ),
    }

6. Separate facts from inferred facts

This is particularly important for your RAG system.

For example, if the page explicitly says:

Marriott Residences AIDA, Oman

we can safely extract:

"brand": "Marriott",
"country": "Oman"

But if we merely infer that a project is in Muscat from some contextual wording, we shouldn't silently treat that as an authoritative fact.

Ideally the final schema eventually includes:

"metadata_confidence": {
    "brand": "high",
    "country": "high",
    "city": "medium",
    "property_type": "high"
}

We don't need to implement this immediately, but the architecture should leave room for it.

DarGlobal

Wasalt

You are getting Cloudflare/bot-protection pages, meaning the scraper isn't receiving the actual content.

These should not be solved in the normalizer.

The normalizer should simply do:

    return None

The Wasalt problem belongs in the scraping/acquisition layer.

So don't weaken is_blocked_page() just to make the record count increase.

Don't regenerate embeddings every time we discover a classification bug.

This is the big payoff.

the RAG system should eventually be able to do:

country = Oman

and then perform semantic retrieval over the filtered documents.

For example:

User:
Show me Marriott properties in Oman

                    ↓

Intent / filters:
brand = Marriott
country = Oman
document_type = property

                    ↓

Metadata filtering

                    ↓

Semantic search

                    ↓

Relevant property chunks

                    ↓

LLM answer

This will dramatically reduce false matches from press releases, category pages and general website content.

1. Add these helper functions

Place these after clean_text() and before the category detection section:

# ============================================================
# PROPERTY METADATA EXTRACTION
# ============================================================

def extract_property_name(
    record: Dict[str, Any],
) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Extract the individual property/project name.
    """

    title = clean_text(record.get("title"))

    if not title:
        return None

    # Known DarGlobal projects
    known_names = [
        "Marriott Residences Oman",
        "Trump International Hotel & Resort Maldives",
        "Trump International Resort Maldives",
    ]

    title_lower = title.lower()

    for name in known_names:
        if name.lower() in title_lower:
            return name

    # Remove common website suffixes
    name = re.sub(
        r"\s*\|\s*DarGlobal.*$",
        "",
        title,
        flags=re.IGNORECASE,
    )

    return name.strip() or None


def extract_developer(
    record: Dict[str, Any],
) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Extract the developer from the page content.
    """

    text = " ".join(
        [
            clean_text(record.get("title")),
            clean_text(record.get("description")),
            clean_text(record.get("content")),
        ]
    )

    developer_markers = [
        "developed by DarGlobal",
        "DarGlobal development",
        "DarGlobal's",
        "DarGlobal on",
        "DarGlobal and",
    ]

    for marker in developer_markers:
        if marker.lower() in text.lower():
            return "DarGlobal"

    # Fallback for known DarGlobal source
    source_url = str(
        record.get("source_url", "")
    ).lower()

    if "darglobal.co.uk" in source_url:
        return "DarGlobal"

    return None


def extract_brand(
    record: Dict[str, Any],
) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Extract the branded hospitality/developer brand.
    """

    text = " ".join(
        [
            clean_text(record.get("title")),
            clean_text(record.get("description")),
            clean_text(record.get("content")),
        ]
    ).lower()

    brand_markers = [
        ("marriott", "Marriott"),
        ("trump international", "Trump"),
        ("the trump organization", "Trump"),
        ("missoni", "Missoni"),
        ("pagani", "Pagani"),
        ("mouawad", "Mouawad"),
    ]

    for marker, brand in brand_markers:
        if marker in text:
            return brand

    return None


def extract_country(
    record: Dict[str, Any],
) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Extract country from property content.
    """

    text = " ".join(
        [
            clean_text(record.get("title")),
            clean_text(record.get("description")),
            clean_text(record.get("content")),
        ]
    ).lower()

    countries = [
        ("oman", "Oman"),
        ("maldives", "Maldives"),
        ("united arab emirates", "United Arab Emirates"),
        ("uae", "United Arab Emirates"),
        ("saudi arabia", "Saudi Arabia"),
        ("qatar", "Qatar"),
        ("united kingdom", "United Kingdom"),
        ("uk", "United Kingdom"),
    ]

    for marker, country in countries:
        if marker in text:
            return country

    return None


def extract_city(
    record: Dict[str, Any],
) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Extract city when explicitly mentioned.
    """

    text = " ".join(
        [
            clean_text(record.get("title")),
            clean_text(record.get("description")),
            clean_text(record.get("content")),
        ]
    )

    city_markers = [
        ("Muscat", "Muscat"),
        ("Doha", "Doha"),
        ("Dubai", "Dubai"),
        ("Abu Dhabi", "Abu Dhabi"),
        ("Jeddah", "Jeddah"),
        ("Riyadh", "Riyadh"),
        ("London", "London"),
    ]

    text_lower = text.lower()

    for marker, city in city_markers:
        if marker.lower() in text_lower:
            return city

    return None


def extract_location(
    record: Dict[str, Any],
) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Extract the most useful named location.
    """

    text = " ".join(
        [
            clean_text(record.get("title")),
            clean_text(record.get("description")),
            clean_text(record.get("content")),
        ]
    )

    text_lower = text.lower()

    location_markers = [
        ("AIDA", "AIDA"),
        ("Noonu Atoll", "Noonu Atoll"),
        ("Wadi Safar", "Wadi Safar"),
        ("Amaya", "Amaya"),
        ("Rayana", "Rayana"),
    ]

    for marker, location in location_markers:
        if marker.lower() in text_lower:
            return location

    return None


def extract_property_type(
    record: Dict[str, Any],
) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Determine the primary property type.
    """

    title = clean_text(record.get("title"))
    description = clean_text(record.get("description"))
    content = clean_text(record.get("content"))

    text = " ".join(
        [
            title,
            description,
            content,
        ]
    ).lower()

    # More specific types first
    property_types = [
        ("hotel & resort", "hotel_resort"),
        ("hotel residences", "hotel_residences"),
        ("branded residences", "branded_residences"),
        ("residences", "residences"),
        ("residence", "residence"),
        ("private island", "private_island"),
        ("island resort", "island_resort"),
        ("lagoon villas", "villas"),
        ("private lagoon villas", "villas"),
        ("villas", "villas"),
        ("villa", "villa"),
        ("apartments", "apartments"),
        ("apartment", "apartment"),
        ("mansions", "mansions"),
        ("mansion", "mansion"),
        ("penthouse", "penthouse"),
        ("townhouses", "townhouses"),
        ("townhouse", "townhouse"),
    ]

    for marker, property_type in property_types:
        if marker in text:
            return property_type

    return None


def extract_investment(
    record: Dict[str, Any],
) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Extract investment-related information.

    This intentionally preserves the relevant text rather than
    interpreting investment claims numerically.
    """

    content = clean_text(
        record.get("content")
    )

    if not content:
        return None

    investment_markers = [
        "Reasons to Invest",
        "investment opportunities",
        "investment",
        "rental yield",
        "rental income",
        "revenue",
        "return",
    ]

    content_lower = content.lower()

    for marker in investment_markers:
        if marker.lower() in content_lower:
            # Capture a useful section around the first match.
            index = content_lower.find(
                marker.lower()
            )

            start = max(
                0,
                index - 100,
            )

            end = min(
                len(content),
                index + 1500,
            )

            return content[start:end].strip()

    return None


def extract_investment_type(
    record: Dict[str, Any],
) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Classify the investment model mentioned on the page.
    """

    content = clean_text(
        record.get("content")
    ).lower()

    if not content:
        return None

    if (
        "rental yield" in content
        or "rental income" in content
    ):
        return "rental_income"

    if (
        "private ownership" in content
        or "home ownership" in content
        or "private home ownership" in content
    ):
        return "private_ownership"

    if (
        "investment opportunities" in content
        or "invest" in content
    ):
        return "investment"

    return None

import json
from collections import Counter


PATH = "data/normalized/properties.json"


def main():
    with open(PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        records = json.load(f)

    print("=" * 80)
    print("NORMALIZATION QUALITY REPORT")
    print("=" * 80)

    print(f"\nTotal records: {len(records)}")

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Document types
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    document_types = Counter(
        r.get("document_type")
        for r in records
    )

    print("\nDocument types")
    print("-" * 40)

    for document_type, count in sorted(
        document_types.items()
    ):
        print(
            f"{document_type:20} {count}"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Property records
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    properties = [
        r
        for r in records
        if r.get("document_type") == "property"
    ]

    print("\nProperty records")
    print("-" * 40)
    print(f"Total properties: {len(properties)}")

    if not properties:
        print("\nNo property records found.")
        return

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Metadata coverage
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    fields = [
        "property_name",
        "developer",
        "brand",
        "country",
        "city",
        "location",
        "property_type",
        "investment",
        "investment_type",
        "price",
        "bedrooms",
        "area",
    ]

    print("\nMetadata coverage")
    print("-" * 40)

    for field in fields:
        populated = sum(
            1
            for r in properties
            if r.get(field) not in (
                None,
                "",
                [],
            )
        )

        total = len(properties)

        percentage = (
            populated / total * 100
            if total
            else 0
        )

        print(
            f"{field:20} "
            f"{populated:3}/{total:<3} "
            f"({percentage:5.1f}%)"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Property details
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    print("\nProperty details")
    print("-" * 80)

    for i, r in enumerate(properties, 1):

        print(f"\n[{i}] {r.get('property_name')}")
        print(
            f"    Title:        {r.get('title')}"
        )
        print(
            f"    Developer:    {r.get('developer')}"
        )
        print(
            f"    Brand:        {r.get('brand')}"
        )
        print(
            f"    Country:      {r.get('country')}"
        )
        print(
            f"    City:         {r.get('city')}"
        )
        print(
            f"    Location:     {r.get('location')}"
        )
        print(
            f"    Type:         {r.get('property_type')}"
        )
        print(
            f"    Price:        {r.get('price')}"
        )
        print(
            f"    Bedrooms:     {r.get('bedrooms')}"
        )
        print(
            f"    Area:         {r.get('area')}"
        )
        print(
            f"    Investment:   {r.get('investment_type')}"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Price safety check
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    print("\nPrice safety check")
    print("-" * 40)

    non_properties_with_price = [
        r
        for r in records
        if r.get("document_type") != "property"
        and r.get("price") not in (
            None,
            "",
        )
    ]

    if non_properties_with_price:
        print(
            "WARNING: Non-property records "
            "contain prices!"
        )

        for r in non_properties_with_price:
            print(
                f"  {r.get('document_type'):15} "
                f"{r.get('price')} | "
                f"{r.get('source_url')}"
            )
    else:
        print(
            "OK: No non-property records "
            "contain prices."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Duplicate URLs
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    print("\nDuplicate URL check")
    print("-" * 40)

    urls = [
        r.get("source_url")
        for r in records
        if r.get("source_url")
    ]

    duplicates = [
        url
        for url, count in Counter(urls).items()
        if count > 1
    ]

    if duplicates:
        print(
            f"WARNING: {len(duplicates)} "
            "duplicate URLs found."
        )

        for url in duplicates:
            print(f"  {url}")
    else:
        print("OK: No duplicate URLs found.")

    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
    print("REPORT COMPLETE")
    print("=" * 80)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Step 6A — Fix metadata contamination

The problem is this pattern:

text = " ".join([
    title,
    description,
    content,
])

For metadata such as brand, country, city, and location, we're searching the entire page, which includes:

    navigation
    related projects
    project dropdowns
    footer
    other DarGlobal properties

That's why Trump Maldives sees Marriott/Oman/AIDA.
Replace the metadata functions

In backend/app/services/normalizer.py, replace these four functions:

extract_brand()
extract_country()
extract_city()
extract_location()

with the following versions.

def extract_brand(
    record: Dict[str, Any],
) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Extract the primary brand from the property's
    title and description.

    Do NOT search the entire page content because
    DarGlobal pages contain navigation and project
    selectors mentioning many unrelated brands.
    """

    text = " ".join(
        [
            clean_text(record.get("title")),
            clean_text(record.get("description")),
        ]
    ).lower()

    # Strongest / most specific signals first
    if "marriott" in text:
        return "Marriott"

    if "trump international" in text:
        return "Trump"

    if "trump" in text:
        return "Trump"

    if "missoni" in text:
        return "Missoni"

    if "pagani" in text:
        return "Pagani"

    if "mouawad" in text:
        return "Mouawad"

    return None


def extract_country(
    record: Dict[str, Any],
) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Extract the property's country using the title
    and description.

    Avoid the full page content because global project
    selectors may contain many countries.
    """

    text = " ".join(
        [
            clean_text(record.get("title")),
            clean_text(record.get("description")),
        ]
    ).lower()

    countries = [
        ("oman", "Oman"),
        ("maldives", "Maldives"),
        ("united arab emirates", "United Arab Emirates"),
        ("uae", "United Arab Emirates"),
        ("saudi arabia", "Saudi Arabia"),
        ("qatar", "Qatar"),
        ("united kingdom", "United Kingdom"),
        ("uk", "United Kingdom"),
    ]

    for marker, country in countries:
        if marker in text:
            return country

    return None


def extract_city(
    record: Dict[str, Any],
) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Extract the property's city from title/description.

    Avoid full content to prevent unrelated project
    locations from contaminating the result.
    """

    text = " ".join(
        [
            clean_text(record.get("title")),
            clean_text(record.get("description")),
        ]
    )

    text_lower = text.lower()

    city_markers = [
        ("muscat", "Muscat"),
        ("doha", "Doha"),
        ("dubai", "Dubai"),
        ("abu dhabi", "Abu Dhabi"),
        ("jeddah", "Jeddah"),
        ("riyadh", "Riyadh"),
        ("london", "London"),
    ]

    for marker, city in city_markers:
        if marker in text_lower:
            return city

    return None


def extract_location(
    record: Dict[str, Any],
) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Extract the property's primary named location.

    Prefer title/description over full page content.
    """

    text = " ".join(
        [
            clean_text(record.get("title")),
            clean_text(record.get("description")),
        ]
    )

    text_lower = text.lower()

    location_markers = [
        ("aida", "AIDA"),
        ("noonu atoll", "Noonu Atoll"),
        ("wadi safar", "Wadi Safar"),
        ("amaya", "Amaya"),
        ("rayana", "Rayana"),
    ]

    for marker, location in location_markers:
        if marker in text_lower:
            return location

    return None

Why this fixes your specific problem

Your Trump page has:

Title:
Trump International Hotel & Resort Maldives

Description:
... Noonu Atoll ... Maldives ...

So:

brand   → Trump
country → Maldives
location → Noonu Atoll

will come from the property's own title/description.

It won't accidentally see this later in the page:

Marriott Residences Aida, Oman
Lumaia, Doha
...

which is part of the site's global project selector.
Step 6B — Fix property_type too

Your current property_type happened to work, but it has the same fundamental contamination risk because it searches the entire content.

For example, a page could describe another project as:

Trump Cliff Villas

and incorrectly classify the current property as villas.

Replace extract_property_type() with:

def extract_property_type(
    record: Dict[str, Any],
) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Determine the primary property type using only
    the property's title and description.
    """

    text = " ".join(
        [
            clean_text(record.get("title")),
            clean_text(record.get("description")),
        ]
    ).lower()

    property_types = [
        ("hotel & resort", "hotel_resort"),
        ("hotel and resort", "hotel_resort"),
        ("hotel residences", "hotel_residences"),
        ("branded residences", "branded_residences"),
        ("residences", "residences"),
        ("residence", "residence"),
        ("private island", "private_island"),
        ("lagoon villas", "villas"),
        ("villas", "villas"),
        ("villa", "villa"),
        ("apartments", "apartments"),
        ("apartment", "apartment"),
        ("mansions", "mansions"),
        ("mansion", "mansion"),
        ("penthouse", "penthouse"),
        ("townhouses", "townhouses"),
        ("townhouse", "townhouse"),
    ]

    for marker, property_type in property_types:
        if marker in text:
            return property_type

    return None
