  "Main concerns",
  "Valuation",
  "Confidence",
] as const;

function parseAnswer(answer: string): Sections {
  const sections: Sections = {};

  let currentSection:
    | keyof Sections
    | null = null;

  answer.split("\n").forEach((line) => {
    const trimmed = line.trim();

    const matchedSection = SECTION_NAMES.find(
      (section) => trimmed === `${section}:`
    );

    if (matchedSection) {
      currentSection = matchedSection;
      sections[matchedSection] = [];
      return;
    }

    if (currentSection && trimmed) {
      sections[currentSection]?.push(trimmed);
    }
  });

  return sections;
}

interface SectionProps {
  title: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

function Section({
  title,
  children,
}: SectionProps) {
  return (
    <section className="ai-answer-section">
      <h3>{title}</h3>
      {children}
    </section>
  );
}

interface LinesProps {
  lines?: string[];
}

function Lines({ lines }: LinesProps) {
  if (!lines?.length) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div>
      {lines.map((line, index) => {
        const isBullet = line.startsWith("- ");

        if (isBullet) {
          return (
            <div
              key={index}
              className="ai-answer-bullet"
            >
              {line.substring(2)}
            </div>
          );
        }

        return (
          <p key={index}>
            {line}
          </p>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function PropertyAIAnswer({
  answer,
}: PropertyAIAnswerProps) {
  if (!answer) {
    return null;
  }

  const sections = parseAnswer(answer);

  return (
    <div className="property-ai-answer">
      {sections.Assessment && (
        <Section title="Assessment">
          <Lines lines={sections.Assessment} />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections.Why && (
        <Section title="Why">
          <Lines lines={sections.Why} />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections["Main concerns"] && (
        <Section title="Main concerns">
          <Lines
            lines={sections["Main concerns"]}
          />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections.Valuation && (
        <Section title="Valuation">
          <Lines lines={sections.Valuation} />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections.Confidence && (
        <Section title="Confidence">
          <Lines
            lines={sections.Confidence}
          />
        </Section>
      )}

      <div className="ai-answer-disclaimer">
        This is an indicative analysis based on
        available property data and POC-generated
        intelligence. It is not financial advice or
        a professional property valuation.
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

4. API service

Create:

src/api/propertyAI.ts

import type {
  PropertyAIResponse,
} from "../types/propertyAI";

export async function askPropertyAI(
  propertyId: number,
  query: string,
): Promise<PropertyAIResponse> {
  const response = await fetch(
    `/api/properties/${propertyId}/ai`,
    {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        query,
      }),
    },
  );

  if (!response.ok) {
    const message =
      await response.text();

    throw new Error(
      message ||
        "Unable to analyze property.",
    );
  }

  return response.json() as Promise<PropertyAIResponse>;
}

But don't use that endpoint yet. We need to see your actual FastAPI route first.
5. React component

Then your component can be:

src/components/PropertyAI.tsx

import {
  useState,
} from "react";

import PropertyAIAnswer from "./PropertyAIAnswer";

import {
  askPropertyAI,
} from "../api/propertyAI";

interface PropertyAIProps {
  propertyId: number;
}

export default function PropertyAI({
  propertyId,
}: PropertyAIProps) {
  const [
    query,
    setQuery,
  ] = useState(
    "Is this property a good investment and what are the main concerns?",
  );

  const [
    answer,
    setAnswer,
  ] = useState("");

  const [
    loading,
    setLoading,
  ] = useState(false);

  const [
    error,
    setError,
  ] = useState("");

  async function handleAsk() {
    if (!query.trim()) {
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      const response =
        await askPropertyAI(
          propertyId,
          query,
        );

      setAnswer(response.answer);

    } catch (error) {
      setError(
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : "Unable to analyze property.",
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="property-ai">
      <h2>
        AI Investment Analysis
      </h2>

      <textarea
        value={query}
        onChange={(event) =>
          setQuery(event.target.value)
        }
        rows={4}
        placeholder="Ask about this property..."
      />

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={handleAsk}
        disabled={
          loading ||
          !query.trim()
        }
      >
        {loading
          ? "Analyzing..."
          : "Ask AI"}
      </button>

      {error && (
        <div className="ai-error">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {answer && (
        <PropertyAIAnswer
          answer={answer}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

  FormEvent,
  useEffect,
  useState,
} from "react";

import {
    chat,
  getHealth,
  searchKnowledge,

type SearchResult = {
  document: string;
  metadata: {
    title?: string;
    source?: string;
    source_url?: string;
    document_type?: string;
    property_name?: string;
    developer?: string;
    brand?: string;
    country?: string;
    city?: string;
    location?: string;
    property_type?: string;
    investment_type?: string;
    price?: string;
    bedrooms?: string;
    area?: string;
  };
};

type Message = {
  role: "user" | "assistant";
  content: string;
  results?: SearchResult[];
};

function App() {
  const [backendStatus, setBackendStatus] =
    useState("Checking...");

  const [input, setInput] = useState("");

  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<Message[]>(
    [
      {
        role: "assistant",
        content:
          "Hi! I can help you explore the DarGlobal and Wasalt real estate knowledge base. Ask me about properties, projects, locations, brands, or investment opportunities.",
      },
    ]
  );

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    getHealth()
      .then(() => setBackendStatus("Connected"))
      .catch(() => setBackendStatus("Offline"));
  }, []);

  async function handleSubmit(
    event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>
  ) {
    event.preventDefault();

    const query = input.trim();

    if (!query || loading) {
      return;
    }

    setInput("");

    setMessages((current) => [
      ...current,
      {
        role: "user",
        content: query,
      },
    ]);

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await searchKnowledge(query);

      const results: SearchResult[] =
        response.results || [];

      setMessages((current) => [
        ...current,
        {
          role: "assistant",
          content:
            results.length > 0
              ? `I found ${results.length} relevant result${
                  results.length === 1 ? "" : "s"
                } in the knowledge base.`
              : "I couldn't find any relevant results in the knowledge base.",
          results,
        },
      ]);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);

      setMessages((current) => [
        ...current,
        {
          role: "assistant",
          content:
            "I couldn't connect to the search service. Please make sure the backend is running.",
        },
      ]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="app">
      <header className="header">
        <div>
          <h1>Property Intelligence</h1>

          <p>
            AI-powered real estate research
          </p>
        </div>

        <span
          className={
            backendStatus === "Connected"
              ? "status online"
              : "status"
          }
        >
          ● {backendStatus}
        </span>
      </header>

      <main className="chat-page">
        <section className="chat-container">
          <div className="chat-header">
            <div>
              <h2>Real Estate Assistant</h2>

              <p>
                Ask questions about properties and
                projects.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="chat-sources">
              <span>DarGlobal</span>
              <span>Wasalt</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="messages">
            {messages.map((message, index) => (
              <div
                key={index}
                className={`message-row ${message.role}`}
              >
                <div className="avatar">
                  {message.role === "assistant"
                    ? "AI"
                    : "You"}
                </div>

                <div className="message-content">
                  <div className="message-bubble">
                    {message.content}
                  </div>

                  {message.results &&
                    message.results.length > 0 && (
                      <div className="results">
                        {message.results.map(
                          (result, resultIndex) => {
                            const metadata =
                              result.metadata;

                            return (
                              <article
                                className="result-card"
                                key={resultIndex}
                              >
                                <div className="result-card-header">
                                  <span className="result-source">
                                    {metadata.source ||
                                      "Knowledge Base"}
                                  </span>

                                  {metadata.document_type && (
                                    <span className="result-type">
                                      {
                                        metadata.document_type
                                      }
                                    </span>
                                  )}
                                </div>

                                <h3>
                                  {metadata.property_name ||
                                    metadata.title ||
                                    "Property information"}
                                </h3>

                                {(metadata.city ||
                                  metadata.country ||
                                  metadata.location) && (
                                  <p className="result-location">
                                    {[
                                      metadata.location,
                                      metadata.city,
                                      metadata.country,
                                    ]
                                      .filter(Boolean)
                                      .join(", ")}
                                  </p>
                                )}

                                <div className="result-metadata">
                                  {metadata.developer && (
                                    <div>
                                      <span>
                                        Developer
                                      </span>

                                      <strong>
                                        {
                                          metadata.developer
                                        }
                                      </strong>
                                    </div>
                                  )}

                                  {metadata.brand && (
                                    <div>
                                      <span>
                                        Brand
                                      </span>

                                      <strong>
                                        {
                                          metadata.brand
                                        }
                                      </strong>
                                    </div>
                                  )}

                                  {metadata.property_type && (
                                    <div>
                                      <span>
                                        Type
                                      </span>

                                      <strong>
                                        {
                                          metadata.property_type
                                        }
                                      </strong>
                                    </div>
                                  )}

                                  {metadata.investment_type && (
                                    <div>
                                      <span>
                                        Investment
                                      </span>

                                      <strong>
                                        {
                                          metadata.investment_type
                                        }
                                      </strong>
                                    </div>

                                  {metadata.price && (

                                    </div>

                              </article>
                            );
                          }

                      </div>

                </div>

            ))}

            {loading && (

      </main>

import {
  useState,
} from "react";

import PropertyAIAnswer from "./PropertyAIAnswer";

import {
  askPropertyAI,
} from "../services/propertyAI";

interface PropertyAIProps {
  propertyId: number;
}

export default function PropertyAI({
  propertyId,
}: PropertyAIProps) {
  const [
    query,
    setQuery,
  ] = useState(
    "Is this property a good investment and what are the main concerns?",
  );

  const [
    answer,
    setAnswer,
  ] = useState("");

  const [
    loading,
    setLoading,
  ] = useState(false);

  const [
    error,
    setError,
  ] = useState("");

  async function handleAsk() {
    if (!query.trim()) {
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      const response =
        await askPropertyAI(
          propertyId,
          query,
        );

      setAnswer(response.answer);

    } catch (error) {
      setError(
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : "Unable to analyze property.",
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="property-ai">
      <h2>
        AI Investment Analysis
      </h2>

      <textarea
        value={query}
        onChange={(event) =>
          setQuery(event.target.value)
        }
        rows={4}
        placeholder="Ask about this property..."
      />

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={handleAsk}
        disabled={
          loading ||
          !query.trim()
        }
      >
        {loading
          ? "Analyzing..."
          : "Ask AI"}
      </button>

      {error && (
        <div className="ai-error">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {answer && (
        <PropertyAIAnswer
          answer={answer}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React from "react";
import "./PropertyAIAnswer.css";

interface PropertyAIAnswerProps {
  answer: string;
}

type Sections = {
  Assessment?: string[];
  Why?: string[];
  "Main concerns"?: string[];
  Valuation?: string[];
  Confidence?: string[];
};

const SECTION_NAMES = [
  "Assessment",
  "Why",
  "Main concerns",
  "Valuation",
  "Confidence",
] as const;

function parseAnswer(answer: string): Sections {
  const sections: Sections = {};

  let currentSection:
    | keyof Sections
    | null = null;

  answer.split("\n").forEach((line) => {
    const trimmed = line.trim();

    const matchedSection = SECTION_NAMES.find(
      (section) => trimmed === `${section}:`
    );

    if (matchedSection) {
      currentSection = matchedSection;
      sections[matchedSection] = [];
      return;
    }

    if (currentSection && trimmed) {
      sections[currentSection]?.push(trimmed);
    }
  });

  return sections;
}

interface SectionProps {
  title: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

function Section({
  title,
  children,
}: SectionProps) {
  return (
    <section className="ai-answer-section">
      <h3>{title}</h3>
      {children}
    </section>
  );
}

interface LinesProps {
  lines?: string[];
}

function Lines({ lines }: LinesProps) {
  if (!lines?.length) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div>
      {lines.map((line, index) => {
        const isBullet = line.startsWith("- ");

        if (isBullet) {
          return (
            <div
              key={index}
              className="ai-answer-bullet"
            >
              {line.substring(2)}
            </div>
          );
        }

        return (
          <p key={index}>
            {line}
          </p>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function PropertyAIAnswer({
  answer,
}: PropertyAIAnswerProps) {
  if (!answer) {
    return null;
  }

  const sections = parseAnswer(answer);

  return (
    <div className="property-ai-answer">
      {sections.Assessment && (
        <Section title="Assessment">
          <Lines lines={sections.Assessment} />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections.Why && (
        <Section title="Why">
          <Lines lines={sections.Why} />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections["Main concerns"] && (
        <Section title="Main concerns">
          <Lines
            lines={sections["Main concerns"]}
          />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections.Valuation && (
        <Section title="Valuation">
          <Lines lines={sections.Valuation} />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections.Confidence && (
        <Section title="Confidence">
          <Lines
            lines={sections.Confidence}
          />
        </Section>
      )}

      <div className="ai-answer-disclaimer">
        This is an indicative analysis based on
        available property data and POC-generated
        intelligence. It is not financial advice or
        a professional property valuation.
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import type {
  PropertyAIResponse,
} from "../types/propertyAI";

export async function askPropertyAI(
  propertyId: number,
  query: string,
): Promise<PropertyAIResponse> {
  const response = await fetch(
    `/api/properties/${propertyId}/ai`,
    {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        query,
      }),
    },
  );

  if (!response.ok) {
    const message =
      await response.text();

    throw new Error(
      message ||
        "Unable to analyze property.",
    );
  }

  return response.json() as Promise<PropertyAIResponse>;
}

Good — this confirms the fallback is being returned, but the guardrail metadata is still reporting violations from the original LLM response. That's actually a useful clue.

There are two things to fix before React:

    The guardrail should report passed: false + fallback_used: true when it had to repair the answer. That's expected.
    But the fallback itself should be validated and should not contain the original violations. More importantly, we need to fix why the original answer is being flagged despite visually containing the required sections.

The most suspicious part is the mismatch between:

AI ANSWER:
...
Confidence:
...
disclaimer...

and:

violations:
missing_section:Confidence
forbidden_content:\bthe user asks\b
missing_disclaimer

That means the violations are from the raw LLM response, while AI ANSWER is the fallback.

So don't try to make the frontend hide those violations. We should make the backend contract explicit.
1. Update AIGuardrails.validate()

Open:

backend/app/services/ai_guardrails.py

At the end of validate(), replace the invalid-response section with this:

# -----------------------------------------------------
# Invalid response
# -----------------------------------------------------

if violations:

    fallback = self.build_fallback(evidence)

    # Validate the deterministic fallback itself.
    fallback_violations = self._validate_fallback(
        fallback,
        evidence,
    )

    if fallback_violations:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "Guardrail fallback failed validation: "
            + ", ".join(fallback_violations)
        )

    return {
        "valid": False,
        "answer": fallback,
        "violations": violations,
        "fallback_used": True,
    }

Then add this method to the class:

def _validate_fallback(
    self,
    answer: str,
    evidence: dict[str, Any],
) -> list[str]:

    violations: list[str] = []

    for section in self.REQUIRED_SECTIONS:
        if section not in answer:
            violations.append(
                f"missing_section:{section[:-1]}"
            )

    normalized_answer = (
        self._normalize_whitespace(answer)
    )

    normalized_disclaimer = (
        self._normalize_whitespace(
            self.DISCLAIMER
        )
    )

    if normalized_disclaimer not in normalized_answer:
        violations.append(
            "missing_disclaimer"
        )

    violations.extend(
        self._validate_numbers(
            answer,
            evidence,
        )
    )

    return violations

This gives us a very important guarantee:

    If the LLM produces garbage, the deterministic fallback must itself be valid.

2. Update the return from answer()

Now open:

backend/app/services/ai_orchestrator.py

Find where you currently return the response from answer().

You want this shape:

return {
    "intent": intent,
    "answer": guardrail_result["answer"],
    "model": model,
    "guardrails": {
        "passed": guardrail_result["valid"],
        "fallback_used": guardrail_result.get(
            "fallback_used",
            False,
        ),
        "violations": guardrail_result["violations"],
    },
}

This distinction is important:

passed
  ↓
Did the original LLM answer pass validation?

fallback_used
  ↓
Did the system replace the LLM answer with
the deterministic fallback?

So a perfectly safe response can legitimately be:

{
    "passed": False,
    "fallback_used": True,
    "violations": [
        "missing_section:Confidence",
        ...
    ]
}

because the LLM response failed, but the user-facing response is safe.

Yes — this is now a backend guardrails implementation issue, not a React issue.

The traceback tells us exactly what happened:

AttributeError: 'AIGuardrails' object has no attribute '_validate_fallback'

Your validate() method is calling:

fallback_violations = self._validate_fallback(
    fallback,
    evidence,
)

but AIGuardrails doesn't currently define that method.
Fix app/services/ai_guardrails.py

Add _validate_fallback() inside the AIGuardrails class, preferably immediately before build_fallback().

Use this:

    # =========================================================
    # FALLBACK VALIDATION
    # =========================================================

    def _validate_fallback(
        self,
        fallback: str,
        evidence: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> list[str]:

        violations: list[str] = []

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # Required sections
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        for section in self.REQUIRED_SECTIONS:
            if section not in fallback:
                violations.append(
                    f"fallback_missing_section:{section[:-1]}"
                )

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # Forbidden content
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        for pattern in self.FORBIDDEN_PATTERNS:
            if re.search(
                pattern,
                fallback,
                flags=re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
            ):
                violations.append(
                    f"fallback_forbidden_content:{pattern}"
                )

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # Financial advice
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        for pattern in self.FORBIDDEN_ADVICE_PATTERNS:
            if re.search(
                pattern,
                fallback,
                flags=re.IGNORECASE,
            ):
                violations.append(
                    f"fallback_financial_advice:{pattern}"
                )

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # Disclaimer
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        normalized_fallback = (
            self._normalize_whitespace(fallback)
        )

        normalized_disclaimer = (
            self._normalize_whitespace(
                self.DISCLAIMER
            )
        )

        if normalized_disclaimer not in normalized_fallback:
            violations.append(
                "fallback_missing_disclaimer"
            )

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # Numeric validation
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        numeric_violations = self._validate_numbers(
            fallback,
            evidence,
        )

        for violation in numeric_violations:
            violations.append(
                f"fallback_{violation}"
            )

        return violations

    def _build_valuation_text(
        valuation: dict[str, Any],

    ) -> str:

        if not valuation.get("available"):
            return (
                "A deterministic valuation is not "

            )

        estimated_value = valuation.get(
            "estimated_value"
        )

            property_data.get("currency")

            estimated_value is not None

            estimated_display = (
                f"{currency}"
                f"{estimated_value / 1_000_000:.2f}M"

            asking_display = (

                    f"price of {asking_display}. This indicates "
                    f"approximately {upside:.2f}% upside relative "
                    f"to its estimated value."
                )

            return (
                f"The estimated value is approximately "
                f"{estimated_display}, which is approximately "

            estimated_value is not None
            and upside is not None

                f"The estimated value is approximately "
                f"{estimated_value:,.2f}. The supplied valuation "
                f"indicates the property is approximately "
                f"{abs(upside):.2f}% above its estimated value."
            )

        return (
            "A valuation is available, but some valuation "
            "details are unavailable."
        )

Perfect. The guardrails layer is now behaving correctly. ✅

Your test proves the important path:

Bad LLM response
      ↓
Guardrails detect violations
      ↓
Fallback generated
      ↓
Fallback validated successfully
      ↓
VALID: True
FALLBACK USED: True
      ↓
Safe deterministic answer

The original violations are retained as diagnostics:

missing_section:Why
missing_section:Main concerns
missing_section:Valuation
missing_section:Confidence
forbidden_content:\bthe user asks\b
missing_disclaimer

That's exactly what we want internally.
One small distinction

VALID: True now means:

    The final answer returned to the user passed the guardrail pipeline.

It does not mean the original LLM response was valid.

You can think of the states as:
LLM	Fallback	Result
Valid	—	passed=True, fallback_used=False
Invalid	Valid	passed=True, fallback_used=True
Invalid	Invalid	passed=False, fallback_used=True

That's a solid design.

Replace the file with:

import {
  useState,
} from "react";

import PropertyAIAnswer from "./PropertyAIAnswer";

import {
  askPropertyAI,
} from "../services/propertyAI";

import type {
  PropertyAIResponse,
} from "../types/propertyAI";

interface PropertyAIProps {
  propertyId: number;
}

export default function PropertyAI({
  propertyId,
}: PropertyAIProps) {
  const [
    query,
    setQuery,
  ] = useState(
    "Is this property a good investment and what are the main concerns?",
  );

  const [
    response,
    setResponse,
  ] = useState<PropertyAIResponse | null>(
    null,
  );

  const [
    loading,
    setLoading,
  ] = useState(false);

  const [
    error,
    setError,
  ] = useState("");

  async function handleAsk() {
    if (!query.trim()) {
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      const result =
        await askPropertyAI(
          propertyId,
          query,
        );

      setResponse(result);

    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);

      setResponse(null);

      setError(
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : "Unable to analyze property.",
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="property-ai">
      <h2>
        AI Investment Analysis
      </h2>

      <textarea
        value={query}
        onChange={(event) =>
          setQuery(event.target.value)
        }
        rows={4}
        placeholder="Ask about this property..."
        disabled={loading}
      />

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={handleAsk}
        disabled={
          loading ||
          !query.trim()
        }
      >
        {loading
          ? "Analyzing..."
          : "Ask AI"}
      </button>

      {error && (
        <div className="ai-error">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {response && (
        <PropertyAIAnswer
          answer={response.answer}
          model={response.model}
          guardrails={response.guardrails}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

The key change is:

  useState<PropertyAIResponse | null>(null);

  useState("");

3. src/components/PropertyAIAnswer.tsx

Update it so the component receives the backend metadata.

import React from "react";
import "./PropertyAIAnswer.css";

import type {
  PropertyAIGuardrails,
} from "../types/propertyAI";

interface PropertyAIAnswerProps {
  answer: string;
  model: string;
  guardrails: PropertyAIGuardrails;
}

type Sections = {
  Assessment?: string[];
  Why?: string[];
  "Main concerns"?: string[];
  Valuation?: string[];
  Confidence?: string[];
};

const SECTION_NAMES = [
  "Assessment",
  "Why",
  "Main concerns",
  "Valuation",
  "Confidence",
] as const;

function parseAnswer(
  answer: string,
): Sections {
  const sections: Sections = {};

  let currentSection:
    | keyof Sections
    | null = null;

  answer
    .split("\n")
    .forEach((line) => {
      const trimmed = line.trim();

      const matchedSection =
        SECTION_NAMES.find(
          (section) =>
            trimmed === `${section}:`,
        );

      if (matchedSection) {
        currentSection =
          matchedSection;

        sections[matchedSection] = [];

        return;
      }

      if (
        currentSection &&
        trimmed
      ) {
        sections[currentSection]?.push(
          trimmed,
        );
      }
    });

  return sections;
}

interface SectionProps {
  title: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

function Section({
  title,
  children,
}: SectionProps) {
  return (
    <section className="ai-answer-section">
      <h3>{title}</h3>

      {children}
    </section>
  );
}

interface LinesProps {
  lines?: string[];
}

function Lines({
  lines,
}: LinesProps) {
  if (!lines?.length) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div>
      {lines.map(
        (line, index) => {
          const isBullet =
            line.startsWith("- ");

          if (isBullet) {
            return (
              <div
                key={index}
                className="ai-answer-bullet"
              >
                <span>•</span>

                <span>
                  {line.substring(2)}
                </span>
              </div>
            );
          }

          return (
            <p key={index}>
              {line}
            </p>
          );
        },
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function PropertyAIAnswer({
  answer,
  model,
  guardrails,
}: PropertyAIAnswerProps) {
  if (!answer) {
    return null;
  }

  const sections =
    parseAnswer(answer);

  return (
    <div className="property-ai-answer">

      <div className="ai-answer-header">
        <div>
          <h2>
            Investment Analysis
          </h2>

          <p>
            AI-assisted property intelligence
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="ai-answer-status">
          <span className="ai-status-dot" />

          <span>
            Analysis verified
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {sections.Assessment && (
        <Section title="Assessment">
          <Lines
            lines={
              sections.Assessment
            }
          />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections.Why && (
        <Section title="Why">
          <Lines
            lines={sections.Why}
          />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections["Main concerns"] && (
        <Section title="Main concerns">
          <Lines
            lines={
              sections["Main concerns"]
            }
          />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections.Valuation && (
        <Section title="Valuation">
          <Lines
            lines={
              sections.Valuation
            }
          />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections.Confidence && (
        <Section title="Confidence">
          <Lines
            lines={
              sections.Confidence
            }
          />
        </Section>
      )}

      <div className="ai-answer-meta">
        <span>
          Model: {model}
        </span>

        {guardrails.fallback_used && (
          <span>
            Deterministic safety fallback applied
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="ai-answer-disclaimer">
        This is an indicative analysis based on
        available property data and POC-generated
        intelligence. It is not financial advice or
        a professional property valuation.
      </div>

    </div>
  );
}

One UI decision

missing_section:Confidence

For your current response:

the UI can safely show a subtle status such as:

    Deterministic safety fallback applied

That is useful during the POC without exposing internal guardrail rules.

    bedrooms?: string;
    area?: string;
  };
};

type Message = {
  role: "user" | "assistant";
  content: string;
  results?: SearchResult[];
};

function getPropertyName(property: Property): string {
  return (
    property.property_name ||
    property.name ||
    property.title ||
    `Property #${property.id}`
  );
}

function formatValue(
  value: number | string | undefined,
  currency?: string,
): string {
  if (value === undefined || value === null || value === "") {
    return "-";
  }

  if (typeof value === "number") {
    return `${currency || ""}${value.toLocaleString()}`;
  }

  return value;
}

function App() {
  const [backendStatus, setBackendStatus] =
    useState("Checking...");

  const [properties, setProperties] =
    useState<Property[]>([]);

  const [selectedPropertyId, setSelectedPropertyId] =
    useState<number | null>(null);

  const [propertiesLoading, setPropertiesLoading] =
    useState(true);

  const [propertiesError, setPropertiesError] =
    useState("");

  const [input, setInput] = useState("");

  const [messages, setMessages] =
    useState<Message[]>([
      {
        role: "assistant",
        content:
          "Select a property above to view its investment intelligence, or ask me a general real estate question.",
      },
    ]);

  const [loading, setLoading] =
    useState(false);

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * Backend health
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  useEffect(() => {
    getHealth()
      .then(() => setBackendStatus("Connected"))
      .catch(() => setBackendStatus("Offline"));
  }, []);

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * Load properties
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadProperties() {
      try {
        setPropertiesLoading(true);
        setPropertiesError("");

        const response = await getProperties();

        /*
         * Support either:
         *
         * [
         *   {...}
         * ]
         *
         * or:
         *
         * {
         *   properties: [...]
         * }
         */

        const items: Property[] =
          Array.isArray(response)
            ? response
            : response.properties || [];

        setProperties(items);

        if (items.length > 0) {
          setSelectedPropertyId(items[0].id);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);

        setPropertiesError(
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : "Unable to load properties.",
        );
      } finally {
        setPropertiesLoading(false);
      }
    }

    loadProperties();
  }, []);

  const selectedProperty =
    properties.find(
      (property) =>
        property.id === selectedPropertyId,
    ) || null;

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * General chat / knowledge search
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  async function handleSubmit(
    event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>,
  ) {
    event.preventDefault();

    const query = input.trim();

    if (!query || loading) {
      return;
    }

    setInput("");

    setMessages((current) => [
      ...current,
      {
        role: "user",
        content: query,
      },
    ]);

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      /*
       * Use the actual chat endpoint instead of
       * searchKnowledge().
       *
       * This allows the backend orchestrator to
       * understand the query.
       */

      const response = await chat(query);

      /*
       * Depending on your ChatResponse schema,
       * support common response fields.
       */

      const answer =
        response.answer ||
        response.message ||
        response.response ||
        "";

      const results: SearchResult[] =
        response.results || [];

        let content = answer;

        if (!content) {
        content =
            results.length > 0
            ? `I found ${results.length} relevant result${
                results.length === 1 ? "" : "s"
                }.`
            : "I couldn't find any relevant results.";
        }

        setMessages((current) => [
        ...current,
        {
            role: "assistant",
            content,
            results,
        },
        ]);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);

      /*
       * Fall back to knowledge search if the
       * general chat endpoint is unavailable.
       */

      try {
        const response =
          await searchKnowledge(query);

        const results: SearchResult[] =
          response.results || [];

        setMessages((current) => [
          ...current,
          {
            role: "assistant",
            content:
              results.length > 0
                ? `I found ${results.length} relevant result${
                    results.length === 1 ? "" : "s"
                  } in the knowledge base.`
                : "I couldn't find any relevant results in the knowledge base.",
            results,
          },
        ]);
      } catch (fallbackError) {
        console.error(fallbackError);

        setMessages((current) => [
          ...current,
          {
            role: "assistant",
            content:
              "I couldn't connect to the backend. Please make sure the API server is running.",
          },
        ]);
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * Render
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  return (
    <div className="app">

      {/* =====================================================
          HEADER
      ===================================================== */}

      <header className="header">
        <div>
          <h1>Property Intelligence</h1>

          <p>
            AI-powered real estate research
          </p>
        </div>

        <span
          className={
            backendStatus === "Connected"
              ? "status online"
              : "status"
          }
        >
          ● {backendStatus}
        </span>
      </header>


      {/* =====================================================
          MAIN
      ===================================================== */}

      <main className="chat-page">

        <section className="chat-container">

          {/* =================================================
              PROPERTY SELECTOR
          ================================================= */}

          <div className="property-selector">

            <div>
              <h2>
                Property Intelligence
              </h2>

              <p>
                Select a property to view its
                investment analysis.
              </p>
            </div>

            {propertiesLoading ? (
              <div className="property-loading">
                Loading properties...
              </div>
            ) : propertiesError ? (
              <div className="ai-error">
                {propertiesError}
              </div>
            ) : properties.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="property-loading">
                No properties found.
              </div>
            ) : (
              <select
                value={
                  selectedPropertyId ?? ""
                }
                onChange={(event) => {
                  const value =
                    Number(event.target.value);

                  setSelectedPropertyId(
                    value || null,
                  );
                }}
              >
                {properties.map(
                  (property) => (
                    <option
                      key={property.id}
                      value={property.id}
                    >
                      {getPropertyName(
                        property,
                      )}
                    </option>
                  ),
                )}
              </select>
            )}
          </div>


          {/* =================================================
              SELECTED PROPERTY
          ================================================= */}

          {selectedProperty && (
            <section className="property-panel">

              <div className="property-panel-header">

                <div>
                  <span className="property-label">
                    SELECTED PROPERTY
                  </span>

                  <h2>
                    {getPropertyName(
                      selectedProperty,
                    )}
                  </h2>

                  {(selectedProperty.city ||
                    selectedProperty.country ||
                    selectedProperty.location) && (
                    <p>
                      {[
                        selectedProperty.location,
                        selectedProperty.city,
                        selectedProperty.country,
                      ]
                        .filter(Boolean)
                        .join(", ")}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                <span className="property-id">
                  ID #{selectedProperty.id}
                </span>

              </div>


              <div className="property-metadata">

                {selectedProperty.developer && (
                  <div>
                    <span>
                      Developer
                    </span>

                    <strong>
                      {
                        selectedProperty.developer
                      }
                    </strong>
                  </div>
                )}

                {selectedProperty.brand && (
                  <div>
                    <span>
                      Brand
                    </span>

                    <strong>
                      {
                        selectedProperty.brand
                      }
                    </strong>
                  </div>
                )}

                {selectedProperty.property_type && (
                  <div>
                    <span>
                      Property Type
                    </span>

                    <strong>
                      {
                        selectedProperty.property_type
                      }
                    </strong>
                  </div>
                )}

                {selectedProperty.investment_type && (
                  <div>
                    <span>
                      Investment Type
                    </span>

                    <strong>
                      {
                        selectedProperty.investment_type
                      }
                    </strong>
                  </div>
                )}

                {selectedProperty.price !==
                  undefined && (
                  <div>
                    <span>
                      Price
                    </span>

                    <strong>
                      {formatValue(
                        selectedProperty.price,
                        selectedProperty.currency,
                      )}
                    </strong>
                  </div>
                )}

                {selectedProperty.bedrooms !==
                  undefined && (
                  <div>
                    <span>
                      Bedrooms
                    </span>

                    <strong>
                      {
                        selectedProperty.bedrooms
                      }
                    </strong>
                  </div>
                )}

                {selectedProperty.area !==
                  undefined && (
                  <div>
                    <span>
                      Area
                    </span>

                    <strong>
                      {formatValue(
                        selectedProperty.area,
                      )}
                    </strong>
                  </div>
                )}

              </div>


              {/* =============================================
                  PROPERTY AI
              ============================================= */}

              <PropertyAI
                propertyId={
                  selectedProperty.id
                }
              />

            </section>
          )}


          {/* =================================================
              GENERAL CHAT
          ================================================= */}

          <div className="chat-header">

            <div>
              <h2>
                Real Estate Assistant
              </h2>

              <p>
                Ask questions about properties,
                projects, locations, brands,
                or the real estate market.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="chat-sources">
              <span>
                DarGlobal
              </span>

              <span>
                Wasalt
              </span>
            </div>

          </div>


          {/* =================================================
              MESSAGES
          ================================================= */}

          <div className="messages">

            {messages.map(
              (message, index) => (
                <div
                  key={index}
                  className={`message-row ${message.role}`}
                >

                  <div className="avatar">
                    {message.role ===
                    "assistant"
                      ? "AI"
                      : "You"}
                  </div>

                  <div className="message-content">

                    <div className="message-bubble">
                      {message.content}
                    </div>


                    {message.results &&
                      message.results.length >
                        0 && (
                        <div className="results">

                          {message.results.map(
                            (
                              result,
                              resultIndex,
                            ) => {

                              const metadata =
                                result.metadata;

                              return (
                                <article
                                  className="result-card"
                                  key={
                                    resultIndex
                                  }
                                >

                                  <div className="result-card-header">

                                    <span className="result-source">
                                      {metadata.source ||
                                        "Knowledge Base"}
                                    </span>

                                    {metadata.document_type && (
                                      <span className="result-type">
                                        {
                                          metadata.document_type
                                        }
                                      </span>
                                    )}

                                  </div>


                                  <h3>
                                    {metadata.property_name ||
                                      metadata.title ||
                                      "Property information"}
                                  </h3>


                                  {(metadata.city ||
                                    metadata.country ||
                                    metadata.location) && (
                                    <p className="result-location">
                                      {[
                                        metadata.location,
                                        metadata.city,
                                        metadata.country,
                                      ]
                                        .filter(Boolean)
                                        .join(
                                          ", ",
                                        )}
                                    </p>
                                  )}


                                  <div className="result-metadata">

                                    {metadata.developer && (
                                      <div>
                                        <span>
                                          Developer
                                        </span>

                                        <strong>
                                          {
                                            metadata.developer
                                          }
                                        </strong>
                                      </div>
                                    )}

                                    {metadata.brand && (
                                      <div>
                                        <span>
                                          Brand
                                        </span>

                                        <strong>
                                          {
                                            metadata.brand
                                          }
                                        </strong>
                                      </div>
                                    )}

                                    {metadata.property_type && (
                                      <div>
                                        <span>
                                          Type
                                        </span>

                                        <strong>
                                          {
                                            metadata.property_type
                                          }
                                        </strong>
                                      </div>
                                    )}

                                    {metadata.investment_type && (
                                      <div>
                                        <span>
                                          Investment
                                        </span>

                                        <strong>
                                          {
                                            metadata.investment_type
                                          }
                                        </strong>
                                      </div>
                                    )}

                                    {metadata.price && (
                                      <div>
                                        <span>
                                          Price
                                        </span>

                                        <strong>
                                          {
                                            metadata.price
                                          }
                                        </strong>
                                      </div>
                                    )}

                                    {metadata.bedrooms && (
                                      <div>
                                        <span>
                                          Bedrooms
                                        </span>

                                        <strong>
                                          {
                                            metadata.bedrooms
                                          }
                                        </strong>
                                      </div>
                                    )}

                                    {metadata.area && (
                                      <div>
                                        <span>
                                          Area
                                        </span>

                                        <strong>
                                          {
                                            metadata.area
                                          }
                                        </strong>
                                      </div>
                                    )}

                                  </div>


                                  <details className="result-details">

                                    <summary>
                                      View source content
                                    </summary>

                                    <p>
                                      {
                                        result.document
                                      }
                                    </p>

                                  </details>


                                  {metadata.source_url && (
                                    <a
                                      href={
                                        metadata.source_url
                                      }
                                      target="_blank"
                                      rel="noreferrer"
                                    >
                                      Open source →
                                    </a>
                                  )}

                                </article>
                              );
                            },
                          )}

                        </div>
                      )}

                  </div>

                </div>
              ),
            )}


            {loading && (
              <div className="message-row assistant">

                <div className="avatar">
                  AI
                </div>

                <div className="message-content">

                  <div className="message-bubble typing">
                    <span />
                    <span />
                    <span />
                  </div>

                </div>

              </div>
            )}

          </div>


          {/* =================================================
              CHAT INPUT
          ================================================= */}

          <form
            className="chat-input-area"
            onSubmit={handleSubmit}
          >

            <input
              value={input}
              onChange={(event) =>
                setInput(
                  event.target.value,
                )
              }
              placeholder="Ask about properties, projects, locations..."
              disabled={loading}
            />

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={
                loading ||
                !input.trim()
              }
            >
              {loading
                ? "..."
                : "Send"}
            </button>

          </form>


          <p className="chat-disclaimer">
            AI analysis is based on available
            property and market intelligence.
            It is not financial advice or a
            professional property valuation.
          </p>

        </section>

      </main>

    </div>
  );
}

export default App;

import React from "react";
import "./PropertyAIAnswer.css";

import type {
  PropertyAIGuardrails,
} from "../types/propertyAI";

interface PropertyAIAnswerProps {
  answer: string;
  model: string;
  guardrails: PropertyAIGuardrails;
}

type Sections = {
  Assessment?: string[];
  Why?: string[];
  "Main concerns"?: string[];
  Valuation?: string[];
  Confidence?: string[];
};

const SECTION_NAMES = [
  "Assessment",
  "Why",
  "Main concerns",
  "Valuation",
  "Confidence",
] as const;

function parseAnswer(
  answer: string,
): Sections {
  const sections: Sections = {};

  let currentSection:
    | keyof Sections
    | null = null;

  answer
    .split("\n")
    .forEach((line) => {
      const trimmed = line.trim();

      const matchedSection =
        SECTION_NAMES.find(
          (section) =>
            trimmed === `${section}:`,
        );

      if (matchedSection) {
        currentSection =
          matchedSection;

        sections[matchedSection] = [];

        return;
      }

      if (
        currentSection &&
        trimmed
      ) {
        sections[currentSection]?.push(
          trimmed,
        );
      }
    });

  return sections;
}

interface SectionProps {
  title: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

function Section({
  title,
  children,
}: SectionProps) {
  return (
    <section className="ai-answer-section">
      <h3>{title}</h3>

      {children}
    </section>
  );
}

interface LinesProps {
  lines?: string[];
}

function Lines({
  lines,
}: LinesProps) {
  if (!lines?.length) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div>
      {lines.map(
        (line, index) => {
          const isBullet =
            line.startsWith("- ");

          if (isBullet) {
            return (
              <div
                key={index}
                className="ai-answer-bullet"
              >
                <span>•</span>

                <span>
                  {line.substring(2)}
                </span>
              </div>
            );
          }

          return (
            <p key={index}>
              {line}
            </p>
          );
        },
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function PropertyAIAnswer({
  answer,
  model,
  guardrails,
}: PropertyAIAnswerProps) {
  if (!answer) {
    return null;
  }

  const sections =
    parseAnswer(answer);

  return (
    <div className="property-ai-answer">

      <div className="ai-answer-header">
        <div>
          <h2>
            Investment Analysis
          </h2>

          <p>
            AI-assisted property intelligence
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="ai-answer-status">
          <span className="ai-status-dot" />

          <span>
            Analysis verified
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {sections.Assessment && (
        <Section title="Assessment">
          <Lines
            lines={
              sections.Assessment
            }
          />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections.Why && (
        <Section title="Why">
          <Lines
            lines={sections.Why}
          />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections["Main concerns"] && (
        <Section title="Main concerns">
          <Lines
            lines={
              sections["Main concerns"]
            }
          />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections.Valuation && (
        <Section title="Valuation">
          <Lines
            lines={
              sections.Valuation
            }
          />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections.Confidence && (
        <Section title="Confidence">
          <Lines
            lines={
              sections.Confidence
            }
          />
        </Section>
      )}

      <div className="ai-answer-meta">
        <span>
          Model: {model}
        </span>

        {guardrails.fallback_used && (
          <span>
            Deterministic safety fallback applied
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="ai-answer-disclaimer">
        This is an indicative analysis based on
        available property data and POC-generated
        intelligence. It is not financial advice or
        a professional property valuation.
      </div>

    </div>
  );
}

import {
  useState,
} from "react";

import PropertyAIAnswer from "./PropertyAIAnswer";

import {
  askPropertyAI,
} from "../services/propertyAI";

import type {
  PropertyAIResponse,
} from "../types/propertyAI";

interface PropertyAIProps {
  propertyId: number;
}

export default function PropertyAI({
  propertyId,
}: PropertyAIProps) {
  const [
    query,
    setQuery,
  ] = useState(
    "Is this property a good investment and what are the main concerns?",
  );

  const [
    response,
    setResponse,
  ] = useState<PropertyAIResponse | null>(
    null,
  );

  const [
    loading,
    setLoading,
  ] = useState(false);

  const [
    error,
    setError,
  ] = useState("");

  async function handleAsk() {
    if (!query.trim()) {
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      const result =
        await askPropertyAI(
          propertyId,
          query,
        );

      setResponse(result);

    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);

      setResponse(null);

      setError(
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : "Unable to analyze property.",
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="property-ai">
      <h2>
        AI Investment Analysis
      </h2>

      <textarea
        value={query}
        onChange={(event) =>
          setQuery(event.target.value)
        }
        rows={4}
        placeholder="Ask about this property..."
        disabled={loading}
      />

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={handleAsk}
        disabled={
          loading ||
          !query.trim()
        }
      >
        {loading
          ? "Analyzing..."
          : "Ask AI"}
      </button>

      {error && (
        <div className="ai-error">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {response && (
        <PropertyAIAnswer
          answer={response.answer}
          model={response.model}
          guardrails={response.guardrails}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
