The important UX idea

When a property is selected, it becomes chat context, not a separate analysis page.

So the user can naturally ask:

Is this property a good investment?

Then:

Why?

Then:

What are the main concerns?

Then:

How does it compare with similar properties?

Then:

Is the asking price reasonable?

Then:

What infrastructure supports this location?

All within one conversation.

That is much closer to the product you're trying to demonstrate.

1. App.tsx

Replace your current frontend/src/App.tsx with this.

import {
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useState,
} from "react";

import {
  getHealth,
  getProperties,
} from "./services/api";

import PropertyAI from "./components/PropertyAI";

import "./index.css";

interface Property {
  id: number;

  name?: string;
  title?: string;
  property_name?: string;

  developer?: string;
  brand?: string;

  source?: string;

  country?: string;
  city?: string;
  location?: string;

  property_type?: string;

  price?: number | string;
  currency?: string;

  bedrooms?: number | string;
  bathrooms?: number | string;

  area?: number | string;
  area_unit?: string;
}

function getPropertyName(
  property: Property,
): string {
  return (
    property.property_name ||
    property.name ||
    property.title ||
    `Property #${property.id}`
  );
}

function formatPrice(
  property: Property,
): string {
  if (
    property.price === undefined ||
    property.price === null ||
    property.price === ""
  ) {
    return "Price unavailable";
  }

  return `${property.currency || ""} ${Number(
    property.price,
  ).toLocaleString()}`;
}

export default function App() {
  const [
    backendStatus,
    setBackendStatus,
  ] = useState("Checking...");

  const [
    properties,
    setProperties,
  ] = useState<Property[]>([]);

  const [
    selectedPropertyId,
    setSelectedPropertyId,
  ] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const [
    propertiesLoading,
    setPropertiesLoading,
  ] = useState(true);

  const [
    propertiesError,
    setPropertiesError,
  ] = useState("");

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * Backend health
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  useEffect(() => {
    getHealth()
      .then(() => {
        setBackendStatus("Connected");
      })
      .catch(() => {
        setBackendStatus("Offline");
      });
  }, []);

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * Load properties
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadProperties() {
      try {
        setPropertiesLoading(true);
        setPropertiesError("");

        const response =
          await getProperties();

        const items: Property[] =
          Array.isArray(response)
            ? response
            : response.properties || [];

        setProperties(items);

        if (items.length > 0) {
          setSelectedPropertyId(
            items[0].id,
          );
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);

        setPropertiesError(
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : "Unable to load properties.",
        );
      } finally {
        setPropertiesLoading(false);
      }
    }

    loadProperties();
  }, []);

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * Selected property
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  const selectedProperty =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        properties.find(
          (property) =>
            property.id ===
            selectedPropertyId,
        ) || null,
      [
        properties,
        selectedPropertyId,
      ],
    );

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * Property change
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  function handlePropertyChange(
    propertyId: number,
  ) {
    setSelectedPropertyId(
      propertyId,
    );
  }

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * UI
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  return (
    <div className="app">

      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}
      {/* Header                                             */}
      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}

      <header className="header">

        <div>
          <h1>
            Property Intelligence
          </h1>

          <p>
            AI-powered real estate research
          </p>
        </div>

        <div
          className={
            backendStatus === "Connected"
              ? "status online"
              : "status"
          }
        >
          <span className="status-dot">
            ●
          </span>

          {backendStatus}
        </div>

      </header>

      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}
      {/* Main                                               */}
      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}

      <main className="chat-page">

        <section className="chat-container">

          {/* ------------------------------------------------ */}
          {/* Chat header                                      */}
          {/* ------------------------------------------------ */}

          <div className="chat-header">

            <div>
              <h2>
                Real Estate Intelligence Assistant
              </h2>

              <p>
                Ask about properties, valuation,
                comparables, infrastructure, growth
                and investment risk.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="chat-sources">

              <span>
                DarGlobal
              </span>

              <span>
                Wasalt
              </span>

            </div>

          </div>

          {/* ------------------------------------------------ */}
          {/* Property context                                 */}
          {/* ------------------------------------------------ */}

          <div className="property-context">

            <div className="property-context-label">
              PROPERTY CONTEXT
            </div>

            {propertiesLoading ? (
              <div className="property-context-loading">
                Loading properties...
              </div>
            ) : propertiesError ? (
              <div className="property-context-error">
                {propertiesError}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="property-context-row">

                <select
                  value={
                    selectedPropertyId ?? ""
                  }
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    handlePropertyChange(
                      Number(
                        event.target.value,
                      ),
                    )
                  }
                >
                  {properties.map(
                    (property) => (
                      <option
                        key={property.id}
                        value={property.id}
                      >
                        {getPropertyName(
                          property,
                        )}
                        {property.city
                          ? ` | ${property.city}`
                          : ""}
                        {property.source
                          ? ` | ${property.source}`
                          : ""}
                      </option>
                    ),
                  )}
                </select>

              </div>
            )}

          </div>

          {/* ------------------------------------------------ */}
          {/* Selected property summary                        */}
          {/* ------------------------------------------------ */}

          {selectedProperty && (
            <div className="selected-property">

              <div className="selected-property-main">

                <div className="selected-property-title">

                  <span>
                    SELECTED PROPERTY
                  </span>

                  <h3>
                    {getPropertyName(
                      selectedProperty,
                    )}
                  </h3>

                  <p>
                    {[
                      selectedProperty.location,
                      selectedProperty.city,
                      selectedProperty.country,
                    ]
                      .filter(Boolean)
                      .join(", ")}
                  </p>

                </div>

                <div className="selected-property-source">
                  {selectedProperty.source ||
                    "Property"}
                </div>

              </div>

              <div className="property-summary-grid">

                <div>
                  <span>
                    Developer
                  </span>

                  <strong>
                    {selectedProperty.developer ||
                      "-"}
                  </strong>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <span>
                    Type
                  </span>

                  <strong>
                    {selectedProperty.property_type ||
                      "-"}
                  </strong>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <span>
                    Price
                  </span>

                  <strong>
                    {formatPrice(
                      selectedProperty,
                    )}
                  </strong>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <span>
                    Bedrooms
                  </span>

                  <strong>
                    {selectedProperty.bedrooms ||
                      "-"}
                  </strong>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <span>
                    Area
                  </span>

                  <strong>
                    {selectedProperty.area
                      ? `${selectedProperty.area} ${
                          selectedProperty.area_unit ||
                          ""
                        }`
                      : "-"}
                  </strong>
                </div>

              </div>

            </div>
          )}

          {/* ------------------------------------------------ */}
          {/* Unified AI chat                                  */}
          {/* ------------------------------------------------ */}

          <PropertyAI
            propertyId={
              selectedPropertyId
            }
            propertyName={
              selectedProperty
                ? getPropertyName(
                    selectedProperty,
                  )
                : undefined
            }
          />

        </section>

      </main>

    </div>
  );
}
2. PropertyAI.tsx

This is the more important change.

Instead of:

textarea
Ask AI
answer

we'll make it a conversation component.

Replace:

frontend/src/components/PropertyAI.tsx

with:

import {
  FormEvent,
  KeyboardEvent,
  useEffect,
  useRef,
  useState,
} from "react";

import PropertyAIAnswer from "./PropertyAIAnswer";

import {
  askPropertyAI,
} from "../services/propertyAI";

interface PropertyAIProps {
  propertyId: number | null;
  propertyName?: string;
}

interface ConversationMessage {
  id: string;

  role:
    | "user"
    | "assistant";

  content: string;

  model?: string;
}

const DEFAULT_PROMPT =
  "Is this property a good investment and what are the main concerns?";

const SUGGESTED_QUESTIONS = [
  "Is this property a good investment?",
  "Why is this property a good or weak deal?",
  "What are the main risks?",
  "How does the valuation compare with the asking price?",
  "How does this property compare with similar properties?",
];

export default function PropertyAI({
  propertyId,
  propertyName,
}: PropertyAIProps) {

  const [
    input,
    setInput,
  ] = useState("");

  const [
    messages,
    setMessages,
  ] = useState<
    ConversationMessage[]
  >([]);

  const [
    loading,
    setLoading,
  ] = useState(false);

  const [
    error,
    setError,
  ] = useState("");

  const messagesEndRef =
    useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(
      null,
    );

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * Reset conversation when property changes
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  useEffect(() => {

    setMessages([
      {
        id: crypto.randomUUID(),

        role: "assistant",

        content: propertyName
          ? `I’m ready to analyze ${propertyName}. You can ask me about its valuation, comparable properties, growth potential, infrastructure, risks, or whether it looks like a good deal.`
          : "Select a property and ask me about its investment intelligence.",
      },
    ]);

    setInput("");
    setError("");

  }, [
    propertyId,
    propertyName,
  ]);

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * Scroll conversation
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  useEffect(() => {

    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({
      behavior: "smooth",
    });

  }, [messages, loading]);

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * Submit
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  async function handleSubmit(
    event?: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>,
  ) {

    event?.preventDefault();

    const query =
      input.trim();

    if (
      !query ||
      loading ||
      propertyId === null
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const userMessage: ConversationMessage = {
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),

      role: "user",

      content: query,
    };

    setMessages(
      (current) => [
        ...current,
        userMessage,
      ],
    );

    setInput("");
    setError("");
    setLoading(true);

    try {

      const response =
        await askPropertyAI(
          propertyId,
          query,
        );

      const assistantMessage:
        ConversationMessage = {
        id: crypto.randomUUID(),

        role: "assistant",

        content:
          response.answer,

        model:
          response.model,
      };

      setMessages(
        (current) => [
          ...current,
          assistantMessage,
        ],
      );

    } catch (error) {

      console.error(error);

      setError(
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : "Unable to analyze property.",
      );

      setMessages(
        (current) => [
          ...current,
          {
            id: crypto.randomUUID(),

            role: "assistant",

            content:
              "I couldn't complete the property analysis. Please try again.",
          },
        ],
      );

    } finally {

      setLoading(false);

    }
  }

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * Enter key
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  function handleKeyDown(
    event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>,
  ) {

    if (
      event.key === "Enter" &&
      !event.shiftKey
    ) {

      event.preventDefault();

      void handleSubmit();

    }
  }

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * Suggested question
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  function askSuggestedQuestion(
    question: string,
  ) {

    if (loading) {
      return;
    }

    setInput(question);

    setTimeout(() => {
      void handleSubmit();
    }, 0);
  }

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * Clear conversation
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  function clearConversation() {

    setMessages([
      {
        id: crypto.randomUUID(),

        role: "assistant",

        content: propertyName
          ? `Conversation cleared. What would you like to know about ${propertyName}?`
          : "Conversation cleared. Select a property to begin.",
      },
    ]);

    setError("");

  }

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * Render
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  return (
    <div className="property-ai-chat">

      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}
      {/* Chat title                                         */}
      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}

      <div className="property-ai-chat-header">

        <div>

          <div className="property-ai-title-row">

            <div className="ai-avatar">
              AI
            </div>

            <div>
              <h2>
                Property Intelligence
              </h2>

              <p>
                Ask questions about this property
              </p>
            </div>

          </div>

        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          className="clear-chat-button"
          onClick={
            clearConversation
          }
          disabled={loading}
        >
          Clear
        </button>

      </div>

      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}
      {/* Active context                                     */}
      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}

      {propertyName && (
        <div className="ai-property-context">

          <span className="context-icon">
            ◆
          </span>

          <div>

            <span>
              ANALYZING PROPERTY
            </span>

            <strong>
              {propertyName}
            </strong>

          </div>

        </div>
      )}

      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}
      {/* Conversation                                      */}
      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}

      <div className="ai-conversation">

        {messages.map(
          (message) => (

            <div
              key={message.id}
              className={`ai-message-row ${message.role}`}
            >

              <div
                className={`ai-message-avatar ${message.role}`}
              >
                {message.role ===
                "assistant"
                  ? "AI"
                  : "You"}
              </div>

              <div className="ai-message-body">

                <div className="ai-message-label">
                  {message.role ===
                  "assistant"
                    ? "Property Intelligence"
                    : "You"}
                </div>

                <div className="ai-message-bubble">

                  {message.role ===
                  "assistant" ? (
                    <PropertyAIAnswer
                      answer={
                        message.content
                      }
                      compact
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <p>
                      {message.content}
                    </p>
                  )}

                </div>

                {message.model && (
                  <div className="ai-message-meta">
                    Powered by local AI
                  </div>
                )}

              </div>

            </div>

          ),
        )}

        {/* ------------------------------------------------ */}
        {/* Loading                                         */}
        {/* ------------------------------------------------ */}

        {loading && (
          <div className="ai-message-row assistant">

            <div className="ai-message-avatar assistant">
              AI
            </div>

            <div className="ai-message-body">

              <div className="ai-message-label">
                Property Intelligence
              </div>

              <div className="ai-message-bubble ai-loading">

                <span />
                <span />
                <span />

                <em>
                  Analyzing property intelligence...
                </em>

              </div>

            </div>

          </div>
        )}

        <div
          ref={
            messagesEndRef
          }
        />

      </div>

      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}
      {/* Suggested questions                                */}
      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}

      {!loading &&
        messages.length <= 1 && (
          <div className="ai-suggestions">

            <span>
              Try asking
            </span>

            <div>

              {SUGGESTED_QUESTIONS
                .slice(0, 4)
                .map(
                  (question) => (
                    <button
                      key={question}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() =>
                        askSuggestedQuestion(
                          question,
                        )
                      }
                    >
                      {question}
                    </button>
                  ),
                )}

            </div>

          </div>
        )}

      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}
      {/* Error                                             */}
      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}

      {error && (
        <div className="ai-error">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}
      {/* Composer                                           */}
      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}

      <form
        className="ai-composer"
        onSubmit={handleSubmit}
      >

        <textarea
          value={input}
          onChange={(event) =>
            setInput(
              event.target.value,
            )
          }
          onKeyDown={
            handleKeyDown
          }
          disabled={
            loading ||
            propertyId === null
          }
          rows={2}
          placeholder={
            propertyId === null
              ? "Select a property to ask questions..."
              : "Ask about valuation, comparables, growth, infrastructure, risks..."
          }
        />

        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={
            loading ||
            !input.trim() ||
            propertyId === null
          }
          aria-label="Send"
        >
          {loading
            ? "..."
            : "➤"}
        </button>

      </form>

      <div className="ai-composer-hint">
        Press Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
      </div>

    </div>
  );
}
3. Important: one small change to PropertyAIAnswer.tsx

Your existing PropertyAIAnswer currently renders a full set of cards and expects:

<PropertyAIAnswer
  answer={response.answer}
  model={response.model}
  guardrails={response.guardrails}
/>

from the previous version.

For the conversational UI, I recommend adding a compact property.

Change:

interface PropertyAIAnswerProps {
  answer: string;
  model: string;
  guardrails: PropertyAIGuardrails;
}

to:

interface PropertyAIAnswerProps {
  answer: string;

  model?: string;

  guardrails?: PropertyAIGuardrails;

  compact?: boolean;
}

And component:

export default function PropertyAIAnswer({
  answer,
  model,
  guardrails,
  compact = false,
}: PropertyAIAnswerProps) {

Then you can make the existing sections slightly smaller when:

compact === true

However, if you don't want to modify this file yet, remove:

compact

from the call in PropertyAI.tsx.

For the 3-day POC, I actually recommend keeping the existing answer parser and simply making the CSS compact.

4. Why I recommend this design

Your product is not really:

"Property Details + AI Investment Analysis + Chat"

It is becoming:

"AI Real Estate Intelligence Assistant"

with property context.

That distinction matters.

The conversation becomes:

User
 │
 │ Selects Marriott Residences Oman
 ▼
Property Context
 │
 ▼
AI Assistant
 │
 ├── Valuation Engine
 ├── Comparable Engine
 ├── Growth Engine
 ├── Risk Engine
 ├── Infrastructure Engine
 ├── Location Intelligence
 ├── Deal Engine
 └── Personalization
 │
 ▼
Answer

The attached architecture already separates deterministic intelligence from AI explanation, so this UI is just exposing that architecture conversationally rather than creating another analysis screen.

5. Even better: property context should persist

I strongly recommend this behavior:

User selects:
Marriott Residences Oman

Chat shows:

Analyzing property:
Marriott Residences Oman

Then:

User

Is this a good investment?

AI

Assessment: Weak...

Then user:

Why?

The frontend should not require the user to repeat the property name.

Then:

What about valuation?

Then:

Compare it with similar properties.

Then:

What are the biggest risks?

This is where the chatbot becomes substantially more valuable than a normal real-estate search UI.

6. One limitation we should recognize now

Your current askPropertyAI() API sends only:

{
  "query": "Is this property a good investment?"
}

while the property ID is in the URL:

POST /api/properties/{propertyId}/ai

That's enough for property-scoped conversation.

But it doesn't yet send previous conversation history.

For the 3-day POC, I recommend NOT changing the backend yet.

Instead:

Conversation UI
       │
       ├── Q1 → property analysis
       ├── Q2 → property analysis
       ├── Q3 → property analysis
       └── Q4 → property analysis

Each question is grounded against the same selected property.

That's sufficient to demonstrate conversational behavior.

Later we can add:

conversation_id
messages[]

but don't burn time on that now.

Do not add another dashboard, another analysis page, or another AI panel. The chat itself should become the front door to Location Intelligence, Infrastructure, Comparables, Valuation, Growth, Risk, Personalization and Deal Intelligence.

The existing project plan also explicitly calls for keeping the POC scope frozen and avoiding unnecessary production complexity.

One caveat before you paste the code

The PropertyAI.tsx above assumes your current backend response and PropertyAIAnswer integration from the attached project history. Your existing API service is already calling the property-scoped endpoint and returning PropertyAIResponse.

import {
  useState,
} from "react";

import PropertyAIAnswer from "./PropertyAIAnswer";

import {
  askPropertyAI,
} from "../services/propertyAI";

interface PropertyAIProps {
  propertyId: number;
}

export default function PropertyAI({
  propertyId,
}: PropertyAIProps) {
  const [
    query,
    setQuery,
  ] = useState(
    "Is this property a good investment and what are the main concerns?",
  );

  const [
    answer,
    setAnswer,
  ] = useState("");

  const [
    loading,
    setLoading,
  ] = useState(false);

  const [
    error,
    setError,
  ] = useState("");

  async function handleAsk() {
    if (!query.trim()) {
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      const response =
        await askPropertyAI(
          propertyId,
          query,
        );

      setAnswer(response.answer);

    } catch (error) {
      setError(
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : "Unable to analyze property.",
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="property-ai">
      <h2>
        AI Investment Analysis
      </h2>

      <textarea
        value={query}
        onChange={(event) =>
          setQuery(event.target.value)
        }
        rows={4}
        placeholder="Ask about this property..."
      />

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={handleAsk}
        disabled={
          loading ||
          !query.trim()
        }
      >
        {loading
          ? "Analyzing..."
          : "Ask AI"}
      </button>

      {error && (
        <div className="ai-error">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {answer && (
        <PropertyAIAnswer
          answer={answer}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import {
  FormEvent,
  useEffect,
  useState,
} from "react";

import {
  chat,
  getHealth,
  getProperties,
  searchKnowledge,
} from "./services/api";

import PropertyAI from "./components/PropertyAI";

import "./index.css";

type Property = {
  id: number;
  name?: string;
  title?: string;
  property_name?: string;

  developer?: string;
  brand?: string;

  country?: string;
  city?: string;
  location?: string;

  property_type?: string;
  investment_type?: string;

  price?: number | string;
  bedrooms?: number | string;
  area?: number | string;

  currency?: string;
};

type SearchResult = {
  document: string;
  metadata: {
    title?: string;
    source?: string;
    source_url?: string;
    document_type?: string;
    property_name?: string;
    developer?: string;
    brand?: string;
    country?: string;
    city?: string;
    location?: string;
    property_type?: string;
    investment_type?: string;
    price?: string;
    bedrooms?: string;
    area?: string;
  };
};

type Message = {
  role: "user" | "assistant";
  content: string;
  results?: SearchResult[];
};

function getPropertyName(property: Property): string {
  return (
    property.property_name ||
    property.name ||
    property.title ||
    `Property #${property.id}`
  );
}

function formatValue(
  value: number | string | undefined,
  currency?: string,
): string {
  if (value === undefined || value === null || value === "") {
    return "-";
  }

  if (typeof value === "number") {
    return `${currency || ""}${value.toLocaleString()}`;
  }

  return value;
}

function App() {
  const [backendStatus, setBackendStatus] =
    useState("Checking...");

  const [properties, setProperties] =
    useState<Property[]>([]);

  const [selectedPropertyId, setSelectedPropertyId] =
    useState<number | null>(null);

  const [propertiesLoading, setPropertiesLoading] =
    useState(true);

  const [propertiesError, setPropertiesError] =
    useState("");

  const [input, setInput] = useState("");

  const [messages, setMessages] =
    useState<Message[]>([
      {
        role: "assistant",
        content:
          "Select a property above to view its investment intelligence, or ask me a general real estate question.",
      },
    ]);

  const [loading, setLoading] =
    useState(false);

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * Backend health
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  useEffect(() => {
    getHealth()
      .then(() => setBackendStatus("Connected"))
      .catch(() => setBackendStatus("Offline"));
  }, []);

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * Load properties
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadProperties() {
      try {
        setPropertiesLoading(true);
        setPropertiesError("");

        const response = await getProperties();

        /*
         * Support either:
         *
         * [
         *   {...}
         * ]
         *
         * or:
         *
         * {
         *   properties: [...]
         * }
         */

        const items: Property[] =
          Array.isArray(response)
            ? response
            : response.properties || [];

        setProperties(items);

        if (items.length > 0) {
          setSelectedPropertyId(items[0].id);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);

        setPropertiesError(
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : "Unable to load properties.",
        );
      } finally {
        setPropertiesLoading(false);
      }
    }

    loadProperties();
  }, []);

  const selectedProperty =
    properties.find(
      (property) =>
        property.id === selectedPropertyId,
    ) || null;

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * General chat / knowledge search
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  async function handleSubmit(
    event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>,
  ) {
    event.preventDefault();

    const query = input.trim();

    if (!query || loading) {
      return;
    }

    setInput("");

    setMessages((current) => [
      ...current,
      {
        role: "user",
        content: query,
      },
    ]);

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      /*
       * Use the actual chat endpoint instead of
       * searchKnowledge().
       *
       * This allows the backend orchestrator to
       * understand the query.
       */

      const response = await chat(query);

      /*
       * Depending on your ChatResponse schema,
       * support common response fields.
       */

      const answer =
        response.answer ||
        response.message ||
        response.response ||
        "";

      const results: SearchResult[] =
        response.results || [];

        let content = answer;

        if (!content) {
        content =
            results.length > 0
            ? `I found ${results.length} relevant result${
                results.length === 1 ? "" : "s"
                }.`
            : "I couldn't find any relevant results.";
        }

        setMessages((current) => [
        ...current,
        {
            role: "assistant",
            content,
            results,
        },
        ]);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);

      /*
       * Fall back to knowledge search if the
       * general chat endpoint is unavailable.
       */

      try {
        const response =
          await searchKnowledge(query);

        const results: SearchResult[] =
          response.results || [];

        setMessages((current) => [
          ...current,
          {
            role: "assistant",
            content:
              results.length > 0
                ? `I found ${results.length} relevant result${
                    results.length === 1 ? "" : "s"
                  } in the knowledge base.`
                : "I couldn't find any relevant results in the knowledge base.",
            results,
          },
        ]);
      } catch (fallbackError) {
        console.error(fallbackError);

        setMessages((current) => [
          ...current,
          {
            role: "assistant",
            content:
              "I couldn't connect to the backend. Please make sure the API server is running.",
          },
        ]);
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * Render
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  return (

      {/* =====================================================

          <p>

          </p>
        </div>

          className={

              ? "status online"
              : "status"
          }
        >
          ● {backendStatus}

      </header>

      ===================================================== */}

          ================================================= */}

          <div className="property-selector">

            <div>
              <h2>
                Property Intelligence
              </h2>

              <p>
                Select a property to view its
                investment analysis.
              </p>
            </div>

            {propertiesLoading ? (
              <div className="property-loading">
                Loading properties...
              </div>
            ) : propertiesError ? (
              <div className="ai-error">
                {propertiesError}
              </div>
            ) : properties.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="property-loading">
                No properties found.
              </div>
            ) : (
              <select
                value={
                  selectedPropertyId ?? ""
                }
                onChange={(event) => {
                  const value =

                  setSelectedPropertyId(
                    value || null,
                  );
                }}
              >
                {properties.map(
                  (property) => (
                    <option
                      key={property.id}
                      value={property.id}
                    >
                      {getPropertyName(
                        property,
                      )}
                    </option>
                  ),
                )}
              </select>
            )}
          </div>


          {/* =================================================
              SELECTED PROPERTY
          ================================================= */}

          {selectedProperty && (

                  </span>

                  <h2>
                    {getPropertyName(
                      selectedProperty,
                    )}
                  </h2>

                  {(selectedProperty.city ||
                    selectedProperty.country ||
                    selectedProperty.location) && (

                        selectedProperty.city,
                        selectedProperty.country,
                      ]
                        .filter(Boolean)
                        .join(", ")}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                <span className="property-id">

const API_URL =
  import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000";

export async function getHealth() {
  const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/health`);

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error("Backend unavailable");
  }

  return response.json();
}

export async function getProperties(params = "") {
  const response = await fetch(
    `${API_URL}/api/properties${params}`
  );

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error("Unable to fetch properties");
  }

  return response.json();
}

export async function searchProperties(
  query: string,
  limit = 5
) {
  const response = await fetch(
    `${API_URL}/api/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(
      query
    )}&limit=${limit}`
  );

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error("Unable to search properties");
  }

  return response.json();
}

export async function searchKnowledge(
  query: string
) {
  const response = await fetch(
    `${API_URL}/api/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`
  );

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error("Unable to search knowledge base");
  }

  return response.json();
}

export async function chat(query: string) {
  const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/api/chat`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      message: query,
    }),
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error("Unable to connect to chat service");
  }

  return response.json();
}

export async function askPropertyAI(
  propertyId: number,
  query: string,
) {
  const response = await fetch(
    `${API_URL}/api/properties/${propertyId}/ai`,
    {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        query,
      }),
    },
  );

  if (!response.ok) {
    const message = await response.text();

    throw new Error(
      message || "Unable to analyze property."
    );
  }

  return response.json();
}

import type {
  PropertyAIResponse,
} from "../types/propertyAI";

export async function askPropertyAI(
  propertyId: number,
  query: string,
): Promise<PropertyAIResponse> {
  const response = await fetch(
    `/api/properties/${propertyId}/ai`,
    {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        query,
      }),
    },
  );

  if (!response.ok) {
    const message =
      await response.text();

    throw new Error(
      message ||
        "Unable to analyze property.",
    );
  }

  return response.json() as Promise<PropertyAIResponse>;
}


import React from "react";
import "./PropertyAIAnswer.css";

interface PropertyAIAnswerProps {
  answer: string;
}

type Sections = {
  Assessment?: string[];
  Why?: string[];
  "Main concerns"?: string[];
  Valuation?: string[];
  Confidence?: string[];
};

const SECTION_NAMES = [
  "Assessment",
  "Why",
  "Main concerns",
  "Valuation",
  "Confidence",
] as const;

function parseAnswer(answer: string): Sections {
  const sections: Sections = {};

  let currentSection:
    | keyof Sections
    | null = null;

  answer.split("\n").forEach((line) => {
    const trimmed = line.trim();

    const matchedSection = SECTION_NAMES.find(
      (section) => trimmed === `${section}:`
    );

    if (matchedSection) {
      currentSection = matchedSection;
      sections[matchedSection] = [];
      return;
    }

    if (currentSection && trimmed) {
      sections[currentSection]?.push(trimmed);
    }
  });

  return sections;
}

interface SectionProps {
  title: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

function Section({
  title,
  children,
}: SectionProps) {
  return (
    <section className="ai-answer-section">
      <h3>{title}</h3>
      {children}
    </section>
  );
}

interface LinesProps {
  lines?: string[];
}

function Lines({ lines }: LinesProps) {
  if (!lines?.length) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div>
      {lines.map((line, index) => {
        const isBullet = line.startsWith("- ");

        if (isBullet) {
          return (
            <div
              key={index}
              className="ai-answer-bullet"
            >
              {line.substring(2)}
            </div>
          );
        }

        return (
          <p key={index}>
            {line}
          </p>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function PropertyAIAnswer({
  answer,
}: PropertyAIAnswerProps) {
  if (!answer) {
    return null;
  }

  const sections = parseAnswer(answer);

  return (
    <div className="property-ai-answer">
      {sections.Assessment && (
        <Section title="Assessment">
          <Lines lines={sections.Assessment} />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections.Why && (
        <Section title="Why">
          <Lines lines={sections.Why} />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections["Main concerns"] && (
        <Section title="Main concerns">
          <Lines
            lines={sections["Main concerns"]}
          />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections.Valuation && (
        <Section title="Valuation">
          <Lines lines={sections.Valuation} />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections.Confidence && (
        <Section title="Confidence">
          <Lines
            lines={sections.Confidence}
          />
        </Section>
      )}

      <div className="ai-answer-disclaimer">
        This is an indicative analysis based on
        available property data and POC-generated
        intelligence. It is not financial advice or
        a professional property valuation.
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

interface ConversationMessage {

}

const SUGGESTED_QUESTIONS = [
"Is this property a good investment?",
"Why is this property a good or weak deal?",
"What are the main risks?",
"Is the asking price reasonable?",
"How does it compare with similar properties?",
];

function createMessage(
role: "user" | "assistant",
content: string,
): ConversationMessage {
return {
id: ${Date.now()}-${Math.random()},
role,
content,
};
}

propertyId,

ConversationMessage[]

useState(false);

useState("");

    Reset conversation whenever the selected

    useEffect(() => {

setInput("");

    useEffect(() => {

    async function sendQuestion(

      : "Unable to analyze property.";

  setError(message);

  setMessages((current) => [
    ...current,
    createMessage(
      "assistant",
      "I couldn't complete that analysis. Please try again.",
    ),
  ]);
} finally {
  setLoading(false);
}

}

async function handleSubmit(
event?: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>,
) {
event?.preventDefault();

await sendQuestion(input);

}

function handleKeyDown(
event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>,
) {
if (
event.key === "Enter" &&
!event.shiftKey
) {
event.preventDefault();

  void sendQuestion(input);
}

}

2. frontend/src/components/PropertyAIAnswer.tsx

I've made it backward-compatible: compact is optional, so the component can still be used elsewhere without breaking existing calls.

I also fixed an important parsing issue: if the backend ever returns plain text that doesn't contain Assessment:, Why:, etc., the old component would render essentially nothing. This version displays the raw answer in that case.
PropertyAIAnswer.tsx

import React from "react";

import "./PropertyAIAnswer.css";

interface PropertyAIAnswerProps {
answer: string;
compact?: boolean;
}

type Sections = {
Assessment?: string[];
Why?: string[];
"Main concerns"?: string[];
Valuation?: string[];
Confidence?: string[];
};

const SECTION_NAMES = [
"Assessment",
"Why",
"Main concerns",
"Valuation",
"Confidence",
] as const;

function parseAnswer(
answer: string,
): Sections {
const sections: Sections = {};

let currentSection:
| keyof Sections
| null = null;

answer
.split("\n")
.forEach((line) => {
const trimmed = line.trim();

  const matchedSection =
    SECTION_NAMES.find(
      (section) =>
        trimmed.toLowerCase() ===
        `${section}:`.toLowerCase(),
    );

  if (matchedSection) {
    currentSection =
      matchedSection;

    sections[matchedSection] = [];

    return;
  }

  if (
    currentSection &&
    trimmed
  ) {
    sections[currentSection]?.push(
      trimmed,
    );
  }
});

return sections;
}

interface SectionProps {
title: string;
children: React.ReactNode;
}

function Section({
title,
children,
}: SectionProps) {
return (
<section className="ai-answer-section">
<h3>{title}</h3>
{children}
</section>
);
}

interface LinesProps {
lines?: string[];
}

function Lines({
lines,
}: LinesProps) {
if (!lines?.length) {
return null;
}

return (
<div>
{lines.map(
(line, index) => {
const isBullet =
line.startsWith("- ") ||
line.startsWith("• ");

      if (isBullet) {
        return (
          <div
            key={index}
            className="ai-answer-bullet"
          >
            <span>
              •
            </span>

            <span>
              {line.substring(2)}
            </span>
          </div>
        );
      }

      return (
        <p key={index}>
          {line}
        </p>
      );
    },
  )}
</div>

);
}

export default function PropertyAIAnswer({
answer,
compact = false,
}: PropertyAIAnswerProps) {
if (!answer?.trim()) {
return null;
}

const sections =
parseAnswer(answer);

const hasSections =
Object.values(sections).some(
(section) =>
section &&
section.length > 0,
);

/*

    If the backend returns normal prose
    rather than the structured format, don't
    hide the answer.
    */
    if (!hasSections) {
    return ( <div className={`property-ai-answer ${ compact ? "compact" : "" }`} > <div className="ai-answer-plain-text"> {answer .split("\n") .filter(Boolean) .map( (line, index) => ( <p key={index}> {line} </p> ), )} </div> </div>

);

}

return (
<div
className={property-ai-answer ${ compact ? "compact" : "" }}
>

  {sections.Assessment && (
    <Section title="Assessment">
      <Lines
        lines={
          sections.Assessment
        }
      />
    </Section>
  )}

  {sections.Why && (
    <Section title="Why">
      <Lines
        lines={sections.Why}
      />
    </Section>
  )}

  {sections["Main concerns"] && (
    <Section title="Main concerns">
      <Lines
        lines={
          sections[
            "Main concerns"
          ]
        }
      />
    </Section>
  )}

  {sections.Valuation && (
    <Section title="Valuation">
      <Lines
        lines={
          sections.Valuation
        }
      />
    </Section>
  )}

  {sections.Confidence && (
    <Section title="Confidence">
      <Lines
        lines={
          sections.Confidence
        }
      />
    </Section>
  )}

  <div className="ai-answer-disclaimer">
    This is an indicative analysis based on
    available property data and POC-generated
    intelligence. It is not financial advice
    or a professional property valuation.
  </div>

</div>

);
}
3. frontend/src/services/propertyAI.ts

Keep this as the only askPropertyAI() implementation.

There is one thing I would change from your version: use the same VITE_API_URL mechanism as api.ts. Otherwise, when your frontend is configured to talk to a backend other than the Vite-origin /api, property AI will behave differently from the rest of the application.
propertyAI.ts

import type {
PropertyAIResponse,
} from "../types/propertyAI";

const API_URL =
import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL ||
"http://localhost:8000";

export async function askPropertyAI(
propertyId: number,
query: string,
): Promise<PropertyAIResponse> {
const response = await fetch(
${API_URL}/api/properties/${propertyId}/ai,
{
method: "POST",
headers: {
"Content-Type": "application/json",
},
body: JSON.stringify({
query,
}),
},
);

if (!response.ok) {
const message =
await response.text();

throw new Error(
  message ||
    "Unable to analyze property.",
);

}

return response.json() as Promise<PropertyAIResponse>;
}

One backend limitation

There is still an important distinction between conversation UI and conversation-aware AI.

Right now every request is:

{
  "query": "What are the main risks?"
}

to:

POST /api/properties/{propertyId}/ai

So the UI looks conversational, but the backend receives each question independently.

For the 3-day POC, that's acceptable. The selected propertyId keeps every request grounded to the same property.

Later, we can change the request to something like:

{
  "conversation_id": "...",
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "Is this property a good investment?"
    },
    {
      "role": "assistant",
      "content": "Assessment: Weak..."
    },
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "Why?"
    }
  ]
}

But I would not do that yet.

You currently have two askPropertyAI() functions. Keep only one. More importantly, the search response you showed has the property information inside:

result.metadata

For example:

{

}

Chat

1. Property type

Create something like:

export interface PropertyResult {
  document: string;
  metadata: {
    property_name?: string;
    developer?: string;
    brand?: string;
    country?: string;
    city?: string;
    location?: string;
    property_type?: string;
    investment_type?: string;
    description?: string;
    source_url?: string;
    price?: string;
    bedrooms?: string;
    area?: string;
  };
}

Then your search function can return:

export async function searchProperties(
  query: string,
  limit = 5
): Promise<{
  query: string;
  results: PropertyResult[];
}> {
  const response = await fetch(
    `${API_URL}/api/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}&limit=${limit}`
  );

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error("Unable to search properties");
  }

  return response.json();
}

2. Property result card

Instead of a dropdown, render each search result as a card.

interface PropertyCardProps {
  property: PropertyResult;
  onAsk: (property: PropertyResult) => void;
}

export function PropertyCard({
  property,
  onAsk,
}: PropertyCardProps) {
  const { metadata } = property;

  const propertyName =
    metadata.property_name ||
    metadata.title ||
    "Property opportunity";

  return (
    <div className="property-card">
      <div className="property-card-content">
        <h3>{propertyName}</h3>

        <div className="property-meta">
          {metadata.city && <span>{metadata.city}</span>}
          {metadata.country && <span>{metadata.country}</span>}
          {metadata.location && <span>{metadata.location}</span>}
        </div>

        {metadata.developer && (
          <p>
            <strong>Developer:</strong>{" "}
            {metadata.developer}
          </p>
        )}

        {metadata.brand && (
          <p>
            <strong>Brand:</strong>{" "}
            {metadata.brand}
          </p>
        )}

        {metadata.description && (
          <p className="property-description">
            {metadata.description}
          </p>
        )}

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onAsk(property)}
        >
          Ask about this property →
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

4. When "Ask about this property" is clicked

This is the key part.

Don't open a separate property dropdown.

Instead, show a contextual chat area:

  <PropertyAIChat
    property={selectedProperty}

For example:

function PropertyAIChat({
  property,
}: {
  property: PropertyResult;
}) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [answer, setAnswer] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  async function handleAsk() {
    if (!query.trim()) return;

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await askPropertyAI(
        property.id,
        query
      );

      setAnswer(response.answer);
    } catch (error) {
      setAnswer(
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : "Unable to analyze property."
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="property-ai-chat">
      <div className="property-ai-header">
        <div>
          <span>Property Intelligence</span>
          <h3>
            {property.metadata.property_name}
          </h3>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="property-ai-context">
        <span>
          {property.metadata.city}
        </span>

        <span>
          {property.metadata.location}
        </span>

        {property.metadata.brand && (
          <span>
            {property.metadata.brand}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="property-ai-input">
        <input
          value={query}
          onChange={(e) =>
            setQuery(e.target.value)
          }
          placeholder="Ask about this property..."
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === "Enter") {
              handleAsk();
            }
          }}
        />

        <button
          onClick={handleAsk}
          disabled={loading}
        >
          {loading ? "Analyzing..." : "Ask"}
        </button>
      </div>

      {answer && (
        <PropertyAIAnswer answer={answer} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

There is one thing to fix here based on your current API: your /api/search result doesn't currently show an id. So don't use property.id unless your backend actually returns one.

You have two good options.

    "brand": "Marriott",
    "country": "Oman",
    "city": "Muscat",
    "location": "AIDA"

}

Then:

works naturally.

import {
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useState,
} from "react";

import {
  getHealth,
  getProperties,
} from "./services/api";

import PropertyAI from "./components/PropertyAI";

import "./index.css";

interface Property {
  id: number;

  name?: string;
  title?: string;
  property_name?: string;

  developer?: string;
  brand?: string;

  source?: string;

  country?: string;
  city?: string;
  location?: string;

  property_type?: string;

  price?: number | string;
  currency?: string;

  bedrooms?: number | string;
  bathrooms?: number | string;

  area?: number | string;
  area_unit?: string;
}

function getPropertyName(
  property: Property,
): string {
  return (
    property.property_name ||
    property.name ||
    property.title ||
    `Property #${property.id}`
  );
}

function formatPrice(
  property: Property,
): string {
  if (
    property.price === undefined ||
    property.price === null ||
    property.price === ""
  ) {
    return "Price unavailable";
  }

  return `${property.currency || ""} ${Number(
    property.price,
  ).toLocaleString()}`;
}

export default function App() {
  const [
    backendStatus,
    setBackendStatus,
  ] = useState("Checking...");

  const [
    properties,
    setProperties,
  ] = useState<Property[]>([]);

  const [
    selectedPropertyId,
    setSelectedPropertyId,
  ] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const [
    propertiesLoading,
    setPropertiesLoading,
  ] = useState(true);

  const [
    propertiesError,
    setPropertiesError,
  ] = useState("");

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * Backend health
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  useEffect(() => {
    getHealth()
      .then(() => {
        setBackendStatus("Connected");
      })
      .catch(() => {
        setBackendStatus("Offline");
      });
  }, []);

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * Load properties
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadProperties() {
      try {
        setPropertiesLoading(true);
        setPropertiesError("");

        const response =
          await getProperties();

        const items: Property[] =
          Array.isArray(response)
            ? response
            : response.properties || [];

        setProperties(items);

        if (items.length > 0) {
          setSelectedPropertyId(
            items[0].id,
          );
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);

        setPropertiesError(
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : "Unable to load properties.",
        );
      } finally {
        setPropertiesLoading(false);
      }
    }

    loadProperties();
  }, []);

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * Selected property
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  const selectedProperty =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        properties.find(
          (property) =>
            property.id ===
            selectedPropertyId,
        ) || null,
      [
        properties,
        selectedPropertyId,
      ],
    );

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * Property change
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  function handlePropertyChange(
    propertyId: number,
  ) {
    setSelectedPropertyId(
      propertyId,
    );
  }

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * UI
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  return (
    <div className="app">

      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}
      {/* Header                                             */}
      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}

      <header className="header">

        <div>
          <h1>
            Property Intelligence
          </h1>

          <p>
            AI-powered real estate research
          </p>
        </div>

        <div
          className={
            backendStatus === "Connected"
              ? "status online"
              : "status"
          }
        >
          <span className="status-dot">
            ●
          </span>

          {backendStatus}
        </div>

      </header>

      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}
      {/* Main                                               */}
      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}

      <main className="chat-page">

        <section className="chat-container">

          {/* ------------------------------------------------ */}
          {/* Chat header                                      */}
          {/* ------------------------------------------------ */}

          <div className="chat-header">

            <div>
              <h2>
                Real Estate Intelligence Assistant
              </h2>

              <p>
                Ask about properties, valuation,
                comparables, infrastructure, growth
                and investment risk.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="chat-sources">

              <span>
                DarGlobal
              </span>

              <span>
                Wasalt
              </span>

            </div>

          </div>

          {/* ------------------------------------------------ */}
          {/* Property context                                 */}
          {/* ------------------------------------------------ */}

          <div className="property-context">

            <div className="property-context-label">
              PROPERTY CONTEXT
            </div>

            {propertiesLoading ? (
              <div className="property-context-loading">
                Loading properties...
              </div>
            ) : propertiesError ? (
              <div className="property-context-error">
                {propertiesError}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="property-context-row">

                <select
                  value={
                    selectedPropertyId ?? ""
                  }
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    handlePropertyChange(
                      Number(
                        event.target.value,
                      ),
                    )
                  }
                >
                  {properties.map(
                    (property) => (
                      <option
                        key={property.id}
                        value={property.id}
                      >
                        {getPropertyName(
                          property,
                        )}
                        {property.city
                          ? ` | ${property.city}`
                          : ""}
                        {property.source
                          ? ` | ${property.source}`
                          : ""}
                      </option>
                    ),
                  )}
                </select>

              </div>
            )}

          </div>

          {/* ------------------------------------------------ */}
          {/* Selected property summary                        */}
          {/* ------------------------------------------------ */}

          {selectedProperty && (
            <div className="selected-property">

              <div className="selected-property-main">

                <div className="selected-property-title">

                  <span>
                    SELECTED PROPERTY
                  </span>

                  <h3>
                    {getPropertyName(
                      selectedProperty,
                    )}
                  </h3>

                  <p>
                    {[
                      selectedProperty.location,
                      selectedProperty.city,
                      selectedProperty.country,
                    ]
                      .filter(Boolean)
                      .join(", ")}
                  </p>

                </div>

                <div className="selected-property-source">
                  {selectedProperty.source ||
                    "Property"}
                </div>

              </div>

              <div className="property-summary-grid">

                <div>
                  <span>
                    Developer
                  </span>

                  <strong>
                    {selectedProperty.developer ||
                      "-"}
                  </strong>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <span>
                    Type
                  </span>

                  <strong>
                    {selectedProperty.property_type ||
                      "-"}
                  </strong>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <span>
                    Price
                  </span>

                  <strong>
                    {formatPrice(
                      selectedProperty,
                    )}
                  </strong>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <span>
                    Bedrooms
                  </span>

                  <strong>
                    {selectedProperty.bedrooms ||
                      "-"}
                  </strong>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <span>
                    Area
                  </span>

                  <strong>
                    {selectedProperty.area
                      ? `${selectedProperty.area} ${

                        }`
                      : "-"}
                  </strong>

          )}

          {/* ------------------------------------------------ */}

          {/* ------------------------------------------------ */}

          <PropertyAI
            propertyId={

            }
            propertyName={

                ? getPropertyName(
                    selectedProperty,
                  )
                : undefined
            }
          />

        </section>

      </main>

    </div>
  );
