2. PropertyAI.tsx

This is the more important change.

Instead of:

textarea
Ask AI
answer

we'll make it a conversation component.

Replace:

frontend/src/components/PropertyAI.tsx

with:

import {
  FormEvent,
  KeyboardEvent,
  useEffect,
  useRef,
  useState,
} from "react";

import PropertyAIAnswer from "./PropertyAIAnswer";

import {
  askPropertyAI,
} from "../services/propertyAI";

interface PropertyAIProps {
  propertyId: number | null;
  propertyName?: string;
}

interface ConversationMessage {
  id: string;

  role:
    | "user"
    | "assistant";

  content: string;

  model?: string;
}

const DEFAULT_PROMPT =
  "Is this property a good investment and what are the main concerns?";

const SUGGESTED_QUESTIONS = [
  "Is this property a good investment?",
  "Why is this property a good or weak deal?",
  "What are the main risks?",
  "How does the valuation compare with the asking price?",
  "How does this property compare with similar properties?",
];

export default function PropertyAI({
  propertyId,
  propertyName,
}: PropertyAIProps) {

  const [
    input,
    setInput,
  ] = useState("");

  const [
    messages,
    setMessages,
  ] = useState<
    ConversationMessage[]
  >([]);

  const [
    loading,
    setLoading,
  ] = useState(false);

  const [
    error,
    setError,
  ] = useState("");

  const messagesEndRef =
    useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(
      null,
    );

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * Reset conversation when property changes
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  useEffect(() => {

    setMessages([
      {
        id: crypto.randomUUID(),

        role: "assistant",

        content: propertyName
          ? `I’m ready to analyze ${propertyName}. You can ask me about its valuation, comparable properties, growth potential, infrastructure, risks, or whether it looks like a good deal.`
          : "Select a property and ask me about its investment intelligence.",
      },
    ]);

    setInput("");
    setError("");

  }, [
    propertyId,
    propertyName,
  ]);

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * Scroll conversation
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  useEffect(() => {

    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({
      behavior: "smooth",
    });

  }, [messages, loading]);

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * Submit
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  async function handleSubmit(
    event?: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>,
  ) {

    event?.preventDefault();

    const query =
      input.trim();

    if (
      !query ||
      loading ||
      propertyId === null
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const userMessage: ConversationMessage = {
      id: crypto.randomUUID(),

      role: "user",

      content: query,
    };

    setMessages(
      (current) => [
        ...current,
        userMessage,
      ],
    );

    setInput("");
    setError("");
    setLoading(true);

    try {

      const response =
        await askPropertyAI(
          propertyId,
          query,
        );

      const assistantMessage:
        ConversationMessage = {
        id: crypto.randomUUID(),

        role: "assistant",

        content:
          response.answer,

        model:
          response.model,
      };

      setMessages(
        (current) => [
          ...current,
          assistantMessage,
        ],
      );

    } catch (error) {

      console.error(error);

      setError(
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : "Unable to analyze property.",
      );

      setMessages(
        (current) => [
          ...current,
          {
            id: crypto.randomUUID(),

            role: "assistant",

            content:
              "I couldn't complete the property analysis. Please try again.",
          },
        ],
      );

    } finally {

      setLoading(false);

    }
  }

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * Enter key
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  function handleKeyDown(
    event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>,
  ) {

    if (
      event.key === "Enter" &&
      !event.shiftKey
    ) {

      event.preventDefault();

      void handleSubmit();

    }
  }

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * Suggested question
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  function askSuggestedQuestion(
    question: string,
  ) {

    if (loading) {
      return;
    }

    setInput(question);

    setTimeout(() => {
      void handleSubmit();
    }, 0);
  }

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * Clear conversation
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  function clearConversation() {

    setMessages([
      {
        id: crypto.randomUUID(),

        role: "assistant",

        content: propertyName
          ? `Conversation cleared. What would you like to know about ${propertyName}?`
          : "Conversation cleared. Select a property to begin.",
      },
    ]);

    setError("");

  }

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * Render
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  return (
    <div className="property-ai-chat">

      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}
      {/* Chat title                                         */}
      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}

      <div className="property-ai-chat-header">

        <div>

          <div className="property-ai-title-row">

            <div className="ai-avatar">
              AI
            </div>

            <div>
              <h2>
                Property Intelligence
              </h2>

              <p>
                Ask questions about this property
              </p>
            </div>

          </div>

        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          className="clear-chat-button"
          onClick={
            clearConversation
          }
          disabled={loading}
        >
          Clear
        </button>

      </div>

      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}
      {/* Active context                                     */}
      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}

      {propertyName && (
        <div className="ai-property-context">

          <span className="context-icon">
            ◆
          </span>

          <div>

            <span>
              ANALYZING PROPERTY
            </span>

            <strong>
              {propertyName}
            </strong>

          </div>

        </div>
      )}

      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}
      {/* Conversation                                      */}
      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}

      <div className="ai-conversation">

        {messages.map(
          (message) => (

            <div
              key={message.id}
              className={`ai-message-row ${message.role}`}
            >

              <div
                className={`ai-message-avatar ${message.role}`}
              >
                {message.role ===
                "assistant"
                  ? "AI"
                  : "You"}
              </div>

              <div className="ai-message-body">

                <div className="ai-message-label">
                  {message.role ===
                  "assistant"
                    ? "Property Intelligence"
                    : "You"}
                </div>

                <div className="ai-message-bubble">

                  {message.role ===
                  "assistant" ? (
                    <PropertyAIAnswer
                      answer={
                        message.content
                      }
                      compact
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <p>
                      {message.content}
                    </p>
                  )}

                </div>

                {message.model && (
                  <div className="ai-message-meta">
                    Powered by local AI
                  </div>
                )}

              </div>

            </div>

          ),
        )}

        {/* ------------------------------------------------ */}
        {/* Loading                                         */}
        {/* ------------------------------------------------ */}

        {loading && (
          <div className="ai-message-row assistant">

            <div className="ai-message-avatar assistant">
              AI
            </div>

            <div className="ai-message-body">

              <div className="ai-message-label">
                Property Intelligence
              </div>

              <div className="ai-message-bubble ai-loading">

                <span />
                <span />
                <span />

                <em>
                  Analyzing property intelligence...
                </em>

              </div>

            </div>

          </div>
        )}

        <div
          ref={
            messagesEndRef
          }
        />

      </div>

      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}
      {/* Suggested questions                                */}
      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}

      {!loading &&
        messages.length <= 1 && (
          <div className="ai-suggestions">

            <span>
              Try asking
            </span>

            <div>

              {SUGGESTED_QUESTIONS
                .slice(0, 4)
                .map(
                  (question) => (
                    <button
                      key={question}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() =>
                        askSuggestedQuestion(
                          question,
                        )
                      }
                    >
                      {question}
                    </button>
                  ),
                )}

            </div>

          </div>
        )}

      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}
      {/* Error                                             */}
      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}

      {error && (
        <div className="ai-error">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}
      {/* Composer                                           */}
      {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}

      <form
        className="ai-composer"
        onSubmit={handleSubmit}
      >

        <textarea
          value={input}
          onChange={(event) =>
            setInput(
              event.target.value,
            )
          }
          onKeyDown={
            handleKeyDown
          }
          disabled={
            loading ||
            propertyId === null
          }
          rows={2}
          placeholder={
            propertyId === null
              ? "Select a property to ask questions..."
              : "Ask about valuation, comparables, growth, infrastructure, risks..."
          }
        />

        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={
            loading ||
            !input.trim() ||
            propertyId === null
          }
          aria-label="Send"
        >
          {loading
            ? "..."
            : "➤"}
        </button>

      </form>

      <div className="ai-composer-hint">
        Press Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
      </div>

    </div>
  );
}
3. Important: one small change to PropertyAIAnswer.tsx

Your existing PropertyAIAnswer currently renders a full set of cards and expects:

<PropertyAIAnswer
  answer={response.answer}
  model={response.model}
  guardrails={response.guardrails}
/>

from the previous version.

For the conversational UI, I recommend adding a compact property.

Change:

interface PropertyAIAnswerProps {
  answer: string;
  model: string;
  guardrails: PropertyAIGuardrails;
}

to:

interface PropertyAIAnswerProps {
  answer: string;

  model?: string;

  guardrails?: PropertyAIGuardrails;

  compact?: boolean;
}

And component:

export default function PropertyAIAnswer({
  answer,
  model,
  guardrails,
  compact = false,
}: PropertyAIAnswerProps) {

Then you can make the existing sections slightly smaller when:

compact === true

However, if you don't want to modify this file yet, remove:

compact

from the call in PropertyAI.tsx.

For the 3-day POC, I actually recommend keeping the existing answer parser and simply making the CSS compact.

4. Why I recommend this design

Your product is not really:

"Property Details + AI Investment Analysis + Chat"

It is becoming:

"AI Real Estate Intelligence Assistant"

with property context.

That distinction matters.

The conversation becomes:

User
 │
 │ Selects Marriott Residences Oman
 ▼
Property Context
 │
 ▼
AI Assistant
 │
 ├── Valuation Engine
 ├── Comparable Engine
 ├── Growth Engine
 ├── Risk Engine
 ├── Infrastructure Engine
 ├── Location Intelligence
 ├── Deal Engine
 └── Personalization
 │
 ▼
Answer

The attached architecture already separates deterministic intelligence from AI explanation, so this UI is just exposing that architecture conversationally rather than creating another analysis screen.

5. Even better: property context should persist

I strongly recommend this behavior:

User selects:
Marriott Residences Oman

Chat shows:

Analyzing property:
Marriott Residences Oman

Then:

User

Is this a good investment?

AI

Assessment: Weak...

Then user:

Why?

The frontend should not require the user to repeat the property name.

Then:

What about valuation?

Then:

Compare it with similar properties.

Then:

What are the biggest risks?

This is where the chatbot becomes substantially more valuable than a normal real-estate search UI.

6. One limitation we should recognize now

Your current askPropertyAI() API sends only:

{
  "query": "Is this property a good investment?"
}

while the property ID is in the URL:

POST /api/properties/{propertyId}/ai

That's enough for property-scoped conversation.

But it doesn't yet send previous conversation history.

For the 3-day POC, I recommend NOT changing the backend yet.

Instead:

Conversation UI
       │
       ├── Q1 → property analysis
       ├── Q2 → property analysis
       ├── Q3 → property analysis
       └── Q4 → property analysis

Each question is grounded against the same selected property.

That's sufficient to demonstrate conversational behavior.

Later we can add:

conversation_id
messages[]

but don't burn time on that now.

7. One thing I would change from your screenshot

Currently you have:

AI Investment Analysis

[Ask AI]

Instead:

One screen. One context. One conversation.

8. I would also keep the property selector

Don't remove it.

It should be the context switcher:

PROPERTY CONTEXT

[ Marriott Residences Oman | DarGlobal ▼ ]

When the user changes it:

Marriott Residences Oman
        ↓
Dubai Hills Estate
        ↓
conversation resets
        ↓
new property context

This is much cleaner than having a separate "Property Intelligence" section.

9. Final POC structure

After this UI change, your product flow becomes:

                    PROPERTY INTELLIGENCE
                           │
                           ▼
                ┌─────────────────────┐
                │ Property Selector    │
                │ DarGlobal / Wasalt   │
                └──────────┬──────────┘
                           │
                           ▼
                  Selected Property
                           │
                           ▼
              ┌─────────────────────────┐
              │   CONVERSATIONAL AI     │
              │                         │
              │ "Is it a good deal?"    │
              │                         │
              │ "Why?"                 │
              │                         │
              │ "Main risks?"          │
              │                         │
              │ "Compare properties?"  │
              └────────────┬────────────┘
                           │
                           ▼
                    AI ORCHESTRATOR
                           │
        ┌──────────────────┼─────────────────┐
        ▼                  ▼                 ▼
   Intelligence        Retrieval          Ollama
     Engines             / DB
        │                  │                 │
        └──────────────────┼─────────────────┘
                           ▼
                       Guardrails
                           │
                           ▼
                    Conversational
                       Response

This is the direction I would take for the remaining 3-day POC.

Do not add another dashboard, another analysis page, or another AI panel. The chat itself should become the front door to Location Intelligence, Infrastructure, Comparables, Valuation, Growth, Risk, Personalization and Deal Intelligence.

The existing project plan also explicitly calls for keeping the POC scope frozen and avoiding unnecessary production complexity.

One caveat before you paste the code

The PropertyAI.tsx above assumes your current backend response and PropertyAIAnswer integration from the attached project history. Your existing API service is already calling the property-scoped endpoint and returning PropertyAIResponse.

So first implement only these two files:

frontend/src/App.tsx
frontend/src/components/PropertyAI.tsx

Do not change the backend.

Then run:

cd ~/real-estate-ai-poc/frontend
npm run build

If TypeScript reports the expected PropertyAIAnswer prop mismatch because of the existing component signature, we'll make the small PropertyAIAnswer.tsx compatibility change next rather than restructuring the frontend again.

import {
  useState,
} from "react";

import PropertyAIAnswer from "./PropertyAIAnswer";

import {
  askPropertyAI,
} from "../services/propertyAI";

interface PropertyAIProps {
  propertyId: number;
}

export default function PropertyAI({
  propertyId,
}: PropertyAIProps) {
  const [
    query,
    setQuery,
  ] = useState(
    "Is this property a good investment and what are the main concerns?",
  );

  const [
    answer,
    setAnswer,
  ] = useState("");

  const [
    loading,
    setLoading,
  ] = useState(false);

  const [
    error,
    setError,
  ] = useState("");

  async function handleAsk() {
    if (!query.trim()) {
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      const response =
        await askPropertyAI(
          propertyId,
          query,
        );

      setAnswer(response.answer);

    } catch (error) {
      setError(
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : "Unable to analyze property.",
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="property-ai">
      <h2>
        AI Investment Analysis
      </h2>

      <textarea
        value={query}
        onChange={(event) =>
          setQuery(event.target.value)
        }
        rows={4}
        placeholder="Ask about this property..."
      />

      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={handleAsk}
        disabled={
          loading ||
          !query.trim()
        }
      >
        {loading
          ? "Analyzing..."
          : "Ask AI"}
      </button>

      {error && (
        <div className="ai-error">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {answer && (
        <PropertyAIAnswer
          answer={answer}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import {
  FormEvent,
  useEffect,
  useState,
} from "react";

import {
  chat,
  getHealth,
  getProperties,
  searchKnowledge,
} from "./services/api";

import PropertyAI from "./components/PropertyAI";

import "./index.css";

type Property = {
  id: number;
  name?: string;
  title?: string;
  property_name?: string;

  developer?: string;
  brand?: string;

  country?: string;
  city?: string;
  location?: string;

  property_type?: string;
  investment_type?: string;

  price?: number | string;
  bedrooms?: number | string;
  area?: number | string;

  currency?: string;
};

type SearchResult = {
  document: string;
  metadata: {
    title?: string;
    source?: string;
    source_url?: string;
    document_type?: string;
    property_name?: string;
    developer?: string;
    brand?: string;
    country?: string;
    city?: string;
    location?: string;
    property_type?: string;
    investment_type?: string;
    price?: string;
    bedrooms?: string;
    area?: string;
  };
};

type Message = {
  role: "user" | "assistant";
  content: string;
  results?: SearchResult[];
};

function getPropertyName(property: Property): string {
  return (
    property.property_name ||
    property.name ||
    property.title ||
    `Property #${property.id}`
  );
}

function formatValue(
  value: number | string | undefined,
  currency?: string,
): string {
  if (value === undefined || value === null || value === "") {
    return "-";
  }

  if (typeof value === "number") {
    return `${currency || ""}${value.toLocaleString()}`;
  }

  return value;
}

function App() {
  const [backendStatus, setBackendStatus] =
    useState("Checking...");

  const [properties, setProperties] =
    useState<Property[]>([]);

  const [selectedPropertyId, setSelectedPropertyId] =
    useState<number | null>(null);

  const [propertiesLoading, setPropertiesLoading] =
    useState(true);

  const [propertiesError, setPropertiesError] =
    useState("");

  const [input, setInput] = useState("");

  const [messages, setMessages] =
    useState<Message[]>([
      {
        role: "assistant",
        content:
          "Select a property above to view its investment intelligence, or ask me a general real estate question.",
      },
    ]);

  const [loading, setLoading] =
    useState(false);

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * Backend health
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  useEffect(() => {
    getHealth()
      .then(() => setBackendStatus("Connected"))
      .catch(() => setBackendStatus("Offline"));
  }, []);

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * Load properties
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadProperties() {
      try {
        setPropertiesLoading(true);
        setPropertiesError("");

        const response = await getProperties();

        /*
         * Support either:
         *
         * [
         *   {...}
         * ]
         *
         * or:
         *
         * {
         *   properties: [...]
         * }
         */

        const items: Property[] =
          Array.isArray(response)
            ? response
            : response.properties || [];

        setProperties(items);

        if (items.length > 0) {
          setSelectedPropertyId(items[0].id);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);

        setPropertiesError(
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : "Unable to load properties.",
        );
      } finally {
        setPropertiesLoading(false);
      }
    }

    loadProperties();
  }, []);

  const selectedProperty =
    properties.find(
      (property) =>
        property.id === selectedPropertyId,
    ) || null;

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * General chat / knowledge search
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  async function handleSubmit(
    event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>,
  ) {
    event.preventDefault();

    const query = input.trim();

    if (!query || loading) {
      return;
    }

    setInput("");

    setMessages((current) => [
      ...current,
      {
        role: "user",
        content: query,
      },
    ]);

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      /*
       * Use the actual chat endpoint instead of
       * searchKnowledge().
       *
       * This allows the backend orchestrator to
       * understand the query.
       */

      const response = await chat(query);

      /*
       * Depending on your ChatResponse schema,
       * support common response fields.
       */

      const answer =
        response.answer ||
        response.message ||
        response.response ||
        "";

      const results: SearchResult[] =
        response.results || [];

        let content = answer;

        if (!content) {
        content =
            results.length > 0
            ? `I found ${results.length} relevant result${
                results.length === 1 ? "" : "s"
                }.`
            : "I couldn't find any relevant results.";
        }

        setMessages((current) => [
        ...current,
        {
            role: "assistant",
            content,
            results,
        },
        ]);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);

      /*
       * Fall back to knowledge search if the
       * general chat endpoint is unavailable.
       */

      try {
        const response =
          await searchKnowledge(query);

        const results: SearchResult[] =
          response.results || [];

        setMessages((current) => [
          ...current,
          {
            role: "assistant",
            content:
              results.length > 0
                ? `I found ${results.length} relevant result${
                    results.length === 1 ? "" : "s"
                  } in the knowledge base.`
                : "I couldn't find any relevant results in the knowledge base.",
            results,
          },
        ]);
      } catch (fallbackError) {
        console.error(fallbackError);

        setMessages((current) => [
          ...current,
          {
            role: "assistant",
            content:
              "I couldn't connect to the backend. Please make sure the API server is running.",
          },
        ]);
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  /*
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   * Render
   * ---------------------------------------------------------
   */

  return (
    <div className="app">

      {/* =====================================================
          HEADER
      ===================================================== */}

      <header className="header">
        <div>
          <h1>Property Intelligence</h1>

          <p>
            AI-powered real estate research
          </p>
        </div>

        <span
          className={
            backendStatus === "Connected"
              ? "status online"
              : "status"
          }
        >
          ● {backendStatus}
        </span>
      </header>


      {/* =====================================================
          MAIN
      ===================================================== */}

      <main className="chat-page">

        <section className="chat-container">

          {/* =================================================
              PROPERTY SELECTOR
          ================================================= */}

          <div className="property-selector">

            <div>
              <h2>
                Property Intelligence
              </h2>

              <p>
                Select a property to view its
                investment analysis.
              </p>
            </div>

            {propertiesLoading ? (
              <div className="property-loading">
                Loading properties...
              </div>
            ) : propertiesError ? (
              <div className="ai-error">
                {propertiesError}
              </div>
            ) : properties.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="property-loading">
                No properties found.
              </div>
            ) : (
              <select
                value={
                  selectedPropertyId ?? ""
                }
                onChange={(event) => {
                  const value =
                    Number(event.target.value);

                  setSelectedPropertyId(
                    value || null,
                  );
                }}
              >
                {properties.map(
                  (property) => (
                    <option
                      key={property.id}
                      value={property.id}
                    >
                      {getPropertyName(
                        property,
                      )}
                    </option>
                  ),
                )}
              </select>
            )}
          </div>


          {/* =================================================
              SELECTED PROPERTY
          ================================================= */}

          {selectedProperty && (
            <section className="property-panel">

              <div className="property-panel-header">

                <div>
                  <span className="property-label">
                    SELECTED PROPERTY
                  </span>

                  <h2>
                    {getPropertyName(
                      selectedProperty,
                    )}
                  </h2>

                  {(selectedProperty.city ||
                    selectedProperty.country ||
                    selectedProperty.location) && (
                    <p>
                      {[
                        selectedProperty.location,
                        selectedProperty.city,
                        selectedProperty.country,
                      ]
                        .filter(Boolean)
                        .join(", ")}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                <span className="property-id">
                  ID #{selectedProperty.id}
                </span>

              </div>


              <div className="property-metadata">

                {selectedProperty.developer && (
                  <div>
                    <span>
                      Developer
                    </span>

                    <strong>
                      {
                        selectedProperty.developer
                      }
                    </strong>
                  </div>
                )}

                {selectedProperty.brand && (
                  <div>
                    <span>
                      Brand
                    </span>

                    <strong>
                      {
                        selectedProperty.brand
                      }
                    </strong>
                  </div>
                )}

                {selectedProperty.property_type && (
                  <div>
                    <span>
                      Property Type
                    </span>

                    <strong>
                      {
                        selectedProperty.property_type
                      }
                    </strong>
                  </div>
                )}

                {selectedProperty.investment_type && (
                  <div>
                    <span>
                      Investment Type
                    </span>

                    <strong>
                      {
                        selectedProperty.investment_type
                      }
                    </strong>
                  </div>
                )}

                {selectedProperty.price !==
                  undefined && (
                  <div>
                    <span>
                      Price
                    </span>

                    <strong>
                      {formatValue(
                        selectedProperty.price,
                        selectedProperty.currency,
                      )}
                    </strong>
                  </div>
                )}

                {selectedProperty.bedrooms !==
                  undefined && (
                  <div>
                    <span>
                      Bedrooms
                    </span>

                    <strong>
                      {
                        selectedProperty.bedrooms
                      }
                    </strong>
                  </div>
                )}

                {selectedProperty.area !==
                  undefined && (
                  <div>
                    <span>
                      Area
                    </span>

                    <strong>
                      {formatValue(
                        selectedProperty.area,
                      )}
                    </strong>
                  </div>
                )}

              </div>


              {/* =============================================
                  PROPERTY AI
              ============================================= */}

              <PropertyAI
                propertyId={
                  selectedProperty.id
                }
              />

            </section>
          )}


          {/* =================================================
              GENERAL CHAT
          ================================================= */}

          <div className="chat-header">

                Real Estate Assistant
              </h2>

              <p>
                Ask questions about properties,
                projects, locations, brands,
                or the real estate market.

              <span>
                DarGlobal
              </span>

              <span>
                Wasalt
              </span>
            </div>

          </div>


          {/* =================================================
              MESSAGES
          ================================================= */}

          <div className="messages">

            {messages.map(
              (message, index) => (
                <div
                  key={index}
                  className={`message-row ${message.role}`}
                >

                  <div className="avatar">
                    {message.role ===
                    "assistant"
                      ? "AI"
                      : "You"}
                  </div>

                  <div className="message-content">

                    <div className="message-bubble">
                      {message.content}
                    </div>


                    {message.results &&
                      message.results.length >

                          {message.results.map(

                                  }

                                        {

                                        }
                                      </span>
                                    )}

                                  </div>


                                  <h3>
                                    {metadata.property_name ||

                                      "Property information"}

                                  {(metadata.city ||

                                      {[

                                        metadata.city,
                                        metadata.country,
                                      ]
                                        .filter(Boolean)
                                        .join(
                                          ", ",
                                        )}
                                    </p>
                                  )}


                                  <div className="result-metadata">

                                      }

                                      rel="noreferrer"
                                    >
                                      Open source →

                              );
                            },

            )}

                    <span />
                    <span />
                    <span />
                  </div>

                </div>

              </div>
            )}

          </div>

              CHAT INPUT
          ================================================= */}

          <form
            className="chat-input-area"
            onSubmit={handleSubmit}
          >

            <input
              value={input}
              onChange={(event) =>
                setInput(
                  event.target.value,

            AI analysis is based on available
            property and market intelligence.
            It is not financial advice or a
            professional property valuation.
          </p>

        </section>

      </main>

    </div>
  );

import React from "react";
import "./PropertyAIAnswer.css";

interface PropertyAIAnswerProps {
  answer: string;
}

type Sections = {
  Assessment?: string[];
  Why?: string[];
  "Main concerns"?: string[];
  Valuation?: string[];
  Confidence?: string[];
};

const SECTION_NAMES = [
  "Assessment",
  "Why",
  "Main concerns",
  "Valuation",
  "Confidence",
] as const;

function parseAnswer(answer: string): Sections {
  const sections: Sections = {};

  let currentSection:
    | keyof Sections
    | null = null;

  answer.split("\n").forEach((line) => {
    const trimmed = line.trim();

    const matchedSection = SECTION_NAMES.find(
      (section) => trimmed === `${section}:`
    );

    if (matchedSection) {
      currentSection = matchedSection;
      sections[matchedSection] = [];
      return;
    }

    if (currentSection && trimmed) {
      sections[currentSection]?.push(trimmed);
    }
  });

  return sections;
}

interface SectionProps {
  title: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

function Section({
  title,
  children,
}: SectionProps) {
  return (
    <section className="ai-answer-section">
      <h3>{title}</h3>
      {children}
    </section>
  );
}

interface LinesProps {
  lines?: string[];
}

function Lines({ lines }: LinesProps) {
  if (!lines?.length) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div>
      {lines.map((line, index) => {
        const isBullet = line.startsWith("- ");

        if (isBullet) {
          return (
            <div
              key={index}
              className="ai-answer-bullet"
            >
              {line.substring(2)}
            </div>
          );
        }

        return (
          <p key={index}>
            {line}
          </p>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function PropertyAIAnswer({
  answer,
}: PropertyAIAnswerProps) {
  if (!answer) {
    return null;
  }

  const sections = parseAnswer(answer);

  return (
    <div className="property-ai-answer">
      {sections.Assessment && (
        <Section title="Assessment">
          <Lines lines={sections.Assessment} />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections.Why && (
        <Section title="Why">
          <Lines lines={sections.Why} />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections["Main concerns"] && (
        <Section title="Main concerns">
          <Lines
            lines={sections["Main concerns"]}
          />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections.Valuation && (
        <Section title="Valuation">
          <Lines lines={sections.Valuation} />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections.Confidence && (
        <Section title="Confidence">
          <Lines
            lines={sections.Confidence}
          />
        </Section>
      )}

      <div className="ai-answer-disclaimer">
        This is an indicative analysis based on
        available property data and POC-generated
        intelligence. It is not financial advice or
        a professional property valuation.
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

}

function createMessage(
role: "user" | "assistant",
content: string,
): ConversationMessage {

id: ${Date.now()}-${Math.random()},
role,
content,
};
}

export default function PropertyAI({
propertyId,
propertyName,
}: PropertyAIProps) {

ConversationMessage[]

    ([]);

useState(false);

    Reset conversation whenever the selected

    Passing the question directly avoids the

    when setInput() and handleSubmit() are

    async function sendQuestion(
    question: string,
    ) {

  !query ||
  loading ||
  propertyId === null
) {
  return;

    await askPropertyAI(
      propertyId,

      answer,

  ]);

  console.error(requestError);

  const message =
    requestError instanceof Error
      ? requestError.message
      : "Unable to analyze property.";

  setError(message);

  setMessages((current) => [
    ...current,
    createMessage(
      "assistant",
      "I couldn't complete that analysis. Please try again.",
    ),
  ]);
} finally {
  setLoading(false);
}

}

import React from "react";

import "./PropertyAIAnswer.css";

interface PropertyAIAnswerProps {
answer: string;
compact?: boolean;
}

type Sections = {
Assessment?: string[];
Why?: string[];
"Main concerns"?: string[];
Valuation?: string[];
Confidence?: string[];
};

const SECTION_NAMES = [
"Assessment",
"Why",
"Main concerns",
"Valuation",
"Confidence",
] as const;

function parseAnswer(
answer: string,
): Sections {
const sections: Sections = {};

let currentSection:
| keyof Sections
| null = null;

answer
.split("\n")
.forEach((line) => {
const trimmed = line.trim();

  const matchedSection =
    SECTION_NAMES.find(
      (section) =>
        trimmed.toLowerCase() ===
        `${section}:`.toLowerCase(),
    );

  if (matchedSection) {
    currentSection =
      matchedSection;

    sections[matchedSection] = [];

    return;
  }

  if (
    currentSection &&
    trimmed
  ) {
    sections[currentSection]?.push(
      trimmed,
    );
  }
});

return sections;
}

}

children,
}: SectionProps) {

);

export default function PropertyAIAnswer({

section &&

    if (!hasSections) {

        }

The important part

When the user clicks:

activeProperty = property

PROPERTY CONTEXT

  Muscat, Oman · DarGlobal

    Is this property good to buy or any risk?

goes to:

POST /api/properties/{propertyId}/ai

That's exactly where your existing backend architecture becomes useful.
There is one backend/frontend change I recommend

Your current general search endpoint already does:

searchKnowledge(query)

and returns:

{
  results: [...]
}

So for:

    Please share me the property in Oman

we can initially use the existing /api/search endpoint.

The frontend can display the returned results as property cards.

Then each result gets:

Ask about this property →

The result's metadata needs to contain the property ID, though.

Currently your SearchResult metadata that you showed me has things like:

property_name
developer
city
country
price
bedrooms
area

but I haven't seen a property_id.

That's important.

Ideally the search response should contain:

{
  "document": "...",
  "metadata": {
    "property_id": 123,
    "property_name": "Marriott Residences Oman",
    "developer": "DarGlobal",
    "country": "Oman",
    "city": "Muscat",
    "price": 1100000,
    "currency": "USD"
  }
}

Then the frontend can do:

function handlePropertyContext(
  property: SearchResult
) {
  setActiveProperty({
    id: property.metadata.property_id,
    name: property.metadata.property_name,
    ...
  });
}

and the next question naturally becomes property-scoped.

export async function searchProperties(

2. Property result card

Instead of a dropdown, render each search result as a card.

interface PropertyCardProps {
  property: PropertyResult;
  onAsk: (property: PropertyResult) => void;
}

export function PropertyCard({
  property,
  onAsk,
}: PropertyCardProps) {
  const { metadata } = property;

  const propertyName =
    metadata.property_name ||
    metadata.title ||
    "Property opportunity";

  return (
    <div className="property-card">
      <div className="property-card-content">
        <h3>{propertyName}</h3>

        <div className="property-meta">
          {metadata.city && <span>{metadata.city}</span>}
          {metadata.country && <span>{metadata.country}</span>}
          {metadata.location && <span>{metadata.location}</span>}
        </div>

        {metadata.developer && (
          <p>
            <strong>Developer:</strong>{" "}
            {metadata.developer}
          </p>
        )}

        {metadata.brand && (
          <p>
            <strong>Brand:</strong>{" "}
            {metadata.brand}
          </p>
        )}

        {metadata.description && (
          <p className="property-description">
            {metadata.description}
          </p>
        )}

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onAsk(property)}
        >
          Ask about this property →
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

4. When "Ask about this property" is clicked

This is the key part.

Don't open a separate property dropdown.

Instead, show a contextual chat area:

{selectedProperty && (
  <PropertyAIChat
    property={selectedProperty}
    onClose={() => setSelectedProperty(null)}
  />
)}

For example:

function PropertyAIChat({
  property,
}: {
  property: PropertyResult;
}) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [answer, setAnswer] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  async function handleAsk() {
    if (!query.trim()) return;

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const response = await askPropertyAI(
        property.id,
        query
      );

      setAnswer(response.answer);
    } catch (error) {
      setAnswer(
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : "Unable to analyze property."
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="property-ai-chat">
      <div className="property-ai-header">
        <div>
          <span>Property Intelligence</span>
          <h3>
            {property.metadata.property_name}
          </h3>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="property-ai-context">
        <span>
          {property.metadata.city}
        </span>

        <span>
          {property.metadata.location}
        </span>

        {property.metadata.brand && (
          <span>
            {property.metadata.brand}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="property-ai-input">
        <input
          value={query}
          onChange={(e) =>
            setQuery(e.target.value)
          }
          placeholder="Ask about this property..."
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === "Enter") {
              handleAsk();
            }
          }}
        />

        <button
          onClick={handleAsk}
          disabled={loading}
        >
          {loading ? "Analyzing..." : "Ask"}
        </button>
      </div>

      {answer && (
        <PropertyAIAnswer answer={answer} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

There is one thing to fix here based on your current API: your /api/search result doesn't currently show an id. So don't use property.id unless your backend actually returns one.

You have two good options.

ChatGPT said:

Absolutely. Below is a complete frontend structure that changes the UX from property dropdown → conversational property search → property cards → “Ask about this property” → contextual Property Intelligence.

I’m assuming a Vite + React + TypeScript project and that your existing types directory is available.
1. src/api/api.ts

Replace your current API file with this. It also removes the duplicate askPropertyAI() implementation.

const API_URL =
  import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000";

export interface PropertyMetadata {
  property_name?: string;
  developer?: string;
  brand?: string;
  country?: string;
  city?: string;
  location?: string;
  property_type?: string;
  investment_type?: string;
  description?: string;
  source_url?: string;
  price?: string;
  bedrooms?: string;
  area?: string;
  title?: string;
}

export interface PropertyResult {
  id?: number;
  document: string;
  metadata: PropertyMetadata;
}

export interface PropertySearchResponse {
  query: string;
  results: PropertyResult[];
}

export async function getHealth() {
  const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/health`);

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error("Backend unavailable");
  }

  return response.json();
}

export async function getProperties(params = "") {
  const response = await fetch(
    `${API_URL}/api/properties${params}`
  );

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error("Unable to fetch properties");
  }

  return response.json();
}

export async function searchProperties(
  query: string,
  limit = 5
): Promise<PropertySearchResponse> {
  const response = await fetch(
    `${API_URL}/api/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(
      query
    )}&limit=${limit}`
  );

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error("Unable to search properties");
  }

  return response.json();
}

export async function searchKnowledge(query: string) {
  const response = await fetch(
    `${API_URL}/api/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`
  );

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error("Unable to search knowledge base");
  }

  return response.json();
}

export async function chat(query: string) {
  const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/api/chat`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      message: query,
    }),
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error("Unable to connect to chat service");
  }

  return response.json();
}

export async function askPropertyAI(
  propertyId: number,
  query: string
) {
  const response = await fetch(
    `${API_URL}/api/properties/${propertyId}/ai`,
    {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        query,
      }),
    }
  );

  if (!response.ok) {
    const message = await response.text();

    throw new Error(
      message || "Unable to analyze property."
    );
  }

  return response.json();
}

2. src/types/propertyAI.ts

Create or replace this file:

export interface PropertyAIResponse {
  answer: string;
}

If your backend returns additional fields later, you can add them here.
3. src/components/PropertyCard.tsx

This is the card displayed when the user searches:

import React from "react";
import type {
  PropertyResult,
} from "../api/api";
import "./PropertyCard.css";

interface PropertyCardProps {
  property: PropertyResult;
  onAsk: (property: PropertyResult) => void;
}

export default function PropertyCard({
  property,
  onAsk,
}: PropertyCardProps) {
  const metadata = property.metadata;

  const propertyName =
    metadata.property_name ||
    metadata.title ||
    "Property opportunity";

  const location = [
    metadata.city,
    metadata.country,
  ]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(", ");

  return (
    <article className="property-card">
      <div className="property-card-top">
        <div className="property-card-icon">
          🏠
        </div>

        <div className="property-card-title">
          <h3>{propertyName}</h3>

          {location && (
            <div className="property-location">
              <span>📍</span>
              {location}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="property-tags">
        {metadata.location && (
          <span className="property-tag">
            {metadata.location}
          </span>
        )}

        {metadata.property_type && (
          <span className="property-tag">
            {metadata.property_type.replace(
              /_/g,
              " "
            )}
          </span>
        )}

        {metadata.brand && (
          <span className="property-tag brand-tag">
            {metadata.brand}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      {metadata.developer && (
        <div className="property-detail">
          <span>Developer</span>
          <strong>{metadata.developer}</strong>
        </div>
      )}

      {metadata.description && (
        <p className="property-description">
          {metadata.description}
        </p>
      )}

      <div className="property-card-footer">
        {metadata.source_url && (
          <a
            href={metadata.source_url}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            className="property-link"
          >
            View property
          </a>
        )}

        <button
          type="button"
          className="ask-property-button"
          onClick={() => onAsk(property)}
        >
          Ask about this property
          <span>→</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

import React from "react";
import type {
  PropertyResult,
} from "../api/api";
import PropertyCard from "./PropertyCard";
import "./PropertyResults.css";

interface PropertyResultsProps {
  properties: PropertyResult[];
  onAsk: (property: PropertyResult) => void;
}

export default function PropertyResults({
  properties,
  onAsk,
}: PropertyResultsProps) {
  if (!properties.length) {
    return (
      <div className="property-results-empty">
        <div className="empty-icon">🔎</div>

        <h3>No matching properties found</h3>

        <p>
          Try asking for a location, property type,
          or investment preference.
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="property-results">
      <div className="property-results-header">
        <div>
          <h3>Properties I found</h3>
          <p>
            {properties.length}{" "}
            {properties.length === 1
              ? "property"
              : "properties"}{" "}
            matching your request
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="property-results-list">
        {properties.map((property, index) => (
          <PropertyCard
            key={
              property.id ??
              property.metadata.property_name ??
              property.metadata.source_url ??
              index
            }
            property={property}
            onAsk={onAsk}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

7. src/components/PropertyAIAnswer.tsx

Your existing component is mostly good. I would make the parser slightly more flexible.

import React from "react";
import "./PropertyAIAnswer.css";

interface PropertyAIAnswerProps {
  answer: string;
}

type Sections = {
  Assessment?: string[];
  Why?: string[];
  "Main concerns"?: string[];
  Valuation?: string[];
  Confidence?: string[];
};

const SECTION_NAMES = [
  "Assessment",
  "Why",
  "Main concerns",
  "Valuation",
  "Confidence",
] as const;

function parseAnswer(answer: string): Sections {
  const sections: Sections = {};

  let currentSection:
    | keyof Sections
    | null = null;

  answer.split("\n").forEach((line) => {
    const trimmed = line.trim();

    if (!trimmed) {
      return;
    }

    const matchedSection = SECTION_NAMES.find(
      (section) =>
        trimmed.toLowerCase() ===
        `${section.toLowerCase()}:`
    );

    if (matchedSection) {
      currentSection = matchedSection;
      sections[matchedSection] = [];
      return;
    }

    if (currentSection) {
      sections[currentSection]?.push(trimmed);
    }
  });

  return sections;
}

interface SectionProps {
  title: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

function Section({
  title,
  children,
}: SectionProps) {
  return (
    <section className="ai-answer-section">
      <h3>{title}</h3>
      {children}
    </section>
  );
}

interface LinesProps {
  lines?: string[];
}

function Lines({ lines }: LinesProps) {
  if (!lines?.length) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div className="ai-answer-lines">
      {lines.map((line, index) => {
        const isBullet =
          line.startsWith("- ") ||
          line.startsWith("• ");

        if (isBullet) {
          return (
            <div
              key={index}
              className="ai-answer-bullet"
            >
              <span>•</span>
              <span>
                {line.replace(/^[-•]\s*/, "")}
              </span>
            </div>
          );
        }

        return (
          <p key={index}>
            {line}
          </p>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function PropertyAIAnswer({
  answer,
}: PropertyAIAnswerProps) {
  if (!answer) {
    return null;
  }

  const sections = parseAnswer(answer);

  const hasStructuredSections =
    Object.keys(sections).length > 0;

  if (!hasStructuredSections) {
    return (
      <div className="property-ai-answer">
        <div className="ai-answer-section">
          <Lines
            lines={answer
              .split("\n")
              .filter(Boolean)}
          />
        </div>

        <Disclaimer />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="property-ai-answer">
      {sections.Assessment && (
        <Section title="Assessment">
          <Lines lines={sections.Assessment} />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections.Why && (
        <Section title="Why">
          <Lines lines={sections.Why} />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections["Main concerns"] && (
        <Section title="Main concerns">
          <Lines
            lines={sections["Main concerns"]}
          />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections.Valuation && (
        <Section title="Valuation">
          <Lines lines={sections.Valuation} />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections.Confidence && (
        <Section title="Confidence">
          <Lines
            lines={sections.Confidence}
          />
        </Section>
      )}

      <Disclaimer />
    </div>
  );
}

function Disclaimer() {
  return (
    <div className="ai-answer-disclaimer">
      This is an indicative analysis based on
      available property data and POC-generated
      intelligence. It is not financial advice or a
      professional property valuation.
    </div>
  );
}

9. src/components/PropertyAIChat.tsx

This is the important component. Once the user clicks Ask about this property, this component gives them the contextual AI experience.

import React, { useState } from "react";
import type {
  PropertyResult,
} from "../api/api";
import { askPropertyAI } from "../api/api";
import PropertyAIAnswer from "./PropertyAIAnswer";
import "./PropertyAIChat.css";

interface PropertyAIChatProps {
  property: PropertyResult;
  onClose: () => void;
}

interface Question {
  query: string;
  answer: string;
}

export default function PropertyAIChat({
  property,
  onClose,
}: PropertyAIChatProps) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState<
    Question[]
  >([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const metadata = property.metadata;

  const propertyName =
    metadata.property_name ||
    metadata.title ||
    "Selected property";

  const location = [
    metadata.city,
    metadata.country,
  ]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(", ");

  async function handleAsk() {
    const trimmedQuery = query.trim();

    if (!trimmedQuery || loading) {
      return;
    }

    if (!property.id) {
      setError(
        "This property does not have a property ID yet."
      );
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      const response = await askPropertyAI(
        property.id,
        trimmedQuery
      );

      setQuestions((previous) => [
        ...previous,
        {
          query: trimmedQuery,
          answer: response.answer,
        },
      ]);

      setQuery("");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : "Unable to analyze property."
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  function handleSuggestedQuestion(
    question: string
  ) {
    setQuery(question);
  }

  return (
    <section className="property-ai-chat">
      <div className="property-ai-chat-header">
        <div className="property-ai-header-info">
          <div className="property-ai-badge">
            ✦
          </div>

          <div>
            <div className="property-ai-label">
              Property Intelligence
            </div>

            <h2>{propertyName}</h2>

            {location && (
              <div className="property-ai-location">
                📍 {location}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          className="property-ai-close"
          onClick={onClose}
          aria-label="Close property intelligence"
        >
          ×
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="property-ai-context">
        {metadata.developer && (
          <span>
            Developer: {metadata.developer}
          </span>
        )}

        {metadata.brand && (
          <span>
            Brand: {metadata.brand}
          </span>
        )}

        {metadata.location && (
          <span>
            Location: {metadata.location}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      {questions.length === 0 && (
        <div className="property-ai-welcome">
          <div className="property-ai-welcome-icon">
            ✦
          </div>

          <h3>
            What would you like to know?
          </h3>

          <p>
            Ask me about investment potential,
            risks, valuation, location, or anything
            else about this property.
          </p>

          <div className="suggested-questions">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() =>
                handleSuggestedQuestion(
                  "Is this property good to buy or are there any risks?"
                )
              }
            >
              Is this property good to buy?
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() =>
                handleSuggestedQuestion(
                  "What are the main risks of this property?"
                )
              }
            >
              What are the main risks?
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() =>
                handleSuggestedQuestion(
                  "How attractive is this property as an investment?"
                )
              }
            >
              Is this a good investment?
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() =>
                handleSuggestedQuestion(
                  "What should I check before buying this property?"
                )
              }
            >
              What should I check?
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {questions.length > 0 && (
        <div className="property-ai-conversation">
          {questions.map((item, index) => (
            <div
              key={index}
              className="property-ai-turn"
            >
              <div className="property-ai-user-question">
                <span className="question-avatar">
                  You
                </span>

                <div className="question-text">
                  {item.query}
                </div>
              </div>

              <PropertyAIAnswer
                answer={item.answer}
              />
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {error && (
        <div className="property-ai-error">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="property-ai-input-wrapper">
        <textarea
          value={query}
          onChange={(event) =>
            setQuery(event.target.value)
          }
          onKeyDown={(event) => {
            if (
              event.key === "Enter" &&
              !event.shiftKey
            ) {
              event.preventDefault();
              handleAsk();
            }
          }}
          placeholder="Ask about this property..."
          rows={2}
          disabled={loading}
        />

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleAsk}
          disabled={!query.trim() || loading}
          className="property-ai-send"
        >
          {loading ? (
            <span className="property-ai-spinner" />
          ) : (
            "↑"
          )}
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="property-ai-input-hint">
        Press Enter to ask · Shift + Enter for a
        new line
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

export interface PropertyMetadata {
  property_name?: string;
  developer?: string;
  brand?: string;
  country?: string;
  city?: string;
  location?: string;
  property_type?: string;
  investment_type?: string;
  description?: string;
  source_url?: string;

  bedrooms?: string;
  area?: string;
  title?: string;

import React from "react";
import type { PropertyResult } from "../types/property";
import "./PropertyCard.css";

interface PropertyCardProps {
  property: PropertyResult;
  onAsk: (property: PropertyResult) => void;
}

export default function PropertyCard({
  property,
  onAsk,
}: PropertyCardProps) {
  const metadata = property.metadata;

  const propertyName =
    metadata.property_name ||
    metadata.title ||
    "Property opportunity";

  const location = [
    metadata.city,
    metadata.location,
    metadata.country,
  ]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(" · ");

  return (
    <article className="property-card">
      <div className="property-card-top">
        <div className="property-card-icon">
          🏠
        </div>

        <div className="property-card-title-wrapper">
          <h3>{propertyName}</h3>

          {location && (
            <div className="property-card-location">
              {location}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="property-card-tags">
        {metadata.property_type && (
          <span className="property-tag">
            {metadata.property_type.replaceAll("_", " ")}
          </span>
        )}

        {metadata.brand && (
          <span className="property-tag">
            {metadata.brand}
          </span>
        )}

        {metadata.investment_type && (
          <span className="property-tag">
            {metadata.investment_type.replaceAll("_", " ")}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      {metadata.description && (
        <p className="property-card-description">
          {metadata.description}
        </p>
      )}

      <div className="property-card-details">
        {metadata.developer && (
          <div className="property-detail">
            <span className="property-detail-label">
              Developer
            </span>

            <span className="property-detail-value">
              {metadata.developer}
            </span>
          </div>
        )}

        {metadata.price && (
          <div className="property-detail">
            <span className="property-detail-label">
              Price
            </span>

            <span className="property-detail-value">
              {metadata.price}
            </span>
          </div>
        )}

        {metadata.area && (
          <div className="property-detail">
            <span className="property-detail-label">
              Area
            </span>

            <span className="property-detail-value">
              {metadata.area}
            </span>
          </div>
        )}

        {metadata.bedrooms && (
          <div className="property-detail">
            <span className="property-detail-label">
              Bedrooms
            </span>

            <span className="property-detail-value">
              {metadata.bedrooms}
            </span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="property-card-actions">
        <button
          type="button"
          className="property-ask-button"
          onClick={() => onAsk(property)}
        >
          <span>Ask about this property</span>
          <span>→</span>
        </button>

        {metadata.source_url && (
          <a
            href={metadata.source_url}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            className="property-view-link"
          >
            View property
          </a>
        )}
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

4. src/components/PropertyAIChat.tsx

This is the important component.

It appears after the user clicks:

    Ask about this property →

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { askPropertyAI } from "../api";
import type {
  PropertyResult,
} from "../types/property";

import PropertyAIAnswer from "./PropertyAIAnswer";
import "./PropertyAIChat.css";

interface PropertyAIChatProps {
  property: PropertyResult;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export default function PropertyAIChat({
  property,
  onClose,
}: PropertyAIChatProps) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [answer, setAnswer] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const metadata = property.metadata;

  const propertyName =
    metadata.property_name ||
    metadata.title ||
    "Selected property";

  async function handleAsk() {
    const trimmedQuery = query.trim();

    if (!trimmedQuery || loading) {
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setError("");

    try {
      if (!property.id) {
        throw new Error(
          "This property does not have a property ID."
        );
      }

      const response = await askPropertyAI(
        property.id,
        trimmedQuery
      );

      setAnswer(response.answer);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : "Unable to analyze property."
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  function handleKeyDown(
    event: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>
  ) {
    if (event.key === "Enter") {
      event.preventDefault();
      handleAsk();
    }
  }

  return (
    <section className="property-ai-chat">
      <div className="property-ai-header">
        <div className="property-ai-heading">
          <div className="property-ai-icon">
            ✦
          </div>

          <div>
            <div className="property-ai-label">
              Property Intelligence
            </div>

            <h2>{propertyName}</h2>
          </div>
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          className="property-ai-close"
          onClick={onClose}
          aria-label="Close property intelligence"
        >
          ×
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="property-ai-context">
        {metadata.city && (
          <span>{metadata.city}</span>
        )}

        {metadata.location && (
          <span>{metadata.location}</span>
        )}

        {metadata.country && (
          <span>{metadata.country}</span>
        )}

        {metadata.brand && (
          <span>{metadata.brand}</span>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="property-ai-prompt">
        <div className="property-ai-prompt-icon">
          ?
        </div>

        <div>
          <strong>
            Ask anything about this property
          </strong>

          <p>
            Get an AI assessment of investment
            potential, risks, valuation and
            important considerations.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="property-ai-input-wrapper">
        <input
          type="text"
          value={query}
          onChange={(event) =>
            setQuery(event.target.value)
          }
          onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
          placeholder="e.g. Is this property good to buy or are there any risks?"
          disabled={loading}
        />

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleAsk}
          disabled={
            loading || !query.trim()
          }
          className="property-ai-send"
        >
          {loading ? (
            <span className="property-ai-spinner" />
          ) : (
            "→"
          )}
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="property-ai-suggestions">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() =>
            setQuery(
              "Is this property good to buy or are there any risks?"
            )
          }
          disabled={loading}
        >
          Is it good to buy?
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() =>
            setQuery(
              "What are the main risks with this property?"
            )
          }
          disabled={loading}
        >
          What are the risks?
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() =>
            setQuery(
              "How attractive is this property as an investment?"
            )
          }
          disabled={loading}
        >
          Investment potential
        </button>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="property-ai-error">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {loading && (
        <div className="property-ai-loading">
          <span className="property-ai-loading-dot" />
          <span className="property-ai-loading-dot" />
          <span className="property-ai-loading-dot" />

          <span>
            Analyzing property intelligence...
          </span>
        </div>
      )}

      {!loading && answer && (
        <PropertyAIAnswer answer={answer} />
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

6. Replace your PropertyAIAnswer.tsx

Your existing component is mostly good. I would make one small improvement: support headings even if the backend returns slightly different formatting.

import React from "react";
import "./PropertyAIAnswer.css";

interface PropertyAIAnswerProps {
  answer: string;
}

type Sections = {
  Assessment?: string[];
  Why?: string[];
  "Main concerns"?: string[];
  Valuation?: string[];
  Confidence?: string[];
};

const SECTION_NAMES = [
  "Assessment",
  "Why",
  "Main concerns",
  "Valuation",
  "Confidence",
] as const;

function parseAnswer(answer: string): Sections {
  const sections: Sections = {};

  let currentSection:
    | keyof Sections
    | null = null;

  answer
    .split("\n")
    .forEach((line) => {
      const trimmed = line.trim();

      if (!trimmed) {
        return;
      }

      const matchedSection =
        SECTION_NAMES.find(
          (section) =>
            trimmed.toLowerCase() ===
            `${section.toLowerCase()}:`
        );

      if (matchedSection) {
        currentSection = matchedSection;

        sections[matchedSection] = [];

        return;
      }

      if (currentSection) {
        sections[currentSection]?.push(
          trimmed
        );
      }
    });

  return sections;
}

interface SectionProps {
  title: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

function Section({
  title,
  children,
}: SectionProps) {
  return (
    <section className="ai-answer-section">
      <h3>{title}</h3>

      {children}
    </section>
  );
}

interface LinesProps {
  lines?: string[];
}

function Lines({ lines }: LinesProps) {
  if (!lines?.length) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <div className="ai-answer-lines">
      {lines.map((line, index) => {
        const isBullet =
          line.startsWith("- ") ||
          line.startsWith("• ");

        if (isBullet) {
          return (
            <div
              key={index}
              className="ai-answer-bullet"
            >
              <span className="ai-answer-bullet-dot">
                •
              </span>

              <span>
                {line.substring(2)}
              </span>
            </div>
          );
        }

        return (
          <p key={index}>
            {line}
          </p>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function PropertyAIAnswer({
  answer,
}: PropertyAIAnswerProps) {
  if (!answer) {
    return null;
  }

  const sections = parseAnswer(answer);

  const hasParsedSections =
    Object.keys(sections).length > 0;

  return (
    <div className="property-ai-answer">
      {hasParsedSections ? (
        <>
          {sections.Assessment && (
            <Section title="Assessment">
              <Lines
                lines={sections.Assessment}
              />
            </Section>
          )}

          {sections.Why && (
            <Section title="Why">
              <Lines lines={sections.Why} />
            </Section>
          )}

          {sections["Main concerns"] && (
            <Section title="Main concerns">
              <Lines
                lines={sections["Main concerns"]}
              />
            </Section>
          )}

          {sections.Valuation && (
            <Section title="Valuation">
              <Lines
                lines={sections.Valuation}
              />
            </Section>
          )}

          {sections.Confidence && (
            <Section title="Confidence">
              <Lines
                lines={sections.Confidence}
              />
            </Section>
          )}
        </>
      ) : (
        <div className="ai-answer-fallback">
          {answer}
        </div>

export interface PropertyMetadata {
  property_name?: string;
  developer?: string;
  brand?: string;
  country?: string;
  city?: string;
  location?: string;
  property_type?: string;
  investment_type?: string;
  description?: string;
  source_url?: string;
  price?: string;
  bedrooms?: string;
  area?: string;
  title?: string;
}

export interface PropertyResult {
  id?: number;
  document: string;
  metadata: PropertyMetadata;
}

export interface PropertySearchResponse {
  query: string;
  results: PropertyResult[];
}

13. src/api.ts

Replace your current duplicated API functions with this version.

import type {
  PropertySearchResponse,
} from "./types/property";

import type {
  PropertyAIResponse,
} from "./types/propertyAI";

const API_URL =
  import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL ||
  "http://localhost:8000";

export async function getHealth() {
  const response = await fetch(
    `${API_URL}/health`
  );

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error("Backend unavailable");
  }

  return response.json();
}

export async function searchProperties(
  query: string,
  limit = 5
): Promise<PropertySearchResponse> {
  const response = await fetch(
    `${API_URL}/api/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(
      query
    )}&limit=${limit}`
  );

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(
      "Unable to search properties"
    );
  }

  return response.json();
}

export async function chat(query: string) {
  const response = await fetch(
    `${API_URL}/api/chat`,
    {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        message: query,
      }),
    }
  );

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(
      "Unable to connect to chat service"
    );
  }

  return response.json();
}

export async function askPropertyAI(
  propertyId: number,
  query: string
): Promise<PropertyAIResponse> {
  const response = await fetch(
    `${API_URL}/api/properties/${propertyId}/ai`,
    {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        query,
      }),
    }
  );

  if (!response.ok) {
    const message =
      await response.text();

    throw new Error(
      message ||
        "Unable to analyze property."
    );
  }

  return response.json();
}
