16. src/components/PropertyAIChat.tsx

This is the contextual intelligence area that appears after the user clicks Ask about this property.

import {
  useState,
} from "react";

import type {
  PropertyResult,
} from "../types/property";

import {
  askPropertyAI,
} from "../api";

import PropertyAIAnswer from "./PropertyAIAnswer";

import "./PropertyAIChat.css";

interface PropertyAIChatProps {
  property: PropertyResult;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export default function PropertyAIChat({
  property,
  onClose,
}: PropertyAIChatProps) {
  const [query, setQuery] =
    useState("");

  const [answer, setAnswer] =
    useState("");

  const [loading, setLoading] =
    useState(false);

  const metadata =
    property.metadata;

  async function handleAsk() {
    const trimmedQuery =
      query.trim();

    if (!trimmedQuery) {
      return;
    }

    if (!property.id) {
      setAnswer(
        "This property does not have a property ID yet. Please configure the backend search response to return an ID for each property."
      );

      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setAnswer("");

    try {
      const response =
        await askPropertyAI(
          property.id,
          trimmedQuery
        );

      setAnswer(
        response.answer
      );
    } catch (error) {
      setAnswer(
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : "Unable to analyze property."
      );
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="property-ai-chat">
      <div className="property-ai-top">
        <div>
          <div className="property-ai-label">
            PROPERTY INTELLIGENCE
          </div>

          <h3>
            {metadata.property_name ||
              metadata.title ||
              "Selected property"}
          </h3>

          <div className="property-ai-meta">
            {metadata.city && (
              <span>
                {metadata.city}
              </span>
            )}

            {metadata.location && (
              <span>
                {metadata.location}
              </span>
            )}

            {metadata.brand && (
              <span>
                {metadata.brand}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        <button
          className="property-ai-close"
          onClick={onClose}
          aria-label="Close property intelligence"
        >
          ×
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="property-ai-suggestions">
        <button
          onClick={() =>
            setQuery(
              "Is this property good to buy or are there any risks?"
            )
          }
        >
          Is this property good to buy?
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() =>
            setQuery(
              "What are the main risks with this property?"
            )
          }
        >
          What are the risks?
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() =>
            setQuery(
              "Is this a good investment opportunity?"
            )
          }
        >
          Is it a good investment?
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="property-ai-input-row">
        <input
          value={query}
          onChange={(event) =>
            setQuery(event.target.value)
          }
          onKeyDown={(event) => {
            if (
              event.key === "Enter"
            ) {
              handleAsk();
            }
          }}
          placeholder="Ask anything about this property..."
          disabled={loading}
        />

        <button
          onClick={handleAsk}
          disabled={
            loading ||
            !query.trim()
          }
        >
          {loading
            ? "Analyzing..."
            : "Ask"}
        </button>
      </div>

      {loading && (
        <div className="property-ai-loading">
          Analyzing property intelligence...
        </div>
      )}

      {answer && !loading && (
        <PropertyAIAnswer
          answer={answer}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

19. src/App.tsx

This ties the whole experience together.

import {
  useState,
} from "react";

import {
  searchProperties,
} from "./api";

import type {
  PropertyResult,
} from "./types/property";

import type {
  ChatMessage,
} from "./types/chat";

import PropertyCard from "./components/PropertyCard";

import PropertyAIChat from "./components/PropertyAIChat";

import "./App.css";

function createId() {
  return `${Date.now()}-${Math.random()
    .toString(36)
    .slice(2)}`;
}

export default function App() {
  const [messages, setMessages] =
    useState<ChatMessage[]>([]);

  const [input, setInput] =
    useState("");

  const [loading, setLoading] =
    useState(false);

  const [selectedProperty, setSelectedProperty] =
    useState<PropertyResult | null>(
      null
    );

  async function handleSearch() {
    const query =
      input.trim();

    if (!query || loading) {
      return;
    }

    setInput("");

    const userMessage: ChatMessage = {
      id: createId(),
      role: "user",
      type: "text",
      content: query,
    };

    setMessages((previous) => [
      ...previous,
      userMessage,
    ]);

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const response =
        await searchProperties(
          query,
          5
        );

      const assistantMessage: ChatMessage = {
        id: createId(),
        role: "assistant",
        type: "properties",
        content:
          response.results.length
            ? `I found ${response.results.length} properties matching your request.`
            : "I couldn't find matching properties.",
        properties:
          response.results,
      };

      setMessages((previous) => [
        ...previous,
        assistantMessage,
      ]);
    } catch (error) {
      const assistantMessage: ChatMessage = {
        id: createId(),
        role: "assistant",
        type: "text",
        content:
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : "Unable to search properties.",
      };

      setMessages((previous) => [
        ...previous,
        assistantMessage,
      ]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  function handleAskProperty(
    property: PropertyResult
  ) {
    setSelectedProperty(property);
  }

  return (
    <div className="app">
      <div className="chat-container">

        <header className="chat-header">
          <div>
            <div className="brand-label">
              REAL ESTATE AI
            </div>

            <h1>
              Property Intelligence
            </h1>

            <p>
              Find properties and ask
              intelligent questions about
              them.
            </p>
          </div>
        </header>

        <main className="chat-content">

          {messages.length === 0 && (
            <div className="welcome">
              <h2>
                What property are you
                looking for?
              </h2>

              <p>
                Try asking something like:
              </p>

              <button
                onClick={() =>
                  setInput(
                    "Please share me the property in Oman"
                  )
                }
              >
                Please share me the property
                in Oman
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {messages.map((message) => (
            <div
              key={message.id}
              className={`message ${
                message.role
              }`}
            >
              {message.role ===
                "assistant" && (
                <div className="assistant-label">
                  AI
                </div>
              )}

              {message.content && (
                <div className="message-text">
                  {message.content}
                </div>
              )}

              {message.type ===
                "properties" &&
                message.properties && (
                  <div className="property-results">
                    {message.properties.map(
                      (
                        property,
                        index
                      ) => (
                        <PropertyCard
                          key={
                            property.id ??
                            property.metadata
                              .property_name ??
                            property.metadata
                              .source_url ??
                            index
                          }
                          property={
                            property
                          }
                          onAsk={
                            handleAskProperty
                          }
                        />
                      )
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
            </div>
          ))}

          {loading && (
            <div className="message assistant">
              <div className="assistant-label">
                AI
              </div>

              <div className="loading">
                Searching properties...
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {selectedProperty && (
            <PropertyAIChat
              property={
                selectedProperty
              }
              onClose={() =>
                setSelectedProperty(
                  null
                )
              }
            />
          )}
        </main>

        <div className="chat-input-container">
          <input
            value={input}
            onChange={(event) =>
              setInput(
                event.target.value
              )
            }
            onKeyDown={(event) => {
              if (
                event.key === "Enter"
              ) {
                handleSearch();
              }
            }}
            placeholder="Ask for properties..."
            disabled={loading}
          />

          <button
            onClick={handleSearch}
            disabled={
              loading ||
              !input.trim()
            }
          >
            {loading
              ? "Searching..."
              : "Send"}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

One backend change is required

Your current /api/search response is missing the property ID:

{
  "document": "...",
  "metadata": {
    "property_name": "Marriott Residences Oman"
  }
}

But your intelligence endpoint requires:

POST /api/properties/{propertyId}/ai

So ideally change the search response to:

{
  "query": "property in Oman",
  "results": [
    {
      "id": 123,
      "document": "...",
      "metadata": {
        "property_name": "Marriott Residences Oman",
        "developer": "DarGlobal",
        "brand": "Marriott",
        "country": "Oman",
        "city": "Muscat",
        "location": "AIDA",
        "property_type": "hotel_residences",
        "investment_type": "private_ownership"
      }
    }
  ]
}

Then the complete flow works:

User: Please share me the property in Oman

→ /api/search

→ Property cards

→ Ask about this property

→ property is selected

→ user asks Is this property good to buy or any risk?

→ /api/properties/123/ai

→ PropertyAIAnswer

One more backend-side improvement is important: filter out document_type: "category" results from the property-card results, because your current response contains generic Oman category pages alongside actual properties. The UI should show actual properties, not the generic "Buy Modern Apartments & Exclusive Villas" page.

    The important UX idea

    Then:

    How does it compare with similar properties?

    Then:

    Is the asking price reasonable?

    Then:

    What infrastructure supports this location?

    All within one conversation.

    That is much closer to the product you're trying to demonstrate.

    1. App.tsx

    Replace your current frontend/src/App.tsx with this.

    import {
      useEffect,
      useMemo,
      useState,
    } from "react";

    import {
      getHealth,
      getProperties,
    } from "./services/api";

    import PropertyAI from "./components/PropertyAI";

    import "./index.css";

    interface Property {
      id: number;

      name?: string;
      title?: string;
      property_name?: string;

      developer?: string;
      brand?: string;

      source?: string;

      country?: string;
      city?: string;
      location?: string;

      property_type?: string;

      price?: number | string;
      currency?: string;

      bedrooms?: number | string;
      bathrooms?: number | string;

      area?: number | string;
      area_unit?: string;
    }

    function getPropertyName(
      property: Property,
    ): string {
      return (
        property.property_name ||
        property.name ||
        property.title ||
        `Property #${property.id}`
      );
    }

    function formatPrice(
      property: Property,
    ): string {
      if (
        property.price === undefined ||
        property.price === null ||
        property.price === ""
      ) {
        return "Price unavailable";
      }

      return `${property.currency || ""} ${Number(
        property.price,
      ).toLocaleString()}`;
    }

    export default function App() {
      const [
        backendStatus,
        setBackendStatus,
      ] = useState("Checking...");

      const [
        properties,
        setProperties,
      ] = useState<Property[]>([]);

      const [
        selectedPropertyId,
        setSelectedPropertyId,
      ] = useState<number | null>(null);

      const [
        propertiesLoading,
        setPropertiesLoading,
      ] = useState(true);

      const [
        propertiesError,
        setPropertiesError,
      ] = useState("");

      /*
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       * Backend health
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       */

      useEffect(() => {
        getHealth()
          .then(() => {
            setBackendStatus("Connected");
          })
          .catch(() => {
            setBackendStatus("Offline");
          });
      }, []);

      /*
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       * Load properties
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       */

      useEffect(() => {
        async function loadProperties() {
          try {
            setPropertiesLoading(true);
            setPropertiesError("");

            const response =
              await getProperties();

            const items: Property[] =
              Array.isArray(response)
                ? response
                : response.properties || [];

            setProperties(items);

            if (items.length > 0) {
              setSelectedPropertyId(
                items[0].id,
              );
            }
          } catch (error) {
            console.error(error);

            setPropertiesError(
              error instanceof Error
                ? error.message
                : "Unable to load properties.",
            );
          } finally {
            setPropertiesLoading(false);
          }
        }

        loadProperties();
      }, []);

      /*
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       * Selected property
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       */

      const selectedProperty =
        useMemo(
          () =>
            properties.find(
              (property) =>
                property.id ===
                selectedPropertyId,
            ) || null,
          [
            properties,
            selectedPropertyId,
          ],
        );

      /*
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       * Property change
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       */

      function handlePropertyChange(
        propertyId: number,
      ) {
        setSelectedPropertyId(
          propertyId,
        );
      }

      /*
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       * UI
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       */

      return (
        <div className="app">

          {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}
          {/* Header                                             */}
          {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}

          <header className="header">

            <div>
              <h1>
                Property Intelligence
              </h1>

              <p>
                AI-powered real estate research
              </p>
            </div>

            <div
              className={
                backendStatus === "Connected"
                  ? "status online"
                  : "status"
              }
            >
              <span className="status-dot">
                ●
              </span>

              {backendStatus}
            </div>

          </header>

          {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}
          {/* Main                                               */}
          {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}

          <main className="chat-page">

            <section className="chat-container">

              {/* ------------------------------------------------ */}
              {/* Chat header                                      */}
              {/* ------------------------------------------------ */}

              <div className="chat-header">

                <div>
                  <h2>
                    Real Estate Intelligence Assistant
                  </h2>

                  <p>
                    Ask about properties, valuation,
                    comparables, infrastructure, growth
                    and investment risk.
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="chat-sources">

                  <span>
                    DarGlobal
                  </span>

                  <span>
                    Wasalt
                  </span>

                </div>

              </div>

              {/* ------------------------------------------------ */}
              {/* Property context                                 */}
              {/* ------------------------------------------------ */}

              <div className="property-context">

                <div className="property-context-label">
                  PROPERTY CONTEXT
                </div>

                {propertiesLoading ? (
                  <div className="property-context-loading">
                    Loading properties...
                  </div>
                ) : propertiesError ? (
                  <div className="property-context-error">
                    {propertiesError}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="property-context-row">

                    <select
                      value={
                        selectedPropertyId ?? ""
                      }
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        handlePropertyChange(
                          Number(
                            event.target.value,
                          ),
                        )
                      }
                    >
                      {properties.map(
                        (property) => (
                          <option
                            key={property.id}
                            value={property.id}
                          >
                            {getPropertyName(
                              property,
                            )}
                            {property.city
                              ? ` | ${property.city}`
                              : ""}
                            {property.source
                              ? ` | ${property.source}`
                              : ""}
                          </option>
                        ),
                      )}
                    </select>

                  </div>
                )}

              </div>

              {/* ------------------------------------------------ */}
              {/* Selected property summary                        */}
              {/* ------------------------------------------------ */}

              {selectedProperty && (
                <div className="selected-property">

                  <div className="selected-property-main">

                    <div className="selected-property-title">

                      <span>
                        SELECTED PROPERTY
                      </span>

                      <h3>
                        {getPropertyName(
                          selectedProperty,
                        )}
                      </h3>

                      <p>
                        {[
                          selectedProperty.location,
                          selectedProperty.city,
                          selectedProperty.country,
                        ]
                          .filter(Boolean)
                          .join(", ")}
                      </p>

                    </div>

                    <div className="selected-property-source">
                      {selectedProperty.source ||
                        "Property"}
                    </div>

                  </div>

                  <div className="property-summary-grid">

                    <div>
                      <span>
                        Developer
                      </span>

                      <strong>
                        {selectedProperty.developer ||
                          "-"}
                      </strong>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <span>
                        Type
                      </span>

                      <strong>
                        {selectedProperty.property_type ||
                          "-"}
                      </strong>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <span>
                        Price
                      </span>

                      <strong>
                        {formatPrice(
                          selectedProperty,
                        )}
                      </strong>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <span>
                        Bedrooms
                      </span>

                      <strong>
                        {selectedProperty.bedrooms ||
                          "-"}
                      </strong>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <span>
                        Area
                      </span>

                      <strong>
                        {selectedProperty.area
                          ? `${selectedProperty.area} ${
                              selectedProperty.area_unit ||
                              ""
                            }`
                          : "-"}
                      </strong>
                    </div>

                  </div>

                </div>
              )}

              {/* ------------------------------------------------ */}
              {/* Unified AI chat                                  */}
              {/* ------------------------------------------------ */}

              <PropertyAI
                propertyId={
                  selectedPropertyId
                }
                propertyName={
                  selectedProperty

                      )
                    : undefined
                }

    2. PropertyAI.tsx

    This is the more important change.

    Instead of:

    textarea
    Ask AI
    answer

    we'll make it a conversation component.

    Replace:

    frontend/src/components/PropertyAI.tsx

    with:

    import {
      FormEvent,
      KeyboardEvent,
      useEffect,
      useRef,
      useState,
    } from "react";

    import PropertyAIAnswer from "./PropertyAIAnswer";

    import {
      askPropertyAI,
    } from "../services/propertyAI";

    interface PropertyAIProps {
      propertyId: number | null;
      propertyName?: string;
    }

    interface ConversationMessage {
      id: string;

      role:
        | "user"
        | "assistant";

      content: string;

      model?: string;
    }

    const DEFAULT_PROMPT =
      "Is this property a good investment and what are the main concerns?";

    const SUGGESTED_QUESTIONS = [
      "Is this property a good investment?",
      "Why is this property a good or weak deal?",
      "What are the main risks?",
      "How does the valuation compare with the asking price?",
      "How does this property compare with similar properties?",
    ];

    export default function PropertyAI({
      propertyId,
      propertyName,
    }: PropertyAIProps) {

      const [
        input,
        setInput,
      ] = useState("");

      const [
        messages,
        setMessages,
      ] = useState<
        ConversationMessage[]
      >([]);

      const [
        loading,
        setLoading,
      ] = useState(false);

      const [
        error,
        setError,
      ] = useState("");

      const messagesEndRef =
        useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(
          null,
        );

      /*
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       * Reset conversation when property changes
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       */

      useEffect(() => {

        setMessages([
          {
            id: crypto.randomUUID(),

            role: "assistant",

            content: propertyName
              ? `I’m ready to analyze ${propertyName}. You can ask me about its valuation, comparable properties, growth potential, infrastructure, risks, or whether it looks like a good deal.`
              : "Select a property and ask me about its investment intelligence.",
          },
        ]);

        setInput("");
        setError("");

      }, [
        propertyId,
        propertyName,
      ]);

      /*
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       * Scroll conversation
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       */

      useEffect(() => {

        messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({
          behavior: "smooth",
        });

      }, [messages, loading]);

      /*
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       * Submit
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       */

      async function handleSubmit(
        event?: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>,
      ) {

        event?.preventDefault();

        const query =
          input.trim();

        if (
          !query ||
          loading ||
          propertyId === null
        ) {
          return;
        }

        const userMessage: ConversationMessage = {
          id: crypto.randomUUID(),

          role: "user",

          content: query,
        };

        setMessages(
          (current) => [
            ...current,
            userMessage,
          ],
        );

        setInput("");
        setError("");
        setLoading(true);

        try {

          const response =
            await askPropertyAI(
              propertyId,
              query,
            );

          const assistantMessage:
            ConversationMessage = {
            id: crypto.randomUUID(),

            role: "assistant",

            content:
              response.answer,

            model:
              response.model,
          };

          setMessages(
            (current) => [
              ...current,
              assistantMessage,
            ],
          );

        } catch (error) {

          console.error(error);

          setError(
            error instanceof Error
              ? error.message
              : "Unable to analyze property.",
          );

          setMessages(
            (current) => [
              ...current,
              {
                id: crypto.randomUUID(),

                role: "assistant",

                content:
                  "I couldn't complete the property analysis. Please try again.",
              },
            ],
          );

        } finally {

          setLoading(false);

        }
      }

      /*
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       * Enter key
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       */

      function handleKeyDown(
        event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>,
      ) {

        if (
          event.key === "Enter" &&
          !event.shiftKey
        ) {

          event.preventDefault();

          void handleSubmit();

        }
      }

      /*
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       * Suggested question
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       */

      function askSuggestedQuestion(
        question: string,
      ) {

        if (loading) {
          return;
        }

        setInput(question);

        setTimeout(() => {
          void handleSubmit();
        }, 0);
      }

      /*
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       * Clear conversation
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       */

      function clearConversation() {

        setMessages([
          {
            id: crypto.randomUUID(),

            role: "assistant",

            content: propertyName
              ? `Conversation cleared. What would you like to know about ${propertyName}?`
              : "Conversation cleared. Select a property to begin.",
          },
        ]);

        setError("");

      }

      /*
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       * Render
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       */

      return (
        <div className="property-ai-chat">

          {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}
          {/* Chat title                                         */}
          {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}

          <div className="property-ai-chat-header">

            <div>

              <div className="property-ai-title-row">

                <div className="ai-avatar">
                  AI
                </div>

                <div>
                  <h2>
                    Property Intelligence
                  </h2>

                  <p>
                    Ask questions about this property
                  </p>
                </div>

              </div>

            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              className="clear-chat-button"
              onClick={
                clearConversation
              }
              disabled={loading}
            >
              Clear
            </button>

          </div>

          {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}
          {/* Active context                                     */}
          {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}

          {propertyName && (
            <div className="ai-property-context">

              <span className="context-icon">
                ◆
              </span>

              <div>

                <span>
                  ANALYZING PROPERTY
                </span>

                <strong>
                  {propertyName}
                </strong>

              </div>

            </div>
          )}

          {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}
          {/* Conversation                                      */}
          {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}

          <div className="ai-conversation">

            {messages.map(
              (message) => (

                <div
                  key={message.id}
                  className={`ai-message-row ${message.role}`}
                >

                  <div
                    className={`ai-message-avatar ${message.role}`}
                  >
                    {message.role ===
                    "assistant"
                      ? "AI"
                      : "You"}
                  </div>

                  <div className="ai-message-body">

                    <div className="ai-message-label">
                      {message.role ===
                      "assistant"
                        ? "Property Intelligence"
                        : "You"}
                    </div>

                    <div className="ai-message-bubble">

                      {message.role ===
                      "assistant" ? (
                        <PropertyAIAnswer
                          answer={
                            message.content
                          }
                          compact
                        />
                      ) : (
                        <p>
                          {message.content}
                        </p>
                      )}

                    </div>

                    {message.model && (
                      <div className="ai-message-meta">
                        Powered by local AI
                      </div>
                    )}

                  </div>

                </div>

              ),
            )}

            {/* ------------------------------------------------ */}
            {/* Loading                                         */}
            {/* ------------------------------------------------ */}

            {loading && (
              <div className="ai-message-row assistant">

                <div className="ai-message-avatar assistant">
                  AI
                </div>

                <div className="ai-message-body">

                  <div className="ai-message-label">
                    Property Intelligence
                  </div>

                  <div className="ai-message-bubble ai-loading">

                    <span />
                    <span />
                    <span />

                    <em>
                      Analyzing property intelligence...
                    </em>

                  </div>

                </div>

              </div>
            )}

            <div
              ref={
                messagesEndRef
              }
            />

          </div>

          {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}
          {/* Suggested questions                                */}
          {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}

          {!loading &&
            messages.length <= 1 && (
              <div className="ai-suggestions">

                <span>
                  Try asking
                </span>

                <div>

                  {SUGGESTED_QUESTIONS
                    .slice(0, 4)
                    .map(
                      (question) => (
                        <button
                          key={question}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() =>
                            askSuggestedQuestion(
                              question,
                            )
                          }
                        >
                          {question}
                        </button>
                      ),
                    )}

                </div>

              </div>
            )}

          {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}
          {/* Error                                             */}
          {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}

          {error && (
            <div className="ai-error">
              {error}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}
          {/* Composer                                           */}
          {/* -------------------------------------------------- */}

          <form
            className="ai-composer"
            onSubmit={handleSubmit}
          >

            <textarea
              value={input}
              onChange={(event) =>
                setInput(
                  event.target.value,
                )
              }
              onKeyDown={
                handleKeyDown
              }
              disabled={
                loading ||
                propertyId === null
              }
              rows={2}
              placeholder={
                propertyId === null
                  ? "Select a property to ask questions..."
                  : "Ask about valuation, comparables, growth, infrastructure, risks..."
              }
            />

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={
                loading ||
                !input.trim() ||
                propertyId === null
              }
              aria-label="Send"
            >
              {loading
                ? "..."
                : "➤"}
            </button>

          </form>

          <div className="ai-composer-hint">
            Press Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
          </div>

        </div>
      );
    }
    3. Important: one small change to PropertyAIAnswer.tsx

    Your existing PropertyAIAnswer currently renders a full set of cards and expects:

    <PropertyAIAnswer
      answer={response.answer}
      model={response.model}
      guardrails={response.guardrails}
    />

    from the previous version.

    For the conversational UI, I recommend adding a compact property.

    Change:

    interface PropertyAIAnswerProps {
      answer: string;
      model: string;
      guardrails: PropertyAIGuardrails;
    }

    to:

    interface PropertyAIAnswerProps {
      answer: string;

      model?: string;

      guardrails?: PropertyAIGuardrails;

      compact?: boolean;
    }

    And component:

    export default function PropertyAIAnswer({
      answer,
      model,
      guardrails,
      compact = false,
    }: PropertyAIAnswerProps) {

    Then you can make the existing sections slightly smaller when:

    compact === true

    However, if you don't want to modify this file yet, remove:

    compact

    from the call in PropertyAI.tsx.

    For the 3-day POC, I actually recommend keeping the existing answer parser and simply making the CSS compact.

    4. Why I recommend this design

    Your product is not really:

    "Property Details + AI Investment Analysis + Chat"

    It is becoming:

    "AI Real Estate Intelligence Assistant"

    with property context.

    That distinction matters.

    The conversation becomes:

    User
     │
     │ Selects Marriott Residences Oman
     ▼
    Property Context
     │
     ▼
    AI Assistant
     │
     ├── Valuation Engine
     ├── Comparable Engine
     ├── Growth Engine
     ├── Risk Engine
     ├── Infrastructure Engine
     ├── Location Intelligence
     ├── Deal Engine
     └── Personalization
     │
     ▼
    Answer

    The attached architecture already separates deterministic intelligence from AI explanation, so this UI is just exposing that architecture conversationally rather than creating another analysis screen.

    5. Even better: property context should persist

    I strongly recommend this behavior:

    User selects:
    Marriott Residences Oman

    Chat shows:

    Analyzing property:
    Marriott Residences Oman

    Then:

    User

    Is this a good investment?

    AI

    Assessment: Weak...

    Then user:

    Why?

    The frontend should not require the user to repeat the property name.

    Then:

    What about valuation?

    Then:

    Compare it with similar properties.

    Then:

    What are the biggest risks?

    This is where the chatbot becomes substantially more valuable than a normal real-estate search UI.

    6. One limitation we should recognize now

    Your current askPropertyAI() API sends only:

    {
      "query": "Is this property a good investment?"
    }

    while the property ID is in the URL:

    POST /api/properties/{propertyId}/ai

    That's enough for property-scoped conversation.

    But it doesn't yet send previous conversation history.

    For the 3-day POC, I recommend NOT changing the backend yet.

    Instead:

    Conversation UI
           │
           ├── Q1 → property analysis
           ├── Q2 → property analysis
           ├── Q3 → property analysis
           └── Q4 → property analysis

    Each question is grounded against the same selected property.

    That's sufficient to demonstrate conversational behavior.

    Later we can add:

    conversation_id
    messages[]

    but don't burn time on that now.

    import {
      useState,
    } from "react";

    import PropertyAIAnswer from "./PropertyAIAnswer";

    import {
      askPropertyAI,
    } from "../services/propertyAI";

    interface PropertyAIProps {
      propertyId: number;
    }

    export default function PropertyAI({
      propertyId,
    }: PropertyAIProps) {
      const [
        query,
        setQuery,
      ] = useState(
        "Is this property a good investment and what are the main concerns?",
      );

      const [
        answer,
        setAnswer,
      ] = useState("");

      const [
        loading,
        setLoading,
      ] = useState(false);

      const [
        error,
        setError,
      ] = useState("");

      async function handleAsk() {
        if (!query.trim()) {
          return;
        }

        setLoading(true);
        setError("");

        try {
          const response =
            await askPropertyAI(
              propertyId,
              query,
            );

          setAnswer(response.answer);

        } catch (error) {
          setError(
            error instanceof Error
              ? error.message
              : "Unable to analyze property.",
          );
        } finally {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }

      return (
        <div className="property-ai">
          <h2>
            AI Investment Analysis
          </h2>

          <textarea
            value={query}
            onChange={(event) =>
              setQuery(event.target.value)
            }
            rows={4}
            placeholder="Ask about this property..."
          />

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handleAsk}
            disabled={
              loading ||
              !query.trim()
            }
          >
            {loading
              ? "Analyzing..."
              : "Ask AI"}
          </button>

          {error && (
            <div className="ai-error">
              {error}
            </div>
          )}

          {answer && (
            <PropertyAIAnswer
              answer={answer}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      );
    }

    import {
      FormEvent,
      useEffect,
      useState,
    } from "react";

    import {
      chat,
      getHealth,
      getProperties,
      searchKnowledge,
    } from "./services/api";

    import PropertyAI from "./components/PropertyAI";

    import "./index.css";

    type Property = {
      id: number;
      name?: string;
      title?: string;
      property_name?: string;

      developer?: string;
      brand?: string;

      country?: string;
      city?: string;
      location?: string;

      property_type?: string;
      investment_type?: string;

      price?: number | string;
      bedrooms?: number | string;
      area?: number | string;

      currency?: string;
    };

    type SearchResult = {
      document: string;
      metadata: {
        title?: string;
        source?: string;
        source_url?: string;
        document_type?: string;
        property_name?: string;
        developer?: string;
        brand?: string;
        country?: string;
        city?: string;
        location?: string;
        property_type?: string;
        investment_type?: string;
        price?: string;
        bedrooms?: string;
        area?: string;
      };
    };

    type Message = {
      role: "user" | "assistant";
      content: string;
      results?: SearchResult[];
    };

    function getPropertyName(property: Property): string {
      return (
        property.property_name ||
        property.name ||
        property.title ||
        `Property #${property.id}`
      );
    }

    function formatValue(
      value: number | string | undefined,
      currency?: string,
    ): string {
      if (value === undefined || value === null || value === "") {
        return "-";
      }

      if (typeof value === "number") {
        return `${currency || ""}${value.toLocaleString()}`;
      }

      return value;
    }

    function App() {
      const [backendStatus, setBackendStatus] =
        useState("Checking...");

      const [properties, setProperties] =
        useState<Property[]>([]);

      const [selectedPropertyId, setSelectedPropertyId] =
        useState<number | null>(null);

      const [propertiesLoading, setPropertiesLoading] =
        useState(true);

      const [propertiesError, setPropertiesError] =
        useState("");

      const [input, setInput] = useState("");

      const [messages, setMessages] =
        useState<Message[]>([
          {
            role: "assistant",
            content:
              "Select a property above to view its investment intelligence, or ask me a general real estate question.",
          },
        ]);

      const [loading, setLoading] =
        useState(false);

      /*
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       * Backend health
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       */

      useEffect(() => {
        getHealth()
          .then(() => setBackendStatus("Connected"))
          .catch(() => setBackendStatus("Offline"));
      }, []);

      /*
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       * Load properties
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       */

      useEffect(() => {
        async function loadProperties() {
          try {
            setPropertiesLoading(true);
            setPropertiesError("");

            const response = await getProperties();

            /*
             * Support either:
             *
             * [
             *   {...}
             * ]
             *
             * or:
             *
             * {
             *   properties: [...]
             * }
             */

            const items: Property[] =
              Array.isArray(response)
                ? response
                : response.properties || [];

            setProperties(items);

            if (items.length > 0) {
              setSelectedPropertyId(items[0].id);
            }
          } catch (error) {
            console.error(error);

            setPropertiesError(
              error instanceof Error
                ? error.message
                : "Unable to load properties.",
            );
          } finally {
            setPropertiesLoading(false);
          }
        }

        loadProperties();
      }, []);

      const selectedProperty =
        properties.find(
          (property) =>
            property.id === selectedPropertyId,
        ) || null;

      /*
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       * General chat / knowledge search
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       */

      async function handleSubmit(
        event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>,
      ) {
        event.preventDefault();

        const query = input.trim();

        if (!query || loading) {
          return;
        }

        setInput("");

        setMessages((current) => [
          ...current,
          {
            role: "user",
            content: query,
          },
        ]);

        setLoading(true);

        try {
          /*
           * Use the actual chat endpoint instead of
           * searchKnowledge().
           *
           * This allows the backend orchestrator to
           * understand the query.
           */

          const response = await chat(query);

          /*
           * Depending on your ChatResponse schema,
           * support common response fields.
           */

          const answer =
            response.answer ||
            response.message ||
            response.response ||
            "";

          const results: SearchResult[] =
            response.results || [];

            let content = answer;

            if (!content) {
            content =
                results.length > 0
                ? `I found ${results.length} relevant result${
                    results.length === 1 ? "" : "s"
                    }.`
                : "I couldn't find any relevant results.";
            }

            setMessages((current) => [
            ...current,
            {
                role: "assistant",
                content,
                results,
            },
            ]);
        } catch (error) {
          console.error(error);

          /*
           * Fall back to knowledge search if the
           * general chat endpoint is unavailable.
           */

          try {
            const response =
              await searchKnowledge(query);

            const results: SearchResult[] =
              response.results || [];

            setMessages((current) => [
              ...current,
              {
                role: "assistant",
                content:
                  results.length > 0
                    ? `I found ${results.length} relevant result${
                        results.length === 1 ? "" : "s"
                      } in the knowledge base.`
                    : "I couldn't find any relevant results in the knowledge base.",
                results,
              },
            ]);
          } catch (fallbackError) {
            console.error(fallbackError);

            setMessages((current) => [
              ...current,
              {
                role: "assistant",
                content:
                  "I couldn't connect to the backend. Please make sure the API server is running.",
              },
            ]);
          }
        } finally {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }

      /*
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       * Render
       * ---------------------------------------------------------
       */

      return (
        <div className="app">

          {/* =====================================================
              HEADER
          ===================================================== */}

          <header className="header">
            <div>
              <h1>Property Intelligence</h1>

              <p>
                AI-powered real estate research
              </p>
            </div>

            <span
              className={
                backendStatus === "Connected"
                  ? "status online"
                  : "status"
              }
            >
              ● {backendStatus}
            </span>
          </header>


          {/* =====================================================
              MAIN
          ===================================================== */}

          <main className="chat-page">

            <section className="chat-container">

              {/* =================================================
                  PROPERTY SELECTOR
              ================================================= */}

              <div className="property-selector">

                <div>
                  <h2>
                    Property Intelligence
                  </h2>

                  <p>
                    Select a property to view its
                    investment analysis.
                  </p>
                </div>

                {propertiesLoading ? (
                  <div className="property-loading">
                    Loading properties...
                  </div>
                ) : propertiesError ? (
                  <div className="ai-error">
                    {propertiesError}
                  </div>
                ) : properties.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="property-loading">
                    No properties found.
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <select
                    value={
                      selectedPropertyId ?? ""
                    }
                    onChange={(event) => {
                      const value =
                        Number(event.target.value);

                      setSelectedPropertyId(
                        value || null,
                      );
                    }}
                  >
                    {properties.map(
                      (property) => (
                        <option
                          key={property.id}
                          value={property.id}
                        >
                          {getPropertyName(
                            property,
                          )}

                      ),
                    )}
                  </select>
                )}
              </div>


              {/* =================================================
                  SELECTED PROPERTY

                  <div className="property-panel-header">

                      </span>

                      <h2>
                        {getPropertyName(
                          selectedProperty,
                        )}
                      </h2>

                      {(selectedProperty.city ||
                        selectedProperty.country ||
                        selectedProperty.location) && (
                        <p>
                          {[

                            selectedProperty.country,
                          ]
                            .filter(Boolean)

                    </div>

    const API_URL =
      import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000";

    export async function getHealth() {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/health`);

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error("Backend unavailable");
      }

      return response.json();
    }

    export async function getProperties(params = "") {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${API_URL}/api/properties${params}`
      );

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error("Unable to fetch properties");
      }

      return response.json();
    }

    export async function searchProperties(
      query: string,
      limit = 5
    ) {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${API_URL}/api/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(
          query
        )}&limit=${limit}`
      );

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error("Unable to search properties");
      }

      return response.json();
    }

    export async function searchKnowledge(
      query: string
    ) {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${API_URL}/api/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`
      );

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error("Unable to search knowledge base");
      }

      return response.json();
    }

    export async function chat(query: string) {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/api/chat`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          message: query,
        }),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error("Unable to connect to chat service");
      }

      return response.json();
    }

    export async function askPropertyAI(
      propertyId: number,
      query: string,
    ) {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${API_URL}/api/properties/${propertyId}/ai`,
        {
          method: "POST",

            query,
          }),

      );

      if (!response.ok) {

        throw new Error(

      }

    }

    import type {
      PropertyAIResponse,
    } from "../types/propertyAI";

    export async function askPropertyAI(

    import React from "react";
    import "./PropertyAIAnswer.css";

    interface PropertyAIAnswerProps {
      answer: string;
    }

    type Sections = {
      Assessment?: string[];
      Why?: string[];
      "Main concerns"?: string[];
      Valuation?: string[];
      Confidence?: string[];
    };

    const SECTION_NAMES = [
      "Assessment",
      "Why",
      "Main concerns",
      "Valuation",
      "Confidence",
    ] as const;

    function parseAnswer(answer: string): Sections {
      const sections: Sections = {};

      let currentSection:
        | keyof Sections
        | null = null;

      answer.split("\n").forEach((line) => {
        const trimmed = line.trim();

        const matchedSection = SECTION_NAMES.find(
          (section) => trimmed === `${section}:`
        );

        if (matchedSection) {
          currentSection = matchedSection;
          sections[matchedSection] = [];
          return;
        }

        if (currentSection && trimmed) {
          sections[currentSection]?.push(trimmed);
        }
      });

      return sections;
    }

    interface SectionProps {
      title: string;
      children: React.ReactNode;
    }

    function Section({
      title,
      children,
    }: SectionProps) {
      return (
        <section className="ai-answer-section">
          <h3>{title}</h3>
          {children}
        </section>
      );
    }

    interface LinesProps {
      lines?: string[];
    }

    function Lines({ lines }: LinesProps) {
      if (!lines?.length) {
        return null;
      }

      return (
        <div>
          {lines.map((line, index) => {
            const isBullet = line.startsWith("- ");

            if (isBullet) {
              return (
                <div
                  key={index}
                  className="ai-answer-bullet"
                >
                  {line.substring(2)}
                </div>
              );
            }

            return (
              <p key={index}>
                {line}
              </p>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      );
    }

    export default function PropertyAIAnswer({
      answer,
    }: PropertyAIAnswerProps) {
      if (!answer) {
        return null;
      }

      const sections = parseAnswer(answer);

      return (
        <div className="property-ai-answer">
          {sections.Assessment && (
            <Section title="Assessment">
              <Lines lines={sections.Assessment} />
            </Section>
          )}

          {sections.Why && (
            <Section title="Why">
              <Lines lines={sections.Why} />
            </Section>
          )}

          {sections["Main concerns"] && (
            <Section title="Main concerns">
              <Lines
                lines={sections["Main concerns"]}
              />
            </Section>
          )}

          {sections.Valuation && (
            <Section title="Valuation">
              <Lines lines={sections.Valuation} />
            </Section>
          )}

          {sections.Confidence && (
            <Section title="Confidence">
              <Lines
                lines={sections.Confidence}
              />
            </Section>
          )}

          <div className="ai-answer-disclaimer">
            This is an indicative analysis based on
            available property data and POC-generated
            intelligence. It is not financial advice or
            a professional property valuation.
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    function createMessage(
    role: "user" | "assistant",
    content: string,
    ): ConversationMessage {
    return {
    id: ${Date.now()}-${Math.random()},
    role,
    content,
    };
    }

    export default function PropertyAI({
    propertyId,
    propertyName,
    }: PropertyAIProps) {
    const [input, setInput] = useState("");

    const [messages, setMessages] = useState<
    ConversationMessage[]

        ([]);

    useState(false);

    const [error, setError] =
    useState("");

    useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

    /*
        Reset conversation whenever the selected

        useEffect(() => {

        : "Select a property above to begin.";

      createMessage(
        "assistant",
        welcomeMessage,
      ),
    ]);

    setInput("");
    setError("");
    setLoading(false);

    }, [propertyId, propertyName]);

    /*
        Keep the newest message visible.
        */
        useEffect(() => {
        messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({
        behavior: "smooth",
        });
        }, [messages, loading]);

    /*
        Send a specific question.
        Passing the question directly avoids the
        React setState timing problem that occurs
        when setInput() and handleSubmit() are
        called back-to-back.
        */
        async function sendQuestion(
        question: string,
        ) {
        const query = question.trim();

    if (
      !query ||
      loading ||
      propertyId === null
    ) {
      return;
    }

    setMessages((current) => [
      ...current,
      createMessage("user", query),
    ]);

    setInput("");
    setError("");
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const response =
        await askPropertyAI(
          propertyId,
          query,
        );

      const answer =
        response?.answer ||
        "I couldn't generate an analysis for that question.";

      setMessages((current) => [
        ...current,
        createMessage(
          "assistant",
          answer,
        ),
      ]);
    } catch (requestError) {
      console.error(requestError);

      const message =
        requestError instanceof Error
          ? requestError.message
          : "Unable to analyze property.";

      setError(message);

      setMessages((current) => [
        ...current,
        createMessage(
          "assistant",
          "I couldn't complete that analysis. Please try again.",
        ),
      ]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }

    }

    async function handleSubmit(

    function clearConversation() {

        </div>
      )}

      <form
        className="ai-composer"

          disabled={

      <div className="ai-composer-hint">

      </div>

    </div>

    );
    }
    2. frontend/src/components/PropertyAIAnswer.tsx

    I've made it backward-compatible: compact is optional, so the component can still be used elsewhere without breaking existing calls.

    I also fixed an important parsing issue: if the backend ever returns plain text that doesn't contain Assessment:, Why:, etc., the old component would render essentially nothing. This version displays the raw answer in that case.
    PropertyAIAnswer.tsx

    import React from "react";

    import "./PropertyAIAnswer.css";

    interface PropertyAIAnswerProps {
    answer: string;
    compact?: boolean;
    }

    type Sections = {
    Assessment?: string[];
    Why?: string[];
    "Main concerns"?: string[];
    Valuation?: string[];
    Confidence?: string[];
    };

    const SECTION_NAMES = [
    "Assessment",
    "Why",
    "Main concerns",
    "Valuation",
    "Confidence",
    ] as const;

    function parseAnswer(
    answer: string,
    ): Sections {
    const sections: Sections = {};

    let currentSection:
    | keyof Sections
    | null = null;

    answer
    .split("\n")
    .forEach((line) => {
    const trimmed = line.trim();

      const matchedSection =
        SECTION_NAMES.find(
          (section) =>
            trimmed.toLowerCase() ===
            `${section}:`.toLowerCase(),
        );

      if (matchedSection) {
        currentSection =
          matchedSection;

        sections[matchedSection] = [];

        return;
      }

      if (
        currentSection &&
        trimmed
      ) {
        sections[currentSection]?.push(
          trimmed,
        );
      }
    });

    return sections;
    }

    interface SectionProps {
    title: string;
    children: React.ReactNode;
    }

    function Section({
    title,
    children,
    }: SectionProps) {
    return (
    <section className="ai-answer-section">
    <h3>{title}</h3>
    {children}
    </section>
    );
    }

    interface LinesProps {
    lines?: string[];
    }

    function Lines({
    lines,
    }: LinesProps) {
    if (!lines?.length) {
    return null;
    }

    return (
    <div>
    {lines.map(
    (line, index) => {
    const isBullet =
    line.startsWith("- ") ||
    line.startsWith("• ");

          if (isBullet) {
            return (
              <div
                key={index}
                className="ai-answer-bullet"
              >
                <span>
                  •
                </span>

                <span>
                  {line.substring(2)}
                </span>
              </div>
            );
          }

          return (
            <p key={index}>
              {line}
            </p>
          );
        },
      )}
    </div>

    );
    }

    export default function PropertyAIAnswer({
    answer,
    compact = false,
    }: PropertyAIAnswerProps) {
    if (!answer?.trim()) {
    return null;
    }

    const sections =
    parseAnswer(answer);

    const hasSections =
    Object.values(sections).some(
    (section) =>
    section &&
    section.length > 0,
    );

    /*
        If the backend returns normal prose
        rather than the structured format, don't
        hide the answer.
        */
        if (!hasSections) {
        return ( <div className={`property-ai-answer ${ compact ? "compact" : "" }`} > <div className="ai-answer-plain-text"> {answer .split("\n") .filter(Boolean) .map( (line, index) => ( <p key={index}> {line} </p> ), )} </div> </div>

    );

    }

    return (
    <div
    className={property-ai-answer ${ compact ? "compact" : "" }}
    >

      {sections.Assessment && (
        <Section title="Assessment">
          <Lines
            lines={
              sections.Assessment
            }
          />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections.Why && (
        <Section title="Why">
          <Lines
            lines={sections.Why}
          />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections["Main concerns"] && (
        <Section title="Main concerns">
          <Lines
            lines={
              sections[
                "Main concerns"
              ]
            }
          />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections.Valuation && (
        <Section title="Valuation">
          <Lines
            lines={
              sections.Valuation
            }
          />
        </Section>
      )}

      {sections.Confidence && (

          <Lines
            lines={
              sections.Confidence
            }
          />
        </Section>
      )}

      <div className="ai-answer-disclaimer">
        This is an indicative analysis based on
        available property data and POC-generated
        intelligence. It is not financial advice
        or a professional property valuation.

    One backend limitation

    There is still an important distinction between conversation UI and conversation-aware AI.

    Right now every request is:

    {
      "query": "What are the main risks?"
    }

    to:

    POST /api/properties/{propertyId}/ai

    So the UI looks conversational, but the backend receives each question independently.

    For the 3-day POC, that's acceptable. The selected propertyId keeps every request grounded to the same property.

    Later, we can change the request to something like:

    {
      "conversation_id": "...",
      "messages": [
        {
          "role": "user",
          "content": "Is this property a good investment?"
        },
        {
          "role": "assistant",
          "content": "Assessment: Weak..."
        },
        {
          "role": "user",
          "content": "Why?"
        }
      ]
    }

    But I would not do that yet.

    The important part

    When the user clicks:

    Ask about this property →

    we should not immediately call the property AI endpoint.

    Instead, the frontend should set:

    activeProperty = property

    and put a small context indicator into the chat:

    PROPERTY CONTEXT

    ◆ Marriott Residences Oman
      Muscat, Oman · DarGlobal

    [ × Remove context ]

    Then the user's next question:

        Is this property good to buy or any risk?

    goes to:

    POST /api/properties/{propertyId}/ai

    That's exactly where your existing backend architecture becomes useful.
    There is one backend/frontend change I recommend

    Your current general search endpoint already does:

    searchKnowledge(query)

    and returns:

    {
      results: [...]
    }

    So for:

        Please share me the property in Oman

    we can initially use the existing /api/search endpoint.

    The frontend can display the returned results as property cards.

    Then each result gets:

    Ask about this property →

    The result's metadata needs to contain the property ID, though.

    Currently your SearchResult metadata that you showed me has things like:

    property_name
    developer
    city
    country
    price
    bedrooms
    area

    but I haven't seen a property_id.

    That's important.

    Ideally the search response should contain:

    {
      "document": "...",
      "metadata": {
        "property_id": 123,
        "property_name": "Marriott Residences Oman",
        "developer": "DarGlobal",
        "country": "Oman",
        "city": "Muscat",
        "price": 1100000,
        "currency": "USD"
      }
    }

    Then the frontend can do:

    function handlePropertyContext(
      property: SearchResult
    ) {
      setActiveProperty({
        id: property.metadata.property_id,
        name: property.metadata.property_name,
        ...
      });
    }

    and the next question naturally becomes property-scoped.
    I would change the architecture to this

                             USER

    4. When "Ask about this property" is clicked

    This is the key part.

    Don't open a separate property dropdown.

    Instead, show a contextual chat area:

    For example:

    function PropertyAIChat({
      property,
    }: {
      property: PropertyResult;
    }) {
      const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
      const [answer, setAnswer] = useState("");
      const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

      async function handleAsk() {
        if (!query.trim()) return;

        setLoading(true);

        try {
          const response = await askPropertyAI(
            property.id,
            query
          );

          setAnswer(response.answer);
        } catch (error) {
          setAnswer(
            error instanceof Error
              ? error.message
              : "Unable to analyze property."
          );
        } finally {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }

      return (
        <div className="property-ai-chat">
          <div className="property-ai-header">
            <div>
              <span>Property Intelligence</span>
              <h3>
                {property.metadata.property_name}
              </h3>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="property-ai-context">
            <span>
              {property.metadata.city}
            </span>

            <span>
              {property.metadata.location}
            </span>

            {property.metadata.brand && (
              <span>
                {property.metadata.brand}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="property-ai-input">
            <input
              value={query}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setQuery(e.target.value)
              }
              placeholder="Ask about this property..."
              onKeyDown={(e) => {
                if (e.key === "Enter") {
                  handleAsk();
                }
              }}
            />

            <button
              onClick={handleAsk}
              disabled={loading}
            >
              {loading ? "Analyzing..." : "Ask"}
            </button>
          </div>

          {answer && (
            <PropertyAIAnswer answer={answer} />
          )}
        </div>
      );
    }

    There is one thing to fix here based on your current API: your /api/search result doesn't currently show an id. So don't use property.id unless your backend actually returns one.

    Absolutely. Below is a complete frontend structure that changes the UX from property dropdown → conversational property search → property cards → “Ask about this property” → contextual Property Intelligence.

    I’m assuming a Vite + React + TypeScript project and that your existing types directory is available.
    1. src/api/api.ts

    Replace your current API file with this. It also removes the duplicate askPropertyAI() implementation.

    const API_URL =
      import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || "http://localhost:8000";

    export interface PropertyMetadata {
      property_name?: string;
      developer?: string;
      brand?: string;
      country?: string;
      city?: string;
      location?: string;
      property_type?: string;
      investment_type?: string;
      description?: string;
      source_url?: string;
      price?: string;
      bedrooms?: string;
      area?: string;
      title?: string;
    }

    export interface PropertyResult {
      id?: number;
      document: string;
      metadata: PropertyMetadata;
    }

    export interface PropertySearchResponse {
      query: string;
      results: PropertyResult[];
    }

    export async function getHealth() {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/health`);

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error("Backend unavailable");
      }

      return response.json();
    }

    export async function getProperties(params = "") {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${API_URL}/api/properties${params}`
      );

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error("Unable to fetch properties");
      }

      return response.json();
    }

    export async function searchProperties(
      query: string,
      limit = 5
    ): Promise<PropertySearchResponse> {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${API_URL}/api/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(
          query
        )}&limit=${limit}`
      );

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error("Unable to search properties");
      }

      return response.json();
    }

    export async function searchKnowledge(query: string) {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${API_URL}/api/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`
      );

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error("Unable to search knowledge base");
      }

      return response.json();
    }

    export async function chat(query: string) {
      const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/api/chat`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          message: query,
        }),
      });

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error("Unable to connect to chat service");
      }

      return response.json();
    }

    export async function askPropertyAI(
      propertyId: number,
      query: string
    ) {
      const response = await fetch(
        `${API_URL}/api/properties/${propertyId}/ai`,
        {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            query,
          }),
        }
      );

      if (!response.ok) {
        const message = await response.text();

        throw new Error(
          message || "Unable to analyze property."
        );
      }

      return response.json();
    }

    2. src/types/propertyAI.ts

    import React from "react";

      const propertyName =
        metadata.property_name ||
        metadata.title ||
        "Property opportunity";

      const location = [

          <div className="property-card-footer">

              onClick={() => onAsk(property)}
            >
              Ask about this property
              <span>→</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </article>
      );
    }
