        # =========================================================
        # VALUATION
        # =========================================================

        @staticmethod
        def _build_valuation_text(
            valuation: dict[str, Any],
            property_data: dict[str, Any],
        ) -> str:

            if not valuation.get("available"):

                return (
                    "A deterministic valuation is not "
                    "available from the supplied property data."
                )

            estimated_value = valuation.get(
                "estimated_value"
            )

            upside = valuation.get(
                "upside_percent"
            )

            asking_price = property_data.get(
                "price"
            )

            currency = (
                property_data.get("currency")
                or ""
            )

            if (
                estimated_value is not None
                and upside is not None
                and asking_price is not None
            ):

                estimated_display = (
                    f"{currency}"
                    f"{estimated_value / 1_000_000:.2f}M"
                )

                asking_display = (
                    f"{currency}"
                    f"{asking_price / 1_000_000:.2f}M"
                )

                if upside < 0:

                    return (
                        f"The estimated value is approximately "
                        f"{estimated_display} versus an asking "
                        f"price of {asking_display}. This indicates "
                        f"the property is approximately "
                        f"{abs(upside):.2f}% above its estimated "
                        f"value."
                    )

                if upside > 0:

                    return (
                        f"The estimated value is approximately "
                        f"{estimated_display} versus an asking "
                        f"price of {asking_display}. This indicates "
                        f"approximately {upside:.2f}% upside relative "
                        f"to its estimated value."
                    )

                return (
                    f"The estimated value is approximately "
                    f"{estimated_display}, which is approximately "
                    f"aligned with the asking price of "
                    f"{asking_display}."
                )

            if (
                estimated_value is not None
                and upside is not None
            ):

                if upside < 0:

                    return (
                        f"The estimated value is approximately "
                        f"{estimated_value:,.2f}. The supplied "
                        f"valuation indicates the property is "
                        f"approximately {abs(upside):.2f}% above "
                        f"its estimated value."
                    )

                if upside > 0:

                    return (
                        f"The estimated value is approximately "
                        f"{estimated_value:,.2f}. The supplied "
                        f"valuation indicates approximately "
                        f"{upside:.2f}% upside relative to its "
                        f"estimated value."
                    )

                return (
                    f"The estimated value is approximately "
                    f"{estimated_value:,.2f}, aligned with the "
                    f"supplied valuation."
                )

            return (
                "A valuation is available, but some valuation "
                "details are unavailable."
            )

        # =========================================================
        # FALLBACK VALIDATION
        # =========================================================

        def _validate_fallback(
            self,
            fallback: str,
            evidence: dict[str, Any],
        ) -> list[str]:

            violations: list[str] = []

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # Required sections
            # -----------------------------------------------------

            for section in self.REQUIRED_SECTIONS:

                if section not in fallback:

                    violations.append(
                        f"fallback_missing_section:{section[:-1]}"
                    )

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # Forbidden content
            # -----------------------------------------------------

            for pattern in self.FORBIDDEN_PATTERNS:

                if re.search(
                    pattern,
                    fallback,
                    flags=re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
                ):

                    violations.append(
                        f"fallback_forbidden_content:{pattern}"
                    )

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # Disclaimer
            # -----------------------------------------------------

            normalized_fallback = (
                self._normalize_whitespace(
                    fallback
                )
            )

            normalized_disclaimer = (
                self._normalize_whitespace(
                    self.DISCLAIMER
                )
            )

            if (
                normalized_disclaimer
                not in normalized_fallback
            ):

                violations.append(
                    "fallback_missing_disclaimer"
                )

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # Numeric validation
            # -----------------------------------------------------

            violations.extend(
                self._validate_numbers(
                    fallback,
                    evidence,
                )
            )

            return violations

    Why your current response is happening

    There are actually two separate problems.

    First, your LLM response is failing guardrails:

    missing_section:Confidence
    forbidden_content:\bwe are given\b
    missing_disclaimer
    unsupported_number:6
    unsupported_number:7

    Therefore this code executes:

    fallback = self.build_fallback(...)

    So what you see in the frontend is not really Qwen's answer. It is the deterministic fallback.

    Second, your old fallback was essentially:

    This property appears to be a moderate investment opportunity...

    regardless of whether the user asked:

        Is this property good to buy?

    or:

        What are the risks?

    or:

        We need to purchase this?

    The updated version makes fallback intent-aware.

    For:

    we need to purchase this?

    you should now get something closer to:

    Assessment:
    The available intelligence supports further purchase due diligence, but does not provide a strong basis for proceeding immediately. The Deal Score is 60.36/100.

    Why:
    - Investment analysis indicates moderate attractiveness
    - Growth evidence is strong
    - Multiple comparable properties support the market view

    Main concerns:
    - Investment risk is moderate.
    - Growth Score is 77/100.

    Valuation:
    A deterministic valuation is not available from the supplied property data.

    Confidence:
    The purchase assessment is based on the available deterministic property, valuation, growth, risk and deal intelligence.

    This is an indicative analysis based on available property data and POC-generated intelligence. It is not financial advice or a professional property valuation.

    And for:

    What are the risks included with this property?

    it will use:

    property_risk_analysis

    instead of the purchase/investment fallback.
    One more thing: restart FastAPI

    Because you're running Python locally, after replacing these files, restart the backend rather than relying on the existing process.

    For example:

    pkill -f uvicorn

    then start your normal server again, e.g.:

    uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000

    Then test directly:

    curl -X POST 'http://localhost:8000/api/properties/10/ai' \
      -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \

    Then:

    curl -X POST 'http://localhost:8000/api/properties/10/ai' \
      -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
      -d '{"query":"What are the risks included with this property"}'

    The key fix for your current AttributeError is that _validate_fallback() is now inside the AIGuardrails class, and the key behavioral fix is passing intent into validate().

    2. Add a direct fact-answer method

    This is important.

    A question such as:

        What is the price of this property?

    does not need Qwen.

    You already have the authoritative value in:

    result["property"]["price"]

    So don't send simple factual questions to the LLM at all.

    Add this method to AIOrchestrator:

    def answer_property_fact(
        self,
        query: str,
        result: dict[str, Any],
        intent: str,
    ) -> str | None:

        property_data = result.get(
            "property",
            {},
        )

        if intent == "property_price":

            price = property_data.get("price")
            currency = property_data.get("currency") or ""

            if price is None:
                return "The property price is currently unavailable."

            try:
                price_display = f"{price:,.2f}"
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                price_display = str(price)

            return (
                f"The asking price for this property is "
                f"{currency} {price_display}."
            )

        if intent == "property_developer":

            developer = property_data.get(
                "developer"
            )

            if not developer:
                return (
                    "The developer information for this "
                    "property is currently unavailable."
                )

            return (
                f"The developer of this property is "
                f"{developer}."
            )

        if intent == "property_location":

            city = property_data.get("city")
            country = property_data.get("country")

            location_parts = [
                value
                for value in [city, country]
                if value
            ]

            if not location_parts:
                return (
                    "The location information for this "
                    "property is currently unavailable."
                )

            return (
                f"This property is located in "
                f"{', '.join(location_parts)}."
            )

        if intent == "property_bedrooms":

            bedrooms = property_data.get(
                "bedrooms"
            )

            if bedrooms is None:
                return (
                    "The bedroom information for this "
                    "property is currently unavailable."
                )

            return (
                f"This property has {bedrooms} "
                f"bedroom{'s' if bedrooms != 1 else ''}."
            )

        if intent == "property_area":

            area = property_data.get("area")
            area_unit = property_data.get(
                "area_unit"
            ) or ""

            if area is None:
                return (
                    "The property area is currently unavailable."
                )

            return (
                f"The property area is "
                f"{area} {area_unit}."
            )

        if intent == "property_type":

            property_type = property_data.get(
                "property_type"
            )

            if not property_type:
                return (
                    "The property type is currently unavailable."
                )

            return (
                f"This is a {property_type}."
            )

        return None

    Put this inside the AIOrchestrator class, before answer().
    3. Change your answer() method

    This is the most important change.

    def answer(
        self,
        query: str,
        result: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:

        intent = self.classify_intent(
            query
        )

        # =====================================================

                    "violations": [],

        # =====================================================

            context

            answer=cleaned_response,

            intent=intent,
            query=query,

            "model": "qwen3:4b",

                "violations": guardrail_result.get(
                    "violations",

        }

    Expected behavior after these changes
    Query

    what is the price of this property?

    Response:

    The asking price for this property is AED 2,500,000.

    No Deal Score.
    No Growth Score.
    No investment analysis.
    No unnecessary disclaimer.
    Query

    who is the developer?

    Response:

    The developer of this property is Emaar.

    Query

    where is this property?

    Response:

    This property is located in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

    Query

    how many bedrooms does this property have?

    Response:

    This property has 3 bedrooms.

    Query

    What are the risks included with this property?

    Uses:

    property_risk_analysis

    and gives a risk-focused response.
    Query

    we need to purchase this?

    Uses:

    property_purchase_analysis

    and gives a purchase-focused assessment rather than blindly returning:

    This property appears to be a moderate investment opportunity...

    Query

    Is this a good investment?

    Uses:

    property_investment_analysis

    and gets your full investment analysis.
    The key architecture

    You want the flow to be:

    User question
          │
          ▼
    classify_intent()
          │
          ├── property_price ───────► deterministic answer
          ├── property_developer ───► deterministic answer
          ├── property_location ────► deterministic answer
          ├── property_bedrooms ────► deterministic answer
          ├── property_area ────────► deterministic answer
          ├── property_type ────────► deterministic answer
          │
          ├── property_risk_analysis ──► Qwen + risk prompt
          ├── property_purchase_analysis ► Qwen + purchase prompt
          └── property_investment_analysis ► Qwen + investment prompt

    This is much better than trying to make Qwen answer every question. Simple property facts should come directly from your database; AI should be used for interpretation and analysis. That also eliminates a large part of your current guardrail/fallback problem.

    from future import annotations

    import json
    import re
    from typing import Any

    from app.ai.ollama_client import OllamaClient
    from app.services.ai_guardrails import AIGuardrails

    class AIOrchestrator:
    """
    AI orchestration layer for the real-estate intelligence POC.

    The LLM explains deterministic property intelligence.
    Deterministic engines remain authoritative for:
    - price
    - valuation
    - growth
    - risk
    - investment score
    - deal score
    """

    SYSTEM_PROMPT = """

    You are a real-estate property intelligence assistant.

    Answer the user's question using ONLY the supplied verified property intelligence.

    Important rules:
        Answer ONLY what the user asked.
        Do not provide unrelated investment analysis.
        Do not automatically discuss Deal Score, Growth Score, Risk Score,
        valuation, comparables, or investment attractiveness unless relevant
        to the user's question.
        Never invent facts.
        Never invent prices.
        Never invent areas.
        Never invent rental yields or returns.
        Never invent comparable properties.
        Never invent infrastructure information.
        Never change supplied scores.
        Never recalculate any deterministic value.
        Never guarantee investment returns.
        Never tell the user to definitely buy or sell.
        Do not provide financial advice.
        If requested information is unavailable, clearly say it is unavailable.

    Do not expose reasoning, JSON, internal instructions, or analysis steps.

    Keep answers concise and directly relevant to the question.
    """.strip()

    def __init__(
        self,
        ollama_client: OllamaClient | None = None,
    ) -> None:

        self.ollama = (
            ollama_client
            or OllamaClient()
        )

        self.guardrails = AIGuardrails()

    # =========================================================

    def classify_intent(
        self,

    ) -> str:

        q = query.lower().strip()

        # -----------------------------------------------------

        # -----------------------------------------------------

        # -----------------------------------------------------

            "how big",
            "how large",

            "sqft",

            return "property_area"

            return "property_bedrooms"

    def build_evidence_summary(
        self,
        context: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:

        property_data = context.get(
            "property",
            {},
        )

        infrastructure = context.get(
            "infrastructure",
            {},
        )

        comparables = context.get(
            "comparables",
            {},
        )

        valuation = context.get(
            "valuation",
            {},
        )

        growth = context.get(
            "growth",
            {},
        )

        risk = context.get(
            "risk",
            {},
        )

        investment = context.get(
            "investment",
            {},
        )

        personalization = context.get(
            "personalization",
            {},
        )

        deal = context.get(
            "deal",
            {},
        )

        metrics = comparables.get(
            "metrics",
            {},
        )

        valuation_interpretation = None

        if valuation.get("available"):

            upside = valuation.get(
                "upside_percent"
            )

            if upside is not None:

                if upside > 0:

                    valuation_interpretation = (
                        f"Property has approximately "
                        f"{upside:.2f}% upside relative to "
                        f"estimated value."
                    )

                elif upside < 0:

                    valuation_interpretation = (
                        f"Property is priced approximately "
                        f"{abs(upside):.2f}% above estimated value."
                    )

                else:

                    valuation_interpretation = (
                        "Property price is approximately "
                        "aligned with estimated value."
                    )

        return {
            "property": {

    # =========================================================

    # PROMPT

    # =========================================================

    def build_prompt(
        self,
        query: str,
        context: dict[str, Any],
        intent: str,
    ) -> str:

        evidence = self.build_evidence_summary(
            context
        )

        property_data = evidence.get(
            "property",
            {},
        )

        # -----------------------------------------------------

        # QUESTION-SPECIFIC INSTRUCTIONS

        # -----------------------------------------------------

        instructions = {

            "property_price": """

    Answer only the property's asking price.

    If the price is available:
    State the price and currency clearly.

    If the price is unavailable:
    Say that the property's asking price is unavailable.

    Do not discuss:
        Deal Score
        Risk
        Growth
        Investment attractiveness
        Valuation
        Comparables

    Keep the answer to 1-2 sentences.
    """,

            "property_area": """

    Answer only the property's area/size.

    If available, provide the area and unit.

    Do not discuss investment analysis, risk, growth,
    Deal Score, valuation, or unrelated information.

    Keep the answer concise.
    """,

            "property_bedrooms": """

    Answer only the number of bedrooms.

    If unavailable, say that bedroom information is unavailable.

    Keep the answer concise.
    """,

            "property_location": """

    Answer only the property's location.

    Mention the available city, country, and/or location.

    Do not provide investment analysis unless specifically requested.
    """,

            "property_developer": """

    Answer only the developer information.

    If the developer is unavailable, say so.

    Keep the answer concise.
    """,

            "property_risk_analysis": """

    Answer specifically about property risks.

    Explain the supplied risk level and relevant evidence-backed risks.

    Do not turn the answer into a general investment recommendation.

    Do not invent risks.

    Keep the answer focused on risk.
    """,

            "property_valuation": """

    Answer specifically about valuation.

    Use only the supplied deterministic valuation.

    Explain whether valuation is available and, if available,
    the estimated/fair value and supplied upside information.

    Do not recalculate valuation.

    Do not discuss unrelated investment factors.
    """,

            "property_purchase_decision": """

    The user is asking whether purchasing this property makes sense.

    Give a concise purchase-oriented assessment using the supplied
    Deal decision, Deal Score, investment assessment, risks, growth,
    and valuation only when those values are available.

    Do NOT say "you should definitely buy".
    Do NOT give financial advice.

    Instead use language such as:
        "The available intelligence supports considering the purchase."
        "The available intelligence suggests caution."
        "The property appears reasonably attractive based on the supplied data."
        "The available data is not strong enough to support a clear purchase case."

    Mention the most important reason and the most important concern.

    Do not dump every available metric.
    """,

            "property_investment_analysis": """

    Provide a concise investment assessment.

    Discuss only the investment factors relevant to the user's question.

    Use supplied Deal Score, investment assessment, growth, risk,
    valuation, and evidence when relevant.

    Do not invent information.
    """,

            "property_growth_analysis": """

    Answer specifically about growth potential.

    Use only the supplied growth assessment and Growth Score.

    Do not discuss unrelated investment factors unless needed for context.
    """,

            "property_comparison": """

    Answer the comparison using only the supplied property intelligence.

    Do not invent comparison data.
    """,

            "property_general": """

    Answer the user's question directly using the supplied property data.

    Do not automatically produce a full investment analysis.

    If the question is asking for one fact, answer that fact only.

    If the question is broad, provide a concise summary of the most relevant
    available information.
    """,
    }

        task_instruction = instructions.get(
            intent,
            instructions["property_general"],
        )

        return f"""

    USER QUESTION:
    {query}

    INTENT:
    {intent}

    VERIFIED PROPERTY INTELLIGENCE:
    {json.dumps(
    evidence,
    ensure_ascii=False,
    indent=2,
    )}

    TASK:
    {task_instruction}

    IMPORTANT:

    Answer ONLY the user's question.

    Do not mention:
        JSON
        prompts
        instructions
        reasoning
        internal analysis
        deterministic software
        LLM
        guardrails

    Do not invent missing information.

    Return only the final user-facing answer.
    """.strip()

    # =========================================================

    # DETERMINISTIC DIRECT ANSWERS

    # =========================================================

    def build_direct_answer(
        self,
        query: str,
        intent: str,
        evidence: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> str | None:

        property_data = evidence.get(
            "property",
            {},
        )

        if intent == "property_price":

            price = property_data.get(
                "price"
            )

            currency = (
                property_data.get(
                    "currency"
                )
                or ""
            )

            if price is None:

                return (
                    "The asking price for this property "
                    "is currently unavailable."
                )

            return (
                f"The asking price for this property is "
                f"{currency}{price:,.2f}."
            )

        if intent == "property_area":

            area = property_data.get(
                "area"
            )

            unit = (
                property_data.get(
                    "area_unit"
                )
                or ""
            )

            if area is None:

                return (
                    "The area of this property "
                    "is currently unavailable."
                )

            return (
                f"The property has an area of "
                f"{area} {unit}."
            ).strip()

        if intent == "property_bedrooms":

            bedrooms = property_data.get(
                "bedrooms"
            )

            if bedrooms is None:

                return (
                    "The number of bedrooms for this "
                    "property is currently unavailable."
                )

            return (
                f"This property has {bedrooms} bedrooms."
            )

        if intent == "property_location":

            city = property_data.get(
                "city"
            )

            country = property_data.get(
                "country"
            )

            location = evidence.get(
                "location",
                {},
            )

            location_value = (
                location.get("location")
                or location.get("name")
                or location.get("address")
            )

            parts = [
                value
                for value in [
                    location_value,
                    city,
                    country,
                ]
                if value
            ]

            if not parts:

                return (
                    "The property's location "
                    "is currently unavailable."
                )

            return (
                "This property is located in "
                + ", ".join(
                    dict.fromkeys(parts)
                )
                + "."
            )

        if intent == "property_developer":

            developer = property_data.get(
                "developer"
            )

            if not developer:

                return (
                    "The developer information for "
                    "this property is unavailable."
                )

            return (
                f"The developer of this property is "
                f"{developer}."
            )

        return None

    # =========================================================

    # RESPONSE CLEANING

    # =========================================================

    @staticmethod
    def _clean_response(
        response: str,
    ) -> str:

        text = response.strip()

        text = re.sub(
            r"<think>.*?</think>",
            "",
            text,
            flags=re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE,
        )

        text = re.sub(
            r"^```(?:text|markdown)?\s*",
            "",
            text,
            flags=re.IGNORECASE,
        )

        text = re.sub(
            r"\s*```$",
            "",
            text,
        )

        return text.strip()

    # =========================================================

    # ANSWER

    # =========================================================

    def answer(
        self,
        query: str,
        result: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:

        intent = self.classify_intent(
            query
        )

        context = self.build_context(
            result
        )

        evidence = self.build_evidence_summary(
            context
        )

        # -----------------------------------------------------

        # Direct factual questions should not go through the LLM.

        #
        # This guarantees that:
        # "what is the price?"
        # actually returns the price.
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        direct_answer = self.build_direct_answer(
            query=query,
            intent=intent,
            evidence=evidence,
        )

        if direct_answer is not None:

            return {
                "intent": intent,
                "answer": direct_answer,
                "model": "deterministic",
                "guardrails": {
                    "passed": True,
                    "fallback_used": False,
                    "violations": [],
                },
            }

        # -----------------------------------------------------

        # LLM answer for analytical questions

        # -----------------------------------------------------

        prompt = self.build_prompt(
            query=query,
            context=context,
            intent=intent,
        )

        raw_response = self.ollama.generate(
            system=self.SYSTEM_PROMPT,
            prompt=prompt,
        )

        cleaned_response = self._clean_response(
            raw_response
        )

        # -----------------------------------------------------

        # IMPORTANT:

        #
        # Only use the full investment-style guardrail for
        # analytical responses that require the structured
        # answer.
        #
        # Simple questions must not be forced into:
        # Assessment / Why / Main concerns / Valuation /
        # Confidence.
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        if intent in {
            "property_purchase_decision",
            "property_investment_analysis",
            "property_risk_analysis",
            "property_valuation",
            "property_growth_analysis",
        }:

            guardrail_result = self.guardrails.validate(
                answer=cleaned_response,
                evidence=evidence,
            )

            return {
                "intent": intent,
                "answer": guardrail_result["answer"],
                "model": "qwen3:4b",
                "guardrails": {
                    "passed": guardrail_result.get(
                        "valid",
                        False,
                    ),
                    "fallback_used": guardrail_result.get(
                        "fallback_used",
                        False,
                    ),
                    "violations": guardrail_result.get(
                        "violations",
                        [],
                    ),
                },
            }

        # -----------------------------------------------------

        # General / comparison / search answers

        # -----------------------------------------------------

        return {
            "intent": intent,
            "answer": cleaned_response,
            "model": "qwen3:4b",
            "guardrails": {
                "passed": True,
                "fallback_used": False,
                "violations": [],
            },
        }

    this point that are used elsewhere in the project, keep those methods.
    The important changes are classify_intent(), build_prompt(),
    build_direct_answer(), and answer().

    """

        # =========================================================

        def build_evidence_summary(
            self,
            context: dict[str, Any],
        ) -> dict[str, Any]:

            property_data = context.get(
                "property",
                {},
            )

            infrastructure = context.get(
                "infrastructure",
                {},
            )

            comparables = context.get(
                "comparables",
                {},
            )

            valuation = context.get(
                "valuation",
                {},
            )

            growth = context.get(
                "growth",
                {},
            )

            risk = context.get(
                "risk",
                {},
            )

            investment = context.get(
                "investment",
                {},
            )

            personalization = context.get(
                "personalization",
                {},
            )

            deal = context.get(
                "deal",
                {},
            )

            metrics = comparables.get(
                "metrics",
                {},
            )

            valuation_interpretation = None

            if valuation.get("available"):

                upside = valuation.get(
                    "upside_percent"
                )

                if upside is not None:

                    if upside > 0:

                        valuation_interpretation = (
                            f"Property has approximately "
                            f"{upside:.2f}% upside relative to "
                            f"estimated value."
                        )

                    elif upside < 0:

                        valuation_interpretation = (
                            f"Property is priced approximately "
                            f"{abs(upside):.2f}% above estimated value."
                        )

                    else:

                        valuation_interpretation = (

        # =========================================================
        # QUESTION-SPECIFIC INSTRUCTIONS
        # =========================================================

        def get_response_instruction(
            self,
            intent: str,
        ) -> str:

            instructions = {

                "property_price": """
    Answer only the property price.

    If the price exists, give the amount and currency clearly.

    Example:
    "The asking price is AED 1,500,000."

    Do not discuss investment score, risk, growth, valuation, or deal score.

    If unavailable:
    "The asking price is not available in the supplied property data."
    """,

                "property_details": """
    Answer only the property detail requested by the user.

    Give the relevant value directly and briefly.

    Do not provide an investment analysis unless specifically requested.
    """,

                "property_valuation": """
    Answer the valuation question directly.

    Explain the supplied estimated value, fair-value range, asking-price
    relationship, or valuation status.

    If deterministic valuation is unavailable, say that clearly.

    Do not provide unrelated investment analysis.
    """,

                "property_risk_analysis": """
    Answer specifically about property risk.

    Start with the risk level if available.

    Mention the Risk Score if available.

    Then mention the supplied specific risk factors.

    Do not provide unrelated price, growth, valuation, or investment analysis.
    """,

                "property_growth_analysis": """
    Answer specifically about growth.

    Mention the Growth Score and supplied growth assessment if available.

    Do not provide unrelated investment analysis.
    """,

                "property_investment_analysis": """
    Answer the purchase/investment question.

    Provide a concise assessment based on:
    - Deal Score
    - Investment Score
    - Growth
    - Risk
    - Valuation when available

    Explain the main reasons and concerns.

    Do not tell the user to definitely buy or sell.

    Do not give financial advice.

    A concise structure is acceptable:

    Assessment:
    ...

    Why:
    - ...
    - ...

    Main concerns:
    - ...
    - ...

    Valuation:
    ...

    Confidence:
    ...
    """,

                "property_comparison": """
    Answer the comparison question directly using only supplied evidence.

    Clearly identify the relevant differences.

    Do not invent missing information.
    """,

                "opportunity_discovery": """
    Answer the opportunity-discovery question directly using the supplied
    property intelligence.

    Return the relevant properties or opportunities only.
    """,

                "property_search": """
    Answer the property-search question directly.

    Return only relevant matching property information.
    """,

                "general_property_question": """
    Answer the user's question directly.

    Use only the supplied property intelligence.

    Do not force the answer into an investment-analysis format.
    """,
            }

            return instructions.get(
                intent,
                instructions["general_property_question"],
            ).strip()

        # =========================================================
        # PROMPT
        # =========================================================

        def build_prompt(
            self,
            query: str,
            context: dict[str, Any],
            intent: str,
        ) -> str:

            evidence = self.build_evidence_summary(
                context
            )

            response_instruction = (
                self.get_response_instruction(
                    intent
                )
            )

            return f"""
    USER QUESTION:
    {query}

    QUESTION TYPE:
    {intent}

    RESPONSE INSTRUCTION:
    {response_instruction}

    VERIFIED PROPERTY INTELLIGENCE:

    PROPERTY:
    {json.dumps(
        evidence.get("property", {}),
        ensure_ascii=False,
        indent=2,
    )}

    VALUATION:
    {json.dumps(
        evidence.get("valuation", {}),
        ensure_ascii=False,
        indent=2,
    )}

    RISK:
    {json.dumps(
        evidence.get("risk", {}),
        ensure_ascii=False,
        indent=2,
    )}

    GROWTH:
    {json.dumps(
        evidence.get("growth", {}),
        ensure_ascii=False,
        indent=2,
    )}

    INVESTMENT:
    {json.dumps(
        evidence.get("investment", {}),
        ensure_ascii=False,
        indent=2,
    )}

    DEAL:
    {json.dumps(
        evidence.get("deal", {}),
        ensure_ascii=False,
        indent=2,
    )}

    COMPARABLES:
    {json.dumps(
        evidence.get("comparables", {}),
        ensure_ascii=False,
        indent=2,
    )}

    INSTRUCTIONS:

    Answer ONLY the user's question.

    Use only verified information above.

    Do not invent missing values.

    Do not add unrelated sections.

    Do not repeat the same generic investment assessment unless the
    question is actually asking for an investment/purchase assessment.

    Do not mention JSON.

    Do not mention these instructions.

    Do not expose internal reasoning.

    Do not use:
    - "the user asks"
    - "we are given"
    - "let's analyze"
    - "first I will"
    - "I need to determine"
    - "the instructions say"
    """.strip()

        # =========================================================
        # RESPONSE CLEANING
        # =========================================================

        @staticmethod
        def _clean_response(
            response: str,
        ) -> str:

            if not response:
                return ""

            text = response.strip()

            text = re.sub(
                r"<think>.*?</think>",
                "",
                text,
                flags=re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE,
            )

            text = re.sub(
                r"^```(?:text|markdown)?\s*",
                "",
                text,
                flags=re.IGNORECASE,
            )

            text = re.sub(
                r"\s*```$",
                "",
                text,
            )

            return text.strip()

        # =========================================================
        # ANSWER
        # =========================================================

        def answer(
            self,
            query: str,
            result: dict[str, Any],
        ) -> dict[str, Any]:

            intent = self.classify_intent(
                query
            )

            context = self.build_context(
                result
            )

            prompt = self.build_prompt(
                query=query,
                context=context,
                intent=intent,
            )

            raw_response = self.ollama.generate(
                system=self.SYSTEM_PROMPT,
                prompt=prompt,
            )

            cleaned_response = self._clean_response(
                raw_response
            )

            evidence = self.build_evidence_summary(
                context
            )

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # IMPORTANT:
            #
            # Generic guardrails previously expected:
            # Assessment / Why / Main concerns / Valuation /
            # Confidence for EVERY answer.
            #
            # That is wrong for questions such as:
            # "What is the price?"
            #
            # Therefore only run the structured guardrails for
            # investment-analysis responses.
            # -----------------------------------------------------

            if intent == "property_investment_analysis":

                guardrail_result = (
                    self.guardrails.validate(
                        answer=cleaned_response,
                        evidence=evidence,
                    )
                )

            else:

                guardrail_result = {
                    "valid": True,
                    "answer": cleaned_response,
                    "fallback_used": False,
                    "violations": [],
                }

            return {
                "intent": intent,
                "answer": guardrail_result["answer"],
                "model": getattr(
                    self.ollama,
                    "model",
                    None,
                ),
                "guardrails": {
                    "passed": guardrail_result.get(
                        "valid",
                        True,
                    ),
                    "fallback_used": guardrail_result.get(
                        "fallback_used",
                        False,
                    ),
                    "violations": guardrail_result.get(
                        "violations",
                        [],
                    ),
                },
            }

    Correct. The problem is now Qwen is exposing its internal reasoning instead of returning only the final sentence.

    The safest fix is to make simple factual questions like price, area, developer, location, etc. deterministic in Python rather than asking the LLM to answer them at all.

    1. Add this method

    Put it before answer():

    def build_direct_answer(
        self,
        query: str,
        intent: str,
        evidence: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> str | None:
        """
        Answer simple factual property questions deterministically.

        These questions do not need the LLM:
        - price
        - property details
        - developer
        - location
        - area
        - bedrooms
        """

        property_data = evidence.get(
            "property",
            {},
        )

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # PRICE
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        if intent == "property_price":

            price = property_data.get(
                "price"
            )

            currency = (
                property_data.get("currency")
                or ""
            )

            if price is None:

                return (
                    "The asking price is not available "
                    "in the supplied property data."
                )

            try:
                numeric_price = float(price)

                if numeric_price.is_integer():
                    price_text = f"{int(numeric_price):,}"
                else:
                    price_text = f"{numeric_price:,.2f}"

            except (TypeError, ValueError):

                price_text = str(price)

            return (
                f"The asking price is "
                f"{currency} {price_text}".strip()
                + "."
            )

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # PROPERTY DETAILS
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        if intent == "property_details":

            q = query.lower()

            if (
                "developer" in q
                or "who developed" in q
            ):

                developer = property_data.get(
                    "developer"
                )

                if developer:
                    return (
                        f"The developer is {developer}."
                    )

                return (
                    "The developer is not available "
                    "in the supplied property data."
                )

            if (
                "project name" in q
                or "property name" in q
            ):

                name = (
                    property_data.get("project_name")
                    or property_data.get("title")
                )

                if name:
                    return (
                        f"The property is {name}."
                    )

                return (
                    "The property name is not available "
                    "in the supplied property data."
                )

            if (
                "where is" in q
                or "location" in q
                or "which city" in q
                or "which country" in q
            ):

                city = property_data.get(
                    "city"
                )

                country = property_data.get(
                    "country"
                )

                location_parts = [
                    value
                    for value in [
                        city,
                        country,
                    ]
                    if value
                ]

                if location_parts:

                    return (
                        "The property is located in "
                        + ", ".join(location_parts)
                        + "."
                    )

                return (
                    "The property location is not available "
                    "in the supplied property data."
                )

            if (
                "area" in q
                or "how big" in q
            ):

                area = property_data.get(
                    "area"
                )

                area_unit = (
                    property_data.get(
                        "area_unit"
                    )
                    or ""
                )

                if area is not None:

                    return (
                        f"The property area is "
                        f"{area} {area_unit}".strip()
                        + "."
                    )

                return (
                    "The property area is not available "
                    "in the supplied property data."
                )

            if (
                "bedroom" in q
            ):

                bedrooms = property_data.get(
                    "bedrooms"
                )

                if bedrooms is not None:

                    return (
                        f"The property has "
                        f"{bedrooms} bedrooms."
                    )

                return (
                    "The number of bedrooms is not available "
                    "in the supplied property data."
                )

        return None

    What happens now

    For:

    what is the price of this property?

    Python checks the database result directly.

    "price": 1500000,
    "currency": "AED"

      "intent": "property_price",
      "answer": "The asking price is AED 1,500,000.",
      "model": null,

        "violations": []
      }
    }

    If the data contains:

    you get exactly:

    No Qwen. No reasoning. No JSON leakage.

    you get only:

    For:

    you get:

    The developer is ABC Developments.

    For:

    where is this property?

    you get the available city/country.

    But for:

    we need to purchase this?

    it still goes through the LLM + investment guardrails because that question actually requires an interpretation of Deal Score + Investment + Risk + Growth + Valuation.
    One more important issue

    Your current Qwen output:

        We are given a user question...

    shows that the model is effectively producing <think>-style reasoning without necessarily putting it inside <think> tags.

    Your current _clean_response() only removes:

    <think>...</think>

    So it cannot reliably remove this kind of leaked reasoning.

    For factual questions, the deterministic approach above completely avoids that problem. For investment/risk/growth questions, we can make the LLM response handling stricter as a separate step.

    Yes. You need two changes:
        Frontend: visually distinguish the property listing section with a different background.
        Backend: ensure every Chroma record gets a property_id, including records that currently don't match a SQL Property.

    One important point: your current backend intentionally only sets property_id when a matching SQL property exists:

    def verify_record_ids():
        """
        Verify that every Chroma document has a record_id.
        """

        data = collection.get(
            include=["metadatas"]
        )

        metadatas = data.get(
            "metadatas",
            []
        )

        total = len(metadatas)

        with_record_id = 0
        without_record_id = 0

        missing = []

        for index, metadata in enumerate(metadatas):

            record_id = (
                metadata.get("record_id")
                if metadata
                else None
            )

            if record_id:
                with_record_id += 1
            else:
                without_record_id += 1
                missing.append(index)

        print(
            f"Total Chroma records: {total}"
        )

        print(
            f"Records with record_id: "
            f"{with_record_id}"
        )

        print(
            f"Records WITHOUT record_id: "
            f"{without_record_id}"
        )

        if missing:
            print(
                "Missing record_id indexes:",
                missing,
            )

        return {
            "total": total,
            "with_record_id": with_record_id,
            "without_record_id": without_record_id,
            "missing": missing,
        }

    def check_record_ids():
        data = collection.get(
            include=["metadatas"]
        )

        ids = data.get("ids", [])
        metadatas = data.get("metadatas", [])

        print(f"Total Chroma records: {len(ids)}")

        missing_record_ids = []
        missing_property_ids = []

        for index, chroma_id in enumerate(ids):

            metadata = (
                metadatas[index]
                if index < len(metadatas)
                else {}
            )

            record_id = metadata.get("record_id")
            property_id = metadata.get("property_id")

            if not record_id:
                missing_record_ids.append(
                    {
                        "chroma_id": chroma_id,
                        "source_url": metadata.get(
                            "source_url"
                        ),
                    }
                )

            if not property_id:
                missing_property_ids.append(
                    {
                        "chroma_id": chroma_id,
                        "record_id": record_id,
                        "source_url": metadata.get(
                            "source_url"
                        ),
                    }
                )

        print(
            f"Records with record_id: "
            f"{len(ids) - len(missing_record_ids)}"
        )

        print(
            f"Records missing record_id: "
            f"{len(missing_record_ids)}"
        )

        print(
            f"Records with property_id: "
            f"{len(ids) - len(missing_property_ids)}"
        )

        print(
            f"Records missing property_id: "
            f"{len(missing_property_ids)}"
        )

        if missing_record_ids:
            print("\nMissing record_id:")

            for item in missing_record_ids:
                print(item)

        if missing_property_ids:
            print("\nMissing property_id:")

            for item in missing_property_ids:
                print(item)

    2. Fix the search endpoint

    The important change is to make /api/search return only records that can actually be opened as properties when the frontend is doing a property search.

    For example, update your search endpoint to:

    from fastapi import APIRouter, Query

    from app.knowledge.chroma_store import search


    router = APIRouter(
        prefix="/api/search",
        tags=["search"],
    )


    @router.get("")
    def semantic_search(
        q: str = Query(..., min_length=1),
        limit: int = Query(
            default=5,
            ge=1,
            le=20,
        ),
    ):
        results = search(
            query=q,
            n_results=limit,
        )

        documents = results.get(
            "documents",
            [[]],
        )[0]

        metadatas = results.get(
            "metadatas",
            [[]],
        )[0]

        chroma_ids = results.get(
            "ids",
            [[]],
        )[0]

        matches = []

        for index, document in enumerate(documents):

            metadata = (
                metadatas[index]
                if index < len(metadatas)
                else {}
            )

            chroma_id = (
                chroma_ids[index]
                if index < len(chroma_ids)
                else None
            )

            property_id = metadata.get(
                "property_id"
            )

            # -----------------------------------------
            # Only return actual properties
            # -----------------------------------------

            if not property_id:
                continue

            matches.append(
                {
                    "id": int(property_id),
                    "property_id": int(property_id),
                    "record_id": metadata.get(
                        "record_id"
                    ),
                    "chroma_id": chroma_id,
                    "document": document,
                    "metadata": metadata,
                }
            )

            if len(matches) >= limit:
                break

        return {
            "query": q,
            "results": matches,
        }

    Now your frontend won't receive this:

    {
      "id": null,
      "property_id": null
    }

    for a press article or category page.

    It will receive:

    {
      "id": 10,
      "property_id": 10,
      "record_id": "abc123...",
      "chroma_id": "abc123...",
      "metadata": {
        "property_name": "...",
        "city": "...",
        "country": "..."
      }
    }

    from fastapi import APIRouter, Query

    from app.knowledge.chroma_store import search


    router = APIRouter(
        prefix="/api/search",
        tags=["search"],
    )


    @router.get("")
    def semantic_search(
        q: str = Query(..., min_length=1),
        limit: int = Query(
            default=5,
            ge=1,
            le=20,
        ),
    ):
        results = search(
            query=q,
            n_results=20,
        )

        documents = results.get(
            "documents",
            [[]],
        )[0]

        metadatas = results.get(
            "metadatas",
            [[]],
        )[0]

        chroma_ids = results.get(
            "ids",
            [[]],
        )[0]

        matches = []

        for index, document in enumerate(documents):

            metadata = (
                metadatas[index]
                if index < len(metadatas)
                else {}
            )

            chroma_id = (
                chroma_ids[index]
                if index < len(chroma_ids)
                else None
            )

            property_id = metadata.get(
                "property_id"
            )

            # -------------------------------------------------
            # IMPORTANT:
            # Only actual SQL Property records can be shown
            # as property listings.
            #
            # Category pages, press releases, etc. may exist
            # in Chroma but don't have property_id.
            # -------------------------------------------------

            if not property_id:
                continue

            try:
                property_id_int = int(property_id)
            except (
                TypeError,
                ValueError,
            ):
                continue

            matches.append(
                {
                    "id": property_id_int,

                    "property_id": property_id_int,

                    "record_id": metadata.get(
                        "record_id"
                    ),

                    "chroma_id": chroma_id,

                    "document": document,

                    "metadata": metadata,
                }
            )

            if len(matches) >= limit:
                break

        return {
            "query": q,
            "results": matches,
        }

    Why n_results=20?

    import React from "react";
    import type {
      PropertyResult,
    } from "../services/api";
    import PropertyCard from "./PropertyCard";
    import "./PropertyResults.css";

    interface PropertyResultsProps {
      properties: PropertyResult[];
      onAsk: (property: PropertyResult) => void;
    }

    export default function PropertyResults({
      properties,
      onAsk,
    }: PropertyResultsProps) {
      if (!properties.length) {
        return (
          <div className="property-results-empty">
            <div className="empty-icon">🔎</div>

            <h3>No matching properties found</h3>

            <p>
              Try asking for a location, property type,
              or investment preference.
            </p>
          </div>
        );
      }

      return (
        <div className="property-results">
          <div className="property-results-header">
            <div>
              <h3>Properties I found</h3>

              <p>
                {properties.length}{" "}
                {properties.length === 1
                  ? "property"
                  : "properties"}{" "}
                matching your request
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="property-results-list">
            {properties.map(
              (property, index) => (
                <PropertyCard
                  key={
                    property.property_id ??
                    property.id ??
                    property.record_id ??
                    property.chroma_id ??
                    index
                  }
                  property={property}
                  onAsk={onAsk}
                />
              )
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    5. Important: protect PropertyCard

    This is the most important frontend protection.

    Currently:

    onClick={() => onAsk(property)}

    If somehow a result without property_id gets through, your AI request can fail.

    Change the button to:

    <button
      type="button"
      className="ask-property-button"
      disabled={!property.property_id && !property.id}
      onClick={() => {
        const propertyId =
          property.property_id ??
          property.id;

        if (!propertyId) {
          return;
        }

        onAsk({
          ...property,
          id: propertyId,
          property_id: propertyId,
        });
      }}
    >
      Ask about this property
      <span>→</span>
    </button>

    Therefore your complete PropertyCard.tsx can be:

    import React from "react";
    import type {
      PropertyResult,
    } from "../services/api";
    import "./PropertyCard.css";

    interface PropertyCardProps {
      property: PropertyResult;
      onAsk: (property: PropertyResult) => void;
    }

    export default function PropertyCard({
      property,
      onAsk,
    }: PropertyCardProps) {
      const metadata = property.metadata;

      const propertyName =
        metadata.property_name ||
        metadata.title ||
        "Property opportunity";

      const location = [
        metadata.city,
        metadata.country,
      ]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(", ");

      const propertyId =
        property.property_id ??
        property.id;

      return (
        <article className="property-card">
          <div className="property-card-top">
            <div className="property-card-icon">
              🏠
            </div>

            <div className="property-card-title">
              <h3>{propertyName}</h3>

              {location && (
                <div className="property-location">
                  <span>📍</span>
                  {location}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="property-tags">
            {metadata.location && (
              <span className="property-tag">
                {metadata.location}
              </span>
            )}

            {metadata.property_type && (
              <span className="property-tag">
                {metadata.property_type.replace(
                  /_/g,
                  " "
                )}
              </span>
            )}

            {metadata.brand && (
              <span className="property-tag brand-tag">
                {metadata.brand}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          {metadata.developer && (
            <div className="property-detail">
              <span>Developer</span>
              <strong>
                {metadata.developer}
              </strong>
            </div>
          )}

          {metadata.description && (
            <p className="property-description">
              {metadata.description}
            </p>
          )}

          <div className="property-card-footer">
            {metadata.source_url && (
              <a
                href={metadata.source_url}
                target="_blank"
                rel="noopener noreferrer"
                className="property-link"
              >
                View property
              </a>
            )}

            <button
              type="button"
              className="ask-property-button"
              disabled={!propertyId}
              onClick={() => {
                if (!propertyId) {
                  return;
                }

                onAsk({
                  ...property,
                  id: propertyId,
                  property_id: propertyId,
                });
              }}
            >
              Ask about this property
              <span>→</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </article>
      );
    }

    2. Update your backend search endpoint

    Your current /api/search is returning:

    "id": property_id

    which becomes null for the 18 non-property records.

    Change app/api/search.py (or wherever your semantic_search function is) to this:

    from fastapi import APIRouter, Query

    from app.knowledge.chroma_store import search


    router = APIRouter(
        prefix="/api/search",
        tags=["search"],
    )


    @router.get("")
    def semantic_search(
        q: str = Query(..., min_length=1),
        limit: int = Query(
            default=5,
            ge=1,
            le=20,
        ),
    ):
        results = search(
            query=q,
            n_results=limit,
        )

        documents = (
            results.get("documents", [[]])[0]
        )

        metadatas = (
            results.get("metadatas", [[]])[0]
        )

        chroma_ids = (
            results.get("ids", [[]])[0]
        )

        matches = []

        for index, document in enumerate(documents):

            metadata = (
                metadatas[index]
                if index < len(metadatas)
                else {}
            )

            chroma_id = (
                chroma_ids[index]
                if index < len(chroma_ids)
                else None
            )

            property_id = metadata.get(
                "property_id"
            )

            record_id = metadata.get(
                "record_id"
            ) or chroma_id

            matches.append(
                {
                    # SQL Property ID.
                    # Only exists for actual property records.
                    "id": (
                        int(property_id)
                        if property_id
                        else None
                    ),

                    # Explicit property ID for frontend.
                    "property_id": (
                        int(property_id)
                        if property_id
                        else None
                    ),

                    # ALWAYS available for a Chroma record.
                    "record_id": record_id,

                    # Chroma document ID.
                    "chroma_id": chroma_id,

                    "document": document,

                    "metadata": metadata,
                }
            )

        return {
            "query": q,
            "results": matches,
        }

    Now every result has:

    {
      "id": null,
      "property_id": null,
      "record_id": "a1bc550a382c964081ee7aca4511f9f7",
      "chroma_id": "a1bc550a382c964081ee7aca4511f9f7"
    }

    for a non-property record.

    And an actual property will have something like:

    {
      "id": 10,
      "property_id": 10,
      "record_id": "....",
      "chroma_id": "...."
    }

    Replace PropertyAIAnswer.tsx

    import React from "react";
    import "./PropertyAIAnswer.css";

    interface PropertyAIAnswerProps {
      answer: string;
    }

    type SectionKey =
      | "Assessment"
      | "Why"
      | "Main concerns"
      | "Valuation"
      | "Confidence";

    type Sections = Partial<
      Record<SectionKey, string[]>
    >;

    const SECTION_NAMES: SectionKey[] = [
      "Assessment",
      "Why",
      "Main concerns",
      "Valuation",
      "Confidence",
    ];

    const DISCLAIMER =
      "This is an indicative analysis based on available property data and POC-generated intelligence. It is not financial advice or a professional property valuation.";

    /**
     * Remove obvious LLM reasoning/instruction leakage.
     *
     * This is a UI safety net.
     * The backend/guardrails should still be responsible
     * for preventing this content.
     */
    function cleanAnswer(answer: string): string {
      let text = answer || "";

      // Remove Qwen reasoning blocks.
      text = text.replace(
        /<think>[\s\S]*?<\/think>/gi,
        ""
      );

      // Remove common reasoning preambles.
      const reasoningMarkers = [
        /^We are given[\s\S]*?(?=Assessment:|The risk level is|The asking price is|The price is)/i,
        /^The question type is:[\s\S]*?(?=Assessment:|The risk level is|The asking price is|The price is)/i,
        /^Steps?:[\s\S]*?(?=Assessment:|The risk level is|The asking price is|The price is)/i,
        /^From the verified property intelligence:[\s\S]*?(?=Assessment:|The risk level is|The asking price is|The price is)/i,
        /^Important:[\s\S]*?(?=Assessment:|The risk level is|The asking price is|The price is)/i,
        /^Output must be:[\s\S]*?(?=Assessment:|The risk level is|The asking price is|The price is)/i,
        /^Let's write the response:[\s\S]*?(?=Assessment:|The risk level is|The asking price is|The price is)/i,
        /^However,[\s\S]*?(?=Assessment:|The risk level is|The asking price is|The price is)/i,
      ];

      for (const pattern of reasoningMarkers) {
        text = text.replace(pattern, "");
      }

      return text.trim();
    }

    /**
     * Parse the standard backend response:
     *
     * Assessment:
     * ...
     *
     * Why:
     * - ...
     *
     * Main concerns:
     * - ...
     *
     * Valuation:
     * ...
     *
     * Confidence:
     * ...
     */
    function parseAnswer(answer: string): Sections {
      const sections: Sections = {};

      let currentSection: SectionKey | null = null;

      answer.split(/\r?\n/).forEach((line) => {
        const trimmed = line.trim();

        if (!trimmed) {
          return;
        }

        const matchedSection = SECTION_NAMES.find(
          (section) =>
            trimmed.toLowerCase() ===
            `${section.toLowerCase()}:`
        );

        if (matchedSection) {
          currentSection = matchedSection;

          sections[matchedSection] = [];

          return;
        }

        if (currentSection) {
          sections[currentSection]?.push(trimmed);
        }
      });

      return sections;
    }

    /**
     * Remove duplicate disclaimer if the backend already
     * included it.
     */
    function removeDisclaimer(
      text: string
    ): string {
      return text
        .replace(
          new RegExp(
            escapeRegExp(DISCLAIMER),
            "gi"
          ),
          ""
        )
        .trim();
    }

    function escapeRegExp(
      value: string
    ): string {
      return value.replace(
        /[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g,
        "\\$&"
      );
    }

    interface SectionProps {
      title: string;
      children: React.ReactNode;
      variant?: "normal" | "highlight";
    }

    function Section({
      title,
      children,
      variant = "normal",
    }: SectionProps) {
      return (
        <section
          className={`ai-answer-section ${
            variant === "highlight"
              ? "ai-answer-section-highlight"
              : ""
          }`}
        >
          <h3>{title}</h3>

          <div className="ai-answer-section-content">
            {children}
          </div>
        </section>
      );
    }

    interface LinesProps {
      lines?: string[];
    }

    function Lines({ lines }: LinesProps) {
      if (!lines?.length) {
        return null;
      }

      return (
        <div className="ai-answer-lines">
          {lines.map((line, index) => {
            const cleanedLine = line.trim();

            const isBullet =
              cleanedLine.startsWith("- ") ||
              cleanedLine.startsWith("• ") ||
              cleanedLine.startsWith("* ");

            if (isBullet) {
              return (
                <div
                  key={index}
                  className="ai-answer-bullet"
                >
                  <span className="ai-answer-bullet-icon">
                    •
                  </span>

                  <span>
                    {cleanedLine.replace(
                      /^[-•*]\s*/,
                      ""
                    )}
                  </span>
                </div>
              );
            }

            return (
              <p key={index}>
                {cleanedLine}
              </p>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      );
    }

    /**
     * Direct-answer rendering.
     *
     * Used when the backend returns something like:
     *
     * "The risk level is moderate. The Risk Score is 51/100."
     *
     * instead of the structured format.
     */
    function DirectAnswer({
      answer,
    }: {
      answer: string;
    }) {
      const cleaned = removeDisclaimer(answer);

      if (!cleaned) {
        return null;
      }

      return (
        <div className="property-ai-answer">
          <Section
            title="Answer"
            variant="highlight"
          >
            <Lines
              lines={cleaned
                .split(/\r?\n/)
                .filter((line) => line.trim())}
            />
          </Section>

          <Disclaimer />
        </div>
      );
    }

    export default function PropertyAIAnswer({
      answer,
    }: PropertyAIAnswerProps) {
      if (!answer?.trim()) {
        return null;
      }

      const cleanedAnswer = cleanAnswer(answer);

      if (!cleanedAnswer) {
        return null;
      }

      const sections = parseAnswer(
        cleanedAnswer
      );

      const hasStructuredSections =
        Object.keys(sections).length > 0;

      /**
       * If backend returned a direct answer rather
       * than the standard structure, render it cleanly.
       */
      if (!hasStructuredSections) {
        return (
          <DirectAnswer
            answer={cleanedAnswer}
          />
        );
      }

      return (
        <div className="property-ai-answer">
          {sections.Assessment && (
            <Section
              title="Assessment"
              variant="highlight"
            >
              <Lines
                lines={sections.Assessment}
              />
            </Section>
          )}

          {sections.Why && (
            <Section title="Why">
              <Lines
                lines={sections.Why}
              />
            </Section>
          )}

          {sections["Main concerns"] && (
            <Section title="Main concerns">
              <Lines
                lines={
                  sections["Main concerns"]
                }
              />
            </Section>
          )}

          {sections.Valuation && (
            <Section title="Valuation">
              <Lines
                lines={sections.Valuation}
              />
            </Section>
          )}

          {sections.Confidence && (
            <Section title="Confidence">
              <Lines
                lines={sections.Confidence}
              />
            </Section>
          )}

          <Disclaimer />
        </div>
      );
    }

    function Disclaimer() {
      return (
        <div className="ai-answer-disclaimer">
          {DISCLAIMER}
        </div>
      );
    }
