    ChatGPT said:

    The UI is fine; the problem is that the backend is returning an incomplete LLM answer ("The risk level is"). Your PropertyAIAnswer component then displays exactly what it receives.

    The safest fix is to make the frontend handle incomplete AI responses gracefully and make the backend fallback deterministic. For the UI, update PropertyAIAnswer.tsx so it detects this kind of truncated answer and displays a useful message instead of just "The risk level is".

    Replace your current file with this:
    Updated PropertyAIAnswer.tsx

    import React from "react";
    import "./PropertyAIAnswer.css";

    interface PropertyAIAnswerProps {
      answer: string;
    }

    type Sections = {
      Assessment?: string[];
      Why?: string[];
      "Main concerns"?: string[];
      Valuation?: string[];
      Confidence?: string[];
    };

    const SECTION_NAMES = [
      "Assessment",
      "Why",
      "Main concerns",
      "Valuation",
      "Confidence",
    ] as const;

    function parseAnswer(answer: string): Sections {
      const sections: Sections = {};

      let currentSection:
        | keyof Sections
        | null = null;

      answer.split("\n").forEach((line) => {
        const trimmed = line.trim();

        if (!trimmed) {
          return;
        }

        const matchedSection = SECTION_NAMES.find(
          (section) =>
            trimmed.toLowerCase() ===
            `${section.toLowerCase()}:`
        );

        if (matchedSection) {
          currentSection = matchedSection;
          sections[matchedSection] = [];
          return;
        }

        if (currentSection) {
          sections[currentSection]?.push(trimmed);
        }
      });

      return sections;
    }

    interface SectionProps {
      title: string;
      children: React.ReactNode;
    }

    function Section({
      title,
      children,
    }: SectionProps) {
      return (
        <section className="ai-answer-section">
          <h3>{title}</h3>
          {children}
        </section>
      );
    }

    interface LinesProps {
      lines?: string[];
    }

    function Lines({ lines }: LinesProps) {
      if (!lines?.length) {
        return null;
      }

      return (
        <div className="ai-answer-lines">
          {lines.map((line, index) => {
            const isBullet =
              line.startsWith("- ") ||
              line.startsWith("• ");

            if (isBullet) {
              return (
                <div
                  key={index}
                  className="ai-answer-bullet"
                >
                  <span>•</span>

                  <span>
                    {line.replace(/^[-•]\s*/, "")}
                  </span>
                </div>
              );
            }

            return (
              <p key={index}>
                {line}
              </p>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      );
    }

    /**
     * Detect incomplete / leaked LLM responses.
     *
     * Examples:
     * "The risk level is"
     * "The asking price is"
     * "We are given a user question..."
     * "Steps:"
     */
    function isIncompleteAnswer(answer: string): boolean {
      const text = answer.trim();

      if (!text) {
        return true;
      }

      const incompletePatterns = [
        /^the risk level is\.?$/i,
        /^the risk score is\.?$/i,
        /^the asking price is\.?$/i,
        /^the price is\.?$/i,
        /^the property price is\.?$/i,
        /^the valuation is\.?$/i,
        /^the investment score is\.?$/i,
        /^the answer is\.?$/i,
        /^the response is\.?$/i,
        /^we are given/i,
        /^the question type is/i,
        /^steps?:/i,
        /^important:/i,
        /^let'?s write/i,
      ];

      return incompletePatterns.some((pattern) =>
        pattern.test(text)
      );
    }

    /**
     * Remove obvious LLM reasoning leakage.
     *
     * This is a UI-level safety net.
     * Backend guardrails should still be responsible
     * for validating the actual AI response.
     */
    function cleanLeakedAnswer(answer: string): string {
      let text = answer.trim();

      const reasoningMarkers = [
        "We are given a user question:",
        "The question type is:",
        "We are to answer",
        "Steps:",
        "From the verified property intelligence:",
        "Important:",
        "Let's write the response:",
      ];

      for (const marker of reasoningMarkers) {
        const index = text
          .toLowerCase()
          .indexOf(marker.toLowerCase());

        if (index === 0) {
          return "";
        }
      }

      return text;
    }

    export default function PropertyAIAnswer({
      answer,
    }: PropertyAIAnswerProps) {
      if (!answer) {
        return null;
      }

      const cleanedAnswer = cleanLeakedAnswer(answer);

      /**
       * Never display an incomplete model response.
       *
       * The backend should normally provide the deterministic
       * fallback. This prevents the UI from showing:
       *
       * "The risk level is"
       */
      if (
        !cleanedAnswer ||
        isIncompleteAnswer(cleanedAnswer)
      ) {
        return (
          <div className="property-ai-answer">
            <div className="ai-answer-section">
              <h3>Answer</h3>

              <div className="ai-answer-lines">
                <p>
                  The AI response was incomplete. Please
                  try the question again.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <Disclaimer />
          </div>
        );
      }

      const sections = parseAnswer(cleanedAnswer);

      const hasStructuredSections =
        Object.keys(sections).length > 0;

      /**
       * Normal conversational answer.
       *
       * Example:
       *
       * "The asking price is AED 2,000,000."
       */
      if (!hasStructuredSections) {
        return (
          <div className="property-ai-answer">
            <div className="ai-answer-section ai-answer-direct">
              <h3>Answer</h3>

              <Lines
                lines={cleanedAnswer
                  .split("\n")
                  .filter((line) => line.trim())}
              />
            </div>

            <Disclaimer />
          </div>
        );
      }

      return (
        <div className="property-ai-answer">
          {sections.Assessment && (
            <Section title="Assessment">
              <Lines lines={sections.Assessment} />
            </Section>
          )}

          {sections.Why && (
            <Section title="Why">
              <Lines lines={sections.Why} />
            </Section>
          )}

          {sections["Main concerns"] && (
            <Section title="Main concerns">
              <Lines
                lines={sections["Main concerns"]}
              />
            </Section>
          )}

          {sections.Valuation && (
            <Section title="Valuation">
              <Lines lines={sections.Valuation} />
            </Section>
          )}

          {sections.Confidence && (
            <Section title="Confidence">
              <Lines
                lines={sections.Confidence}
              />
            </Section>
          )}

          <Disclaimer />
        </div>
      );
    }

    function Disclaimer() {
      return (
        <div className="ai-answer-disclaimer">
          This is an indicative analysis based on
          available property data and POC-generated
          intelligence. It is not financial advice or a
          professional property valuation.
        </div>
      );
    }

    But there is one important backend issue

    This frontend change prevents the ugly "The risk level is" output, but it does not fix why Qwen is producing that response.

    Your backend should not send the raw Qwen response to the frontend when it is incomplete.

    For example, if Qwen returns:

    The risk level is

    your AIGuardrails.validate() should mark that response invalid and return the deterministic fallback.

    Add this to AIGuardrails:

    def _is_incomplete_response(
        self,
        answer: str,
    ) -> bool:

        text = answer.strip()

        if not text:
            return True

        incomplete_patterns = [
            r"^the risk level is\.?$",
            r"^the risk score is\.?$",
            r"^the asking price is\.?$",
            r"^the price is\.?$",
            r"^the property price is\.?$",
            r"^the valuation is\.?$",
            r"^the investment score is\.?$",
            r"^the answer is\.?$",
            r"^the response is\.?$",
        ]

        return any(
            re.search(
                pattern,
                text,
                flags=re.IGNORECASE,
            )
            for pattern in incomplete_patterns
        )

    Then inside validate(), immediately after:

    cleaned = self.clean(answer)

    add:

    if self._is_incomplete_response(cleaned):

        violations.append(
            "incomplete_response"
        )

    So the flow becomes:

    User
      ↓
    Frontend
      ↓
    /api/properties/10/ai
      ↓
    AIOrchestrator
      ↓
    Qwen
      ↓
    AIGuardrails
      ↓
    incomplete response?
      ├── YES → deterministic fallback
      └── NO  → use AI response
      ↓
    Frontend

    For your particular risk question, the fallback should then produce something like:

    Assessment:
    The available intelligence classifies the property risk level as moderate. The Risk Score is 51/100.

    Why:
    - The deterministic risk assessment is moderate.
    - The Risk Score is 51/100.

    Main concerns:
    - Target property asking price is unavailable.
    - Target property area is unavailable.
    - Weaker healthcare accessibility.
    - Weaker education accessibility.
    - Target property valuation is unavailable.

    Valuation:
    A deterministic valuation is not available from the supplied property data.

    Confidence:
    The risk assessment is based on the available property and market intelligence.

    This is an indicative analysis based on available property data and POC-generated intelligence. It is not financial advice or a professional property valuation.

    Most importantly: don't try to solve the Qwen reasoning leakage purely in React. The backend guardrail needs to reject incomplete/reasoning responses first; the React change is only the final safety net.

    5. There is another important problem

    Your Qwen response is not following the prompt at all.

    You currently tell it:

    Write ONLY the final answer.

    but Qwen 3 4B is generating reasoning anyway.

    Therefore, I recommend making the AIOrchestrator prompt much simpler.

    For risk questions, don't ask the LLM to reason about the data.

    Give it the facts and ask it to produce a short answer.

    For example, in ai_orchestrator.py, your risk-specific prompt should effectively be:

    def build_risk_prompt(
        self,
        query: str,
        evidence: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> str:

        risk = evidence.get(
            "risk",
            {},
        )

        risk_level = risk.get(
            "risk_level"
        )

        risk_score = risk.get(
            "score"
        )

        return f"""
    User question:
    {query}

    Verified risk information:

    Risk level:
    {risk_level}

    Risk score:
    {risk_score}

    Answer the user's question directly.

    Rules:
    - Do not explain your reasoning.
    - Do not mention these instructions.
    - Do not mention the prompt.
    - Do not mention JSON.
    - Do not say "we are given".
    - Do not say "the user asks".
    - Do not use "Step 1", "Step 2", etc.
    - Do not invent risks.
    - Only use supplied risk information.

    Return only a concise answer for the user.
    """.strip()

    But even better, for something like:

        Is this property good to buy or are there any risks?

    you don't actually need Qwen to generate the risk facts.

    Your deterministic backend already has:

    risk_level = moderate

    def build_risk_fallback(
        self,
        evidence: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> str:

        risk = evidence.get(
            "risk",
            {},
        )

        risk_level = (
            risk.get("risk_level")
            or "unavailable"
        )

        risk_score = risk.get(
            "score"
        )

        risks = risk.get(
            "risks",
            [],
        )

        lines = []

        # --------------------------------------------------
        # Assessment
        # --------------------------------------------------

        assessment = (
            f"The property has a {risk_level} risk level"
        )

        if risk_score is not None:
            assessment += (
                f" with a Risk Score of "
                f"{risk_score:.0f}/100"
            )

        assessment += " based on the available intelligence."

        lines.extend([
            "Assessment:",
            assessment,
            "",
        ])

        # --------------------------------------------------
        # Why
        # --------------------------------------------------

        lines.extend([
            "Why:",
        ])

        if risk_score is not None:
            lines.append(
                f"- The deterministic Risk Score is "
                f"{risk_score:.0f}/100."
            )

        lines.append(
            f"- The deterministic risk assessment is "
            f"{risk_level}."
        )

        lines.extend([
            "",
            "Main concerns:",
        ])

        # --------------------------------------------------
        # Risks
        # --------------------------------------------------

        if risks:

            for risk_item in risks:

                if risk_item:
                    lines.append(
                        f"- {risk_item}"
                    )

        else:

            lines.append(
                "- No specific additional risks are "
                "identified in the supplied intelligence."
            )

        # --------------------------------------------------
        # Valuation
        # --------------------------------------------------

        valuation = evidence.get(
            "valuation",
            {},
        )

        if valuation.get("available"):

            valuation_text = (
                self._build_valuation_text(
                    valuation,
                    evidence.get(
                        "property",
                        {},
                    ),
                )
            )

        else:

            valuation_text = (
                "A deterministic valuation is not "
                "available from the supplied property data."
            )

        lines.extend([
            "",
            "Valuation:",
            valuation_text,
            "",
            "Confidence:",
            (
                "The risk assessment is based on the "
                "available property and market intelligence."
            ),
            "",
            self.DISCLAIMER,
        ])

        return "\n".join(lines)

    7. One more important correction

    Your guardrail currently checks for:

    "missing_section:Confidence"

    That means every answer is required to contain:

    Assessment:
    Why:
    Main concerns:
    Valuation:
    Confidence:

    That is wrong for questions like:

        Who is the developer?

    or:

        What is the price?

    Those should be direct answers.

    You need to make section validation dependent on the intent.

    For example:

    def _validate_sections(
        self,
        answer: str,
        intent: str,
    ) -> list[str]:

            "property_investment_analysis",
            "property_risk_analysis",
        }:

                if section not in answer:

                    violations.append(
                        f"missing_section:{section[:-1]}"
                    )

    Then in validate() replace:

    for section in self.REQUIRED_SECTIONS:

        if section not in cleaned:

            violations.append(
                f"missing_section:{section[:-1]}"
            )

    with:

    violations.extend(
        self._validate_sections(
            answer=cleaned,

        )
    )

    Now:
    Developer question

    Who is the developer?

    can return:

    The developer is DarGlobal.

    Price question

    What is the price of this property?

    can return:

    The asking price is not available in the supplied property data.

    Risk question

    Is there any risk with this property?

    can return:

    Assessment:
    The property has a moderate risk level with a Risk Score of 51/100 based on the available intelligence.

    Why:
    - The deterministic Risk Score is 51/100.
    - The deterministic risk assessment is moderate.

    Main concerns:
    - Target property asking price is unavailable.
    - Target property area is unavailable.
    - Weaker healthcare accessibility.
    - Weaker education accessibility.
    - Target property valuation is unavailable.

    Valuation:
    A deterministic valuation is not available from the supplied property data.

    Confidence:
    The risk assessment is based on the available property and market intelligence.

    This is an indicative analysis based on available property data and POC-generated intelligence. It is not financial advice or a professional property valuation.

    That is the architecture you want.

    So don't fix this by making React smarter. The backend should decide the response type, reject Qwen's leaked reasoning, and produce the appropriate deterministic fallback for that intent. The frontend should simply render whatever valid answer the API gives it.

        # =========================================================
        # ANSWER
        # =========================================================

        def answer(
            self,
            query: str,
            result: dict[str, Any],
        ) -> dict[str, Any]:

            intent = self.classify_intent(
                query
            )

            context = self.build_context(
                result
            )

            evidence = self.build_evidence_summary(
                context
            )

            prompt = self.build_prompt(
                query=query,
                intent=intent,
                context=context,
            )

            raw_response = self.ollama.generate(
                system=self.SYSTEM_PROMPT,
                prompt=prompt,
            )

            cleaned_response = self._clean_response(
                raw_response
            )

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # Deterministic direct answers
            #
            # These prevent Qwen from producing reasoning for
            # simple factual questions.
            # -----------------------------------------------------

            direct_answer = self._build_direct_answer(
                intent=intent,
                evidence=evidence,
            )

            if direct_answer is not None:
                final_answer = direct_answer
                guardrail_result = {
                    "valid": True,
                    "answer": final_answer,
                    "fallback_used": False,
                    "violations": [],
                }

            else:

                guardrail_result = self.guardrails.validate(
                    answer=cleaned_response,
                    evidence=evidence,
                    intent=intent,
                )

                final_answer = guardrail_result[
                    "answer"
                ]

            return {
                "intent": intent,
                "answer": final_answer,
                "model": getattr(
                    self.ollama,
                    "model",
                    "qwen3:4b",
                ),
                "guardrails": {
                    "passed": guardrail_result.get(
                        "valid",
                        False,
                    ),
                    "fallback_used": guardrail_result.get(
                        "fallback_used",
                        False,
                    ),
                    "violations": guardrail_result.get(
                        "violations",
                        [],
                    ),
                },
            }

        # =========================================================
        # DIRECT ANSWERS
        # =========================================================

        @staticmethod
        def _build_direct_answer(
            intent: str,
            evidence: dict[str, Any],
        ) -> str | None:

            property_data = evidence.get(
                "property",
                {},
            )

            if intent == "property_developer":

                developer = property_data.get(
                    "developer"
                )

                if developer:
                    return (
                        f"The developer is {developer}."
                    )

                return (
                    "The developer is not available "
                    "in the supplied property data."
                )

            if intent == "property_price":

                price = property_data.get(
                    "price"
                )

                currency = property_data.get(
                    "currency"
                )

                if price is not None:

                    if currency:

                        return (
                            f"The asking price is "
                            f"{currency} {price}."
                        )

                    return (
                        f"The asking price is "
                        f"{price}."
                    )

                return (
                    "The asking price is not available "
                    "in the supplied property data."
                )

            if intent == "property_area":

                area = property_data.get(
                    "area"
                )

                unit = property_data.get(
                    "area_unit"
                )

                if area is not None:

                    if unit:
                        return (
                            f"The property area is "
                            f"{area} {unit}."
                        )

                    return (
                        f"The property area is "
                        f"{area}."
                    )

                return (
                    "The property area is not available "
                    "in the supplied property data."
                )

            if intent == "property_location":

                city = property_data.get(
                    "city"
                )

                country = property_data.get(
                    "country"
                )

                location = property_data.get(
                    "location"
                )

                parts = [
                    value
                    for value in [
                        location,
                        city,
                        country,
                    ]
                    if value
                ]

                if parts:

                    # Remove duplicates while preserving order.
                    unique_parts = list(
                        dict.fromkeys(parts)
                    )

                    return (
                        "The property is located in "
                        + ", ".join(unique_parts)
                        + "."
                    )

                return (
                    "The property location is not "
                    "available in the supplied property data."
                )

            return None

        # =========================================================
        # RESPONSE CLEANING
        # =========================================================

        @staticmethod
        def _clean_response(
            response: str,
        ) -> str:

            if not response:
                return ""

            text = response.strip()

            # Remove Qwen reasoning blocks.
            import re

            text = re.sub(
                r"<think>.*?</think>",
                "",
                text,
                flags=re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE,
            )

            # Remove accidental markdown fences.
            text = re.sub(
                r"^```(?:text|markdown)?\s*",
                "",
                text,
                flags=re.IGNORECASE,
            )

            text = re.sub(
                r"\s*```$",
                "",
                text,
            )

            return text.strip()

        self,
        answer: str,
        evidence: dict[str, Any],
        intent: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:

        violations: list[str] = []

        if not answer or not answer.strip():

                "answer": self.build_fallback(

                )

                    "fallback_used": True,
                    "violations": violations,
                }

            return {
                "valid": True,
                "answer": cleaned,
                "fallback_used": False,
                "violations": [],
            }

        # ---------------------------------------------------------
        # General response
        # ---------------------------------------------------------

            )

    Change PropertyAIAnswer.tsx to this:

    import React from "react";
    import "./PropertyAIAnswer.css";

    interface PropertyAIAnswerProps {
      answer: string;
      intent?: string;
    }

    type Sections = {
      Assessment?: string[];
      Why?: string[];
      "Main concerns"?: string[];
      Valuation?: string[];
      Confidence?: string[];
    };

    const SECTION_NAMES = [
      "Assessment",
      "Why",
      "Main concerns",
      "Valuation",
      "Confidence",
    ] as const;

    function parseAnswer(answer: string): Sections {
      const sections: Sections = {};

      let currentSection:
        | keyof Sections
        | null = null;

      answer.split("\n").forEach((line) => {
        const trimmed = line.trim();

        if (!trimmed) {
          return;
        }

        const matchedSection = SECTION_NAMES.find(
          (section) =>
            trimmed.toLowerCase() ===
            `${section.toLowerCase()}:`
        );

        if (matchedSection) {
          currentSection = matchedSection;
          sections[matchedSection] = [];
          return;
        }

        if (currentSection) {
          sections[currentSection]?.push(trimmed);
        }
      });

      return sections;
    }

    interface SectionProps {
      title: string;
      children: React.ReactNode;
    }

    function Section({
      title,
      children,
    }: SectionProps) {
      return (
        <section className="ai-answer-section">
          <h3>{title}</h3>
          {children}
        </section>
      );
    }

    interface LinesProps {
      lines?: string[];
    }

    function Lines({
      lines,
    }: LinesProps) {

      if (!lines?.length) {
        return null;
      }

      return (
        <div className="ai-answer-lines">

          {lines.map((line, index) => {

            const isBullet =
              line.startsWith("- ") ||
              line.startsWith("• ");

            if (isBullet) {

              return (
                <div
                  key={index}
                  className="ai-answer-bullet"
                >
                  <span>•</span>

                  <span>
                    {line.replace(
                      /^[-•]\s*/,
                      ""
                    )}
                  </span>
                </div>
              );
            }

            return (
              <p key={index}>
                {line}
              </p>
            );
          })}

        </div>
      );
    }

    function Disclaimer() {
      return (
        <div className="ai-answer-disclaimer">
          This is an indicative analysis based on
          available property data and POC-generated
          intelligence. It is not financial advice or a
          professional property valuation.
        </div>
      );
    }

    export default function PropertyAIAnswer({
      answer,
      intent,
    }: PropertyAIAnswerProps) {

      if (!answer) {
        return null;
      }

      const sections = parseAnswer(answer);

      const hasStructuredSections =
        Object.keys(sections).length > 0;

      /*
       * Simple factual answers should remain simple.
       *
       * Examples:
       * - developer
       * - price
       * - area
       * - location
       */
      const isDirectAnswer =
        intent === "property_developer" ||
        intent === "property_price" ||
        intent === "property_area" ||
        intent === "property_location";

      if (isDirectAnswer) {

        return (
          <div className="property-ai-answer">

            <div className="ai-answer-direct">
              {answer}
            </div>

          </div>
        );
      }

      if (!hasStructuredSections) {

        return (
          <div className="property-ai-answer">

            <div className="ai-answer-section">

              <Lines
                lines={answer
                  .split("\n")
                  .filter(Boolean)}
              />

            </div>

            <Disclaimer />

          </div>
        );
      }

      return (
        <div className="property-ai-answer">

          {sections.Assessment && (
            <Section title="Assessment">
              <Lines
                lines={sections.Assessment}
              />
            </Section>
          )}

          {sections.Why && (
            <Section title="Why">
              <Lines
                lines={sections.Why}
              />
            </Section>
          )}

          {sections["Main concerns"] && (
            <Section title="Main concerns">
              <Lines
                lines={sections["Main concerns"]}
              />
            </Section>
          )}

          {sections.Valuation && (
            <Section title="Valuation">
              <Lines
                lines={sections.Valuation}
              />
            </Section>
          )}

          {sections.Confidence && (
            <Section title="Confidence">
              <Lines
                lines={sections.Confidence}
              />
            </Section>
          )}

          <Disclaimer />

        </div>
      );
    }

    class AIOrchestrator:
        """
        AI orchestration layer for the real-estate intelligence POC.

        Deterministic property intelligence remains authoritative.

        Simple factual questions are answered directly from verified
        property data. Analytical questions are passed to Ollama for
        explanation, then validated by guardrails.
        """

        SYSTEM_PROMPT = """
    You are a real-estate property intelligence assistant.

    Answer the user's question using ONLY the supplied verified property data.

    IMPORTANT:

    - Never invent facts.
    - Never invent prices.
    - Never invent property areas.
    - Never invent rental yields or returns.
    - Never invent comparable properties.
    - Never invent infrastructure information.
    - Never change supplied scores.
    - Never recalculate scores.
    - Never provide financial advice.
    - Never guarantee investment returns.
    - Never tell the user to definitely buy or sell.

    Return ONLY the answer to the user.

    NEVER output:
    - your reasoning
    - analysis steps

    - "The question type is..."
    - "Steps:"
    - "Let's analyze..."
    - "We must..."
    - "The instructions say..."
    - "From the verified property intelligence..."

        def __init__(
            self,
            ollama_client: OllamaClient | None = None,

            self.ollama = (
                ollama_client

        # =========================================================
        # INTENT
        # =========================================================

        def classify_intent(
            self,
            query: str,
        ) -> str:

            q = query.lower().strip()

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # Simple factual questions
            # -----------------------------------------------------

            if any(
                phrase in q
                for phrase in [
                    "who is the developer",
                    "who developed",
                    "developer of this property",
                    "what developer",
                ]
            ):
                return "property_developer"

            if any(
                phrase in q
                for phrase in [
                    "what is the price",
                    "what's the price",
                    "price of this property",
                    "asking price",
                    "how much is this property",
                    "how much does this property cost",
                ]
            ):
                return "property_price"

            if any(
                phrase in q
                for phrase in [
                    "what is the area",
                    "what's the area",
                    "property area",
                    "how big is this property",
                    "size of this property",
                ]
            ):
                return "property_area"

            if any(
                phrase in q
                for phrase in [
                    "where is this property",
                    "property location",
                    "where is the property",
                    "which city is this property",
                ]
            ):
                return "property_location"

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # Risk
            # -----------------------------------------------------

            if any(
                phrase in q
                for phrase in [
                    "risk",
                    "risks",
                    "risky",
                    "risk involved",
                    "risk included",
                    "any risk",
                    "are there any risks",
                ]
            ):
                return "property_risk_analysis"

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # Investment
            # -----------------------------------------------------

            investment_patterns = [
                "good investment",
                "good deal",
                "worth it",
                "worth buying",
                "should i buy",
                "should we buy",
                "we need to purchase",
                "need to purchase",
                "investment potential",
                "investment opportunity",
                "main concerns",
                "valuation",
                "fair value",
                "undervalued",
                "overvalued",
                "why is this property",
                "why this property",
                "why should i consider",
            ]

            if any(
                pattern in q
                for pattern in investment_patterns
            ):
                return "property_investment_analysis"

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # Opportunity discovery
            # -----------------------------------------------------

            opportunity_patterns = [
                "top opportunities",
                "best opportunities",
                "best properties",
                "top properties",
                "10 opportunities",
                "find opportunities",
                "show me opportunities",
                "what should i investigate",
                "properties i should investigate",
            ]

            if any(
                pattern in q
                for pattern in opportunity_patterns
            ):
                return "opportunity_discovery"

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # Comparison
            # -----------------------------------------------------

            comparison_patterns = [
                "compare",
                "comparison",
                "versus",
                " vs ",
                "which is better",
            ]

            if any(
                pattern in q
                for pattern in comparison_patterns
            ):
                return "property_comparison"

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # Search
            # -----------------------------------------------------

            search_patterns = [
                "show me",
                "find me",
                "search",
                "properties in",
                "properties under",
                "properties below",
                "properties above",
                "bedroom",
            ]

            if any(
                pattern in q
                for pattern in search_patterns
            ):
                return "property_search"

            return "property_investment_analysis"

        # =========================================================

        # =========================================================

        def build_context(

            return {

                "location": result.get("location", {}),
                "infrastructure": result.get("infrastructure", {}),
                "comparables": result.get("comparables", {}),
                "valuation": result.get("valuation", {}),
                "growth": result.get("growth", {}),
                "risk": result.get("risk", {}),

                    "personalization",

        # =========================================================
        # EVIDENCE
        # =========================================================

        def build_evidence_summary(
            self,
            context: dict[str, Any],
        ) -> dict[str, Any]:

            property_data = context.get(
                "property",
                {},
            )

            infrastructure = context.get(
                "infrastructure",
                {},
            )

            comparables = context.get(
                "comparables",
                {},
            )

            valuation = context.get(
                "valuation",
                {},
            )

            growth = context.get(
                "growth",
                {},
            )

            risk = context.get(
                "risk",
                {},
            )

            investment = context.get(
                "investment",
                {},
            )

            personalization = context.get(
                "personalization",
                {},
            )

            deal = context.get(
                "deal",
                {},
            )

            metrics = comparables.get(
                "metrics",
                {},
            )

            valuation_interpretation = None

            if valuation.get("available"):

                upside = valuation.get(
                    "upside_percent"
                )

                if upside is not None:

                    if upside > 0:
                        valuation_interpretation = (
                            f"Property has approximately "
                            f"{upside:.2f}% upside relative to "
                            f"estimated value."
                        )

                    elif upside < 0:
                        valuation_interpretation = (
                            f"Property is priced approximately "
                            f"{abs(upside):.2f}% above estimated value."
                        )

                    else:
                        valuation_interpretation = (
                            "Property price is approximately "
                            "aligned with estimated value."
                        )

            return {
                "property": {
                    "id": property_data.get("id"),
                    "property_id": property_data.get(
                        "property_id"
                    ),
                    "title": property_data.get("title"),
                    "project_name": property_data.get(
                        "project_name"
                    ),
                    "developer": property_data.get(
                        "developer"
                    ),
                    "city": property_data.get("city"),
                    "country": property_data.get(
                        "country"
                    ),
                    "price": property_data.get(
                        "price"
                    ),
                    "currency": property_data.get(
                        "currency"
                    ),
                    "area": property_data.get(
                        "area"
                    ),
                    "area_unit": property_data.get(
                        "area_unit"
                    ),
                },

                "infrastructure": {
                    "score": infrastructure.get("score"),
                    "confidence": infrastructure.get(
                        "confidence"
                    ),
                },

                "comparables": {
                    "count": comparables.get(
                        "count",
                        0,
                    ),
                    "median_price": metrics.get(
                        "median_price"
                    ),
                    "average_price": metrics.get(
                        "average_price"
                    ),
                    "average_price_per_area": metrics.get(
                        "average_price_per_area"
                    ),
                    "price_range": metrics.get(
                        "price_range"
                    ),
                },

                "valuation": {
                    "available": valuation.get(
                        "available",
                        False,
                    ),
                    "estimated_value": valuation.get(
                        "estimated_value"
                    ),
                    "fair_value_low": valuation.get(
                        "fair_value_low"
                    ),
                    "fair_value_high": valuation.get(
                        "fair_value_high"
                    ),
                    "upside_percent": valuation.get(

                    "valuation_score": valuation.get(
                        "valuation_score"
                    ),
                    "reason": valuation.get(
                        "reason"

                    "interpretation": valuation_interpretation,

        # =========================================================
        # DIRECT ANSWERS
        # =========================================================

        def build_direct_answer(
            self,
            query: str,
            evidence: dict[str, Any],
            intent: str,
        ) -> str | None:

            property_data = evidence.get(
                "property",
                {},
            )

            risk = evidence.get(
                "risk",
                {},
            )

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # Developer
            # -----------------------------------------------------

            if intent == "property_developer":

                developer = property_data.get(
                    "developer"
                )

                if developer:
                    return (
                        f"The developer is {developer}."
                    )

                return (
                    "The developer is not available "
                    "in the supplied property data."
                )

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # Price
            # -----------------------------------------------------

            if intent == "property_price":

                price = property_data.get("price")
                currency = property_data.get(
                    "currency"
                )

                if price is not None:

                    if currency:
                        return (
                            f"The asking price is "
                            f"{currency} "
                            f"{price:,.0f}."
                        )

                    return (
                        f"The asking price is "
                        f"{price:,.0f}."
                    )

                return (
                    "The asking price is not available "
                    "in the supplied property data."
                )

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # Area
            # -----------------------------------------------------

            if intent == "property_area":

                area = property_data.get("area")
                unit = property_data.get(
                    "area_unit"
                )

                if area is not None:

                    if unit:
                        return (
                            f"The property area is "
                            f"{area} {unit}."
                        )

                    return (
                        f"The property area is {area}."
                    )

                return (
                    "The property area is not available "
                    "in the supplied property data."
                )

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # Location
            # -----------------------------------------------------

            if intent == "property_location":

                city = property_data.get("city")
                country = property_data.get(
                    "country"
                )

                location = ", ".join(
                    value
                    for value in [
                        city,
                        country,
                    ]
                    if value
                )

                if location:
                    return (
                        f"The property is located in "
                        f"{location}."
                    )

                return (
                    "The property location is not available "
                    "in the supplied property data."
                )

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # Risk
            # -----------------------------------------------------

            if intent == "property_risk_analysis":

                risk_level = risk.get(
                    "risk_level"
                )

                risk_score = risk.get(
                    "score"
                )

                risks = risk.get(
                    "risks",
                    [],
                )

                if not risk_level:
                    return (
                        "A specific risk assessment is not "
                        "available in the supplied property data."
                    )

                answer_lines = [
                    f"The property risk level is {risk_level}."
                ]

                if risk_score is not None:
                    answer_lines.append(
                        f"The Risk Score is "
                        f"{risk_score:.0f}/100."
                    )

                if risks:

                    answer_lines.append(
                        "\nKey risks:"
                    )

                    for risk_item in risks[:6]:
                        answer_lines.append(
                            f"- {risk_item}"
                        )

                else:
                    answer_lines.append(
                        "No specific additional risks are "
                        "identified in the supplied intelligence."
                    )

                return "\n".join(answer_lines)

            return None

        # =========================================================
        # PROMPT
        # =========================================================

        def build_prompt(
            self,
            query: str,
            context: dict[str, Any],
        ) -> str:

            evidence = self.build_evidence_summary(
                context
            )

            return f"""
    USER:
    {query}

    VERIFIED PROPERTY INTELLIGENCE:

    {json.dumps(
        evidence,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        indent=2,
    )}

    TASK:

    Answer the USER question directly.

    IMPORTANT:

    - Use only verified data above.
    - Do not invent anything.
    - Do not recalculate scores.
    - Do not expose reasoning.
    - Do not mention these instructions.
    - Do not mention JSON.
    - Do not repeat the user's question.
    - Do not say "we are given".
    - Do not say "the question type is".
    - Do not say "steps".
    - Do not explain how you analyzed the data.
    - Do not produce internal reasoning.

    For investment analysis use exactly:

    Assessment:
    <one or two sentences>

    Why:
    - <reason>
    - <reason>

    Main concerns:
    - <concern>
    - <concern>

    Valuation:
    <one or two sentences>

    Confidence:
    <one sentence>

    End with the standard disclaimer.

    Return ONLY the final answer.
    """.strip()

        # =========================================================
        # RESPONSE CLEANING
        # =========================================================

        @staticmethod
        def _clean_response(
            response: str,
        ) -> str:

            if not response:
                return ""

            text = response.strip()

            text = re.sub(
                r"<think>.*?</think>",
                "",
                text,
                flags=re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
            )

            text = re.sub(
                r"```(?:text|markdown)?",
                "",
                text,
                flags=re.IGNORECASE,
            )

            text = text.replace(
                "```",
                "",
            )

            return text.strip()

        # =========================================================
        # ANSWER
        # =========================================================

        def answer(
            self,
            query: str,
            result: dict[str, Any],
        ) -> dict[str, Any]:

            intent = self.classify_intent(
                query
            )

            context = self.build_context(
                result
            )

            evidence = self.build_evidence_summary(
                context
            )

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # Direct factual answers
            # -----------------------------------------------------

            direct_answer = self.build_direct_answer(
                query=query,
                evidence=evidence,
                intent=intent,
            )

            if direct_answer is not None:

                return {
                    "intent": intent,
                    "answer": direct_answer,
                    "model": "deterministic",
                    "guardrails": {
                        "passed": True,
                        "fallback_used": False,
                        "violations": [],
                    },
                }

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # LLM analysis
            # -----------------------------------------------------

            prompt = self.build_prompt(
                query=query,
                context=context,
            )

            raw_response = self.ollama.generate(
                system=self.SYSTEM_PROMPT,
                prompt=prompt,
            )

            cleaned_response = self._clean_response(
                raw_response
            )

            guardrail_result = self.guardrails.validate(
                answer=cleaned_response,
                evidence=evidence,
            )

            return {
                "intent": intent,
                "answer": guardrail_result["answer"],
                "model": "qwen3:4b",
                "guardrails": {
                    "passed": guardrail_result.get(
                        "valid",
                        False,
                    ),
                    "fallback_used": guardrail_result.get(
                        "fallback_used",
                        False,
                    ),
                    "violations": guardrail_result.get(
                        "violations",
                        [],
                    ),
                },
            }

    2. Important: update app/services/ai_guardrails.py

    Your current guardrails have a fundamental issue: they only understand the long structured response.

    For example, this perfectly valid answer:

        The risk level is moderate. The Risk Score is 51/100.

    would fail because it doesn't contain:

    Assessment:
    Why:
    Main concerns:
    Valuation:
    Confidence:

    So do not run normal structured guardrails against direct factual responses.

    The orchestrator above handles those responses before Ollama/guardrails.

    But your guardrails should also detect the exact reasoning leakage you're currently seeing.

    Add these patterns to FORBIDDEN_PATTERNS:

    2. Update PropertyAIAnswer.tsx

    Your current UI expects structured AI sections. For direct responses like:

    Replace your entire PropertyAIAnswer.tsx with:

    import React from "react";
    import "./PropertyAIAnswer.css";

    interface PropertyAIAnswerProps {
      answer: string;
    }

    type Sections = {
      Assessment?: string[];
      Why?: string[];
      "Main concerns"?: string[];
      Valuation?: string[];
      Confidence?: string[];
      Risk?: string[];
    };

    const SECTION_NAMES = [
      "Assessment",
      "Why",
      "Main concerns",
      "Valuation",
      "Confidence",
      "Risk",
    ] as const;

    function parseAnswer(answer: string): Sections {
      const sections: Sections = {};

      let currentSection:
        | keyof Sections
        | null = null;

      answer.split("\n").forEach((line) => {
        const trimmed = line.trim();

        if (!trimmed) {
          return;
        }

        const matchedSection = SECTION_NAMES.find(
          (section) =>
            trimmed.toLowerCase() ===
            `${section.toLowerCase()}:`
        );

        if (matchedSection) {
          currentSection = matchedSection;
          sections[matchedSection] = [];
          return;
        }

        if (currentSection) {
          sections[currentSection]?.push(trimmed);
        }
      });

      return sections;
    }

    interface SectionProps {
      title: string;
      children: React.ReactNode;
    }

    function Section({
      title,
      children,
    }: SectionProps) {
      return (
        <section className="ai-answer-section">
          <h3>{title}</h3>
          {children}
        </section>
      );
    }

    interface LinesProps {
      lines?: string[];
    }

    function Lines({ lines }: LinesProps) {
      if (!lines?.length) {
        return null;
      }

      return (
        <div className="ai-answer-lines">
          {lines.map((line, index) => {
            const isBullet =
              line.startsWith("- ") ||
              line.startsWith("• ");

            if (isBullet) {
              return (
                <div
                  key={index}
                  className="ai-answer-bullet"
                >
                  <span className="ai-answer-bullet-icon">
                    •
                  </span>

                  <span>
                    {line.replace(/^[-•]\s*/, "")}
                  </span>
                </div>
              );
            }

            return (
              <p key={index}>
                {line}
              </p>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      );
    }

    function DirectAnswer({
      answer,
    }: {
      answer: string;
    }) {
      const lines = answer
        .split("\n")
        .map((line) => line.trim())
        .filter(Boolean);

      return (
        <div className="ai-direct-answer">
          {lines.map((line, index) => {

            if (
              line.toLowerCase() === "key risks:"
            ) {
              return (
                <h4
                  key={index}
                  className="ai-direct-heading"
                >
                  Key risks
                </h4>
              );
            }

            const isBullet =
              line.startsWith("- ") ||
              line.startsWith("• ");

            if (isBullet) {
              return (
                <div
                  key={index}
                  className="ai-answer-bullet"
                >
                  <span className="ai-answer-bullet-icon">
                    •
                  </span>

                  <span>
                    {line.replace(/^[-•]\s*/, "")}
                  </span>
                </div>
              );
            }

            if (
              line.toLowerCase().startsWith(
                "risk level:"
              )
            ) {
              const value = line.substring(
                "risk level:".length
              ).trim();

              return (
                <div
                  key={index}
                  className="ai-risk-summary"
                >
                  <span className="ai-risk-label">
                    Risk level
                  </span>

                  <strong className="ai-risk-value">
                    {value}
                  </strong>
                </div>
              );
            }

            if (
              line.toLowerCase().startsWith(
                "risk score:"
              )
            ) {
              const value = line.substring(
                "risk score:".length
              ).trim();

              return (
                <div
                  key={index}
                  className="ai-risk-summary"
                >
                  <span className="ai-risk-label">
                    Risk Score
                  </span>

                  <strong className="ai-risk-value">
                    {value}
                  </strong>
                </div>
              );
            }

            return (
              <p key={index}>
                {line}
              </p>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      );
    }

    export default function PropertyAIAnswer({
      answer,
    }: PropertyAIAnswerProps) {

      if (!answer) {
        return null;
      }

      const sections = parseAnswer(answer);

      const hasStructuredSections =
        Object.keys(sections).length > 0;

      /*
       * Direct factual/risk answers do not use the
       * Assessment / Why / Valuation structure.
       *
       * Render them directly instead of forcing them
       * into the investment-analysis UI.
       */
      if (!hasStructuredSections) {
        return (
          <div className="property-ai-answer">
            <DirectAnswer answer={answer} />
          </div>
        );
      }

      return (
        <div className="property-ai-answer">

          {sections.Assessment && (
            <Section title="Assessment">
              <Lines
                lines={sections.Assessment}
              />
            </Section>
          )}

          {sections.Why && (
            <Section title="Why">
              <Lines
                lines={sections.Why}
              />
            </Section>
          )}

          {sections["Main concerns"] && (
            <Section title="Main concerns">
              <Lines
                lines={sections["Main concerns"]}
              />
            </Section>
          )}

          {sections.Risk && (
            <Section title="Risk">
              <Lines
                lines={sections.Risk}
              />
            </Section>
          )}

          {sections.Valuation && (
            <Section title="Valuation">
              <Lines
                lines={sections.Valuation}
              />
            </Section>
          )}

          {sections.Confidence && (
            <Section title="Confidence">
              <Lines
                lines={sections.Confidence}
              />
            </Section>
          )}
        </div>
      );
    }

        def classify_intent(
            self,
            query: str,
        ) -> str:

            q = query.lower().strip()

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # Developer
            # -----------------------------------------------------

            developer_patterns = [
                "who is the developer",
                "who developed",
                "who developed this",
                "developer of this property",
                "property developer",
            ]

            if any(
                pattern in q
                for pattern in developer_patterns
            ):
                return "property_developer"

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # Price
            # -----------------------------------------------------

            price_patterns = [
                "what is the price",
                "what's the price",
                "how much is this property",
                "how much does this property cost",
                "asking price",
                "property price",
                "price of this property",
                "cost of this property",
            ]

            if any(
                pattern in q
                for pattern in price_patterns
            ):
                return "property_price"

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # Area
            # -----------------------------------------------------

            area_patterns = [
                "what is the area",
                "what's the area",
                "how big is this property",
                "property size",
                "how large is this property",
                "square feet",
                "sq ft",
            ]

            if any(
                pattern in q
                for pattern in area_patterns
            ):
                return "property_area"

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # Location
            # -----------------------------------------------------

            location_patterns = [
                "where is this property",
                "where is the property",
                "property location",
                "where is it located",
                "which city is this property",
                "which country is this property",
            ]

            if any(
                pattern in q
                for pattern in location_patterns
            ):
                return "property_location"

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # Risk
            # -----------------------------------------------------

            risk_patterns = [
                "risk",
                "risks",
                "risky",
                "any risk",
                "any risks",
                "what are the risks",
                "what risks",
                "risk with this property",
                "risk associated",
                "risk involved",
            ]

            if any(
                pattern in q
                for pattern in risk_patterns

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # Investment

            ]

            if any(

            if any(

                "properties above",
                "bedroom",
            ]

                for pattern in search_patterns
            ):
                return "property_search"

            return "property_general"

    Do not explain reasoning.
    """.strip()

        # =========================================================
        # ANSWER
        # =========================================================

        def answer(
            self,
            query: str,
            result: dict[str, Any],
        ) -> dict[str, Any]:

            intent = self.classify_intent(
                query
            )

            context = self.build_context(
                result
            )

            evidence = self.build_evidence_summary(
                context
            )

            # =====================================================
            # DIRECT ANSWERS
            # =====================================================

            direct_answer = self.build_direct_answer(
                query=query,
                evidence=evidence,
                intent=intent,
            )

            if direct_answer is not None:

                return {
                    "intent": intent,
                    "answer": direct_answer,
                    "model": "deterministic",
                    "guardrails": {
                        "passed": True,
                        "fallback_used": False,
                        "violations": [],
                    },
                }

            # =====================================================
            # ONLY ANALYTICAL QUESTIONS REACH OLLAMA
            # =====================================================

            prompt = self.build_prompt(
                query=query,
                context=context,
            )

            raw_response = self.ollama.generate(
                system=self.SYSTEM_PROMPT,
                prompt=prompt,
            )

            cleaned_response = self._clean_response(
                raw_response
            )

            guardrail_result = self.guardrails.validate(
                answer=cleaned_response,
                evidence=evidence,
            )

            return {
                "intent": intent,
                "answer": guardrail_result["answer"],
                "model": "qwen3:4b",
                "guardrails": {
                    "passed": guardrail_result.get(
                        "valid",
                        False,
                    ),
                    "fallback_used": guardrail_result.get(
                        "fallback_used",
                        False,
                    ),
                    "violations": guardrail_result.get(
                        "violations",
                        [],
                    ),
                },
            }


        # =========================================================
        # DIRECT ANSWERS
        # =========================================================

        @staticmethod
        def build_direct_answer(
            self,
            query: str,
            evidence: dict[str, Any],
            intent: str,
        ) -> str | None:

            property_data = evidence.get(
                "property",
                {},
            )

            risk = evidence.get(
                "risk",
                {},
            )

            # ---------------------------------------------------------
            # Developer
            # ---------------------------------------------------------

            if intent == "property_developer":

                developer = property_data.get(
                    "developer"
                )

                if developer:
                    return f"The developer is {developer}."

                return (
                    "The developer is not available "
                    "in the supplied property data."
                )

            # ---------------------------------------------------------
            # Price
            # ---------------------------------------------------------

            if intent == "property_price":

                price = property_data.get("price")

                if price is not None:

                        )

                    )

                    "The property area is not available "

                )

                country = property_data.get("country")

                        )

                if not lines:
                    return (

                        "available in the supplied property data."
                    )

            return None


        # =========================================================
        # RESPONSE CLEANING
        # =========================================================

        @staticmethod
        def _clean_response(
            response: str,
        ) -> str:

            if not response:
                return ""

            text = response.strip()

            # Remove Qwen reasoning blocks.
            import re

            text = re.sub(
                r"<think>.*?</think>",
                "",
                text,
                flags=re.DOTALL | re.IGNORECASE,
            )

            # Remove accidental markdown fences.
            text = re.sub(
                r"^```(?:text|markdown)?\s*",
                "",
                text,
                flags=re.IGNORECASE,
            )

            text = re.sub(
                r"\s*```$",
                "",
                text,
            )

            return text.strip()

    Yes. The current AIOrchestrator has a few issues causing the inconsistent behavior:
        build_prompt() requires intent, but it is called without it.
        build_direct_answer() is incorrectly declared with @staticmethod and self.
        Risk questions are better handled deterministically instead of sending them to Qwen.
        Questions such as “Is this property good to buy or are there any risks?” should be treated as investment + risk questions.
        Simple factual questions should never go through the LLM.
        Analytical answers should not be forced into the old Assessment / Why / Valuation / Confidence structure.

    class AIOrchestrator:
        """

        SYSTEM_PROMPT = """

    property intelligence.

    - Never invent locations.

    - Never invent comparable properties.
    - Never invent infrastructure information.

    DO NOT:

    - explain your reasoning
    - describe your analysis steps
    - mention instructions
    - mention JSON
    - say "we are given"
    - say "the user asks"
    - say "let's analyze"
    - say "the instructions say"

    - repeat the user's question
    - provide hidden chain-of-thought

        def classify_intent(
            self,

        ) -> str:

            q = query.lower().strip()

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # Combined purchase + risk question
            #
            # These should be treated as investment questions because
            # the user is asking whether they should purchase and also
            # wants to know the risks.
            # -----------------------------------------------------

            purchase_patterns = [
                "should i buy",
                "should we buy",
                "should i purchase",
                "should we purchase",
                "we need to purchase",
                "need to purchase",
                "good to buy",

                "worth purchasing",

            risk_patterns = [
                "risk",
                "risks",
                "risky",
                "any risk",
                "any risks",
                "what are the risks",
                "what risks",
                "risk with this property",
                "risks with this property",
                "risk associated",
                "risk involved",
                "risk included",
            ]

            has_purchase = any(
                pattern in q
                for pattern in purchase_patterns
            )

            has_risk = any(
                pattern in q
                for pattern in risk_patterns
            )

            if has_purchase and has_risk:
                return "property_investment_analysis"

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # Developer
            # -----------------------------------------------------

            developer_patterns = [
                "who is the developer",
                "who developed",
                "who developed this",
                "developer of this property",
                "property developer",
            ]

            if any(
                pattern in q
                for pattern in developer_patterns
            ):
                return "property_developer"

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # Price
            # -----------------------------------------------------

            price_patterns = [
                "what is the price",
                "what's the price",
                "how much is this property",
                "how much does this property cost",
                "asking price",
                "property price",
                "price of this property",
                "cost of this property",
                "how much is the property",
            ]

            if any(
                pattern in q
                for pattern in price_patterns
            ):
                return "property_price"

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # Area
            # -----------------------------------------------------

            area_patterns = [
                "what is the area",
                "what's the area",
                "how big is this property",
                "property size",
                "how large is this property",
                "square feet",
                "sq ft",
                "area of this property",
            ]

            if any(
                pattern in q
                for pattern in area_patterns
            ):
                return "property_area"

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # Location
            # -----------------------------------------------------

            location_patterns = [
                "where is this property",
                "where is the property",
                "property location",
                "where is it located",
                "which city is this property",
                "which country is this property",
                "location of this property",
            ]

            if any(
                pattern in q
                for pattern in location_patterns

                return "property_location"

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # Risk
            # -----------------------------------------------------

            if has_risk:
                return "property_risk_analysis"

            # -----------------------------------------------------
            # Investment
            # -----------------------------------------------------

            investment_patterns = [

            if any(

            # -----------------------------------------------------

            comparison_patterns = [

                "which is better",

            if any(
